Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Healthcare team

  • Our healthcare agents already reach over 50% of U.S. families. We partner with leading health plans, providers, and healthcare platforms to deliver AI agents that handle some of the most sensitive and high stakes conversations in any industry. From helping members understand their benefits to resolving billing questions with empathy, our healthcare agents are transforming how patients and policyholders interact with the healthcare system.

  • Our healthcare customers include major health insurance networks, nonprofit providers, multi-site primary and urgent care practices, healthcare diagnostics companies, and healthcare financial platforms.

  • Join us to transform the patient experience across the healthcare system—and help build technology that makes care more accessible, more human and more affordable for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

  • Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

  • Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

  • Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

What you'll bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Platform (Europe)
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About North:

North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

Why This Role?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows.

You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

In this role, you will:

  • Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies

  • Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance

  • Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualisation through production

  • Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution

  • Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams

  • Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization

  • Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners

You may be a good fit if:

  • You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code

  • You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute

  • You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

  • You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency

  • You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs

  • You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end

  • You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting

It's a bonus if you have:

  • Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams

  • Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it

  • Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)

  • Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Post-Training (Reinforcement Learning & Generalization)
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Key Overview:
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training, you will train our large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning and develop methods that help them generalize beyond the distribution they were trained on. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, run, and analyse large-scale RL post-training experiments (e.g., RLHF, RL from verifiable rewards).

  • Research and develop methods that improve out-of-distribution generalization, such as reward design, environment and task diversity, curricula, and regularization.

  • Build held-out evaluations that measure generalization to unseen tasks, domains, and formats, and that catch reward hacking and benchmark overfitting.

  • Diagnose training dynamics and failure modes, including instability, reward over-optimization, and capability regressions.

  • Turn successful research into robust, reproducible training recipes for production models.


Qualifications

  • Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.

  • Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.

  • Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.

  • Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Agentic Environments
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Role Overview:
At Cohere, we're pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can achieve for production environments, and we're seeking a senior engineer who understands the practical challenges of making AI systems work at scale. This role demands deep technical expertise in production environments and the ability to bridge research concepts with real-world implementations.

This position is hands-on and engineering-driven. You'll focus on production systems, experiment with frontier models, and collaborate with talented engineers to build scalable, production ready solutions. We strive for excellence in both engineering and science by meticulously designing experiments and design docs. We blend engineering and research seamlessly. Everyone contributes to both, depending on organizational needs. We provide access to world class compute resources, data, and talent to ensure you can do your best work. This role is perfect for you if you:

  • Have a deep passion for quality work.

  • Enjoy tuning and optimising large LLM models.

  • Comfortable working with people with different levels of software engineering skills, from beginner to more advanced.

  • Comfortable diving into complex ML codebases to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our systems.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment, where you can contribute your innovative ideas and solutions.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and write high-performing and scalable software for training models.

  • Develop new tools to support and accelerate research and LLM training.

  • Coordinate with other engineering teams (Infrastructure, Efficiency, Serving) and the scientific teams (Agent, Multimodal, Multilingual, etc.).

  • Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our cluster and data infrastructure.

  • Collaborate, Collaborate, and Collaborate with other scientists, engineers, and teams!


Qualifications:

  • Extremely strong software engineering skills.

  • Value test-driven development methods, clean code, and strive to reduce technical debts at all levels.

  • Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX, Pytorch and/or XLA/MLIR.

  • Experience using and debugging large-scale distributed training strategies (memory/speed profiling).

  • Experience with distributed training infrastructures (Kubernetes) and associated frameworks (Ray).

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About North:

North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.


Why this role:

The Data Abstractions & Tools team is the group inside North responsible for how users bring their data into the platform and put it to work. We own the systems that let users upload, organize, and share their files and knowledge bases, the framework for extending agents with skills and third-party integrations, and the data-sync pipeline that connects enterprise data sources to North's agents.

North connects to a growing set of external tools and data sources so its agents can act on a user's real workflow. This role owns the integration pipeline end-to-end: adding new integrations to the platform, helping other engineers do the same, and becoming the owner of the process that makes that repeatable. You will also create the evals and tests that make sure those integrations work as expected and keep working as the platform evolves.

In this role, you will:

  • Build new integrations (tools) on the North agentic platform, and maintain the ones already in production.

  • Own the integration pipeline: the process for adding a new tool, from design to shipping to ongoing maintenance.

  • Help other engineers add integrations of their own, and raise the bar for how the team does it.

  • Create evals and tests to make sure integrations work as expected and alert on regressions.

  • Tune tool descriptions to improve performance based on feedback and evals.

  • Use AI actively in your work, while staying accountable for the quality and reliability of what you ship.

You may be a good fit if:

  • You have shipped production code and are comfortable building integrations against external APIs.

  • You have a background in evaluating agentic systems (ideal), or at minimum know what an eval is and are comfortable with prompt engineering and tool-description tuning.

  • You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities are a moving target.

  • You bring high agency: you learn quickly and drive change without waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You've owned things end-to-end before and care about the quality of what ships, not just that it shipped.

  • You enjoy helping other engineers succeed, not just shipping your own work.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Automotive
jobs.description_plain: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. À propos du poste En tant que responsable de compte Entreprise chez Anthropic, vous intégrerez l’équipe fondatrice en charge du déploiement de nos solutions API et SaaS de productivité, à la pointe de l’IA, à destination des organisations du secteur automobile en France. Vous favoriserez l’adoption d’une IA sûre et de pointe en concluant des accords stratégiques avec des constructeurs automobiles, des équipementiers de rang 1 et de rang 2, ainsi que des fournisseurs de solutions de mobilité. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en vente consultative dans le secteur automobile pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d’affaires, tout en devenant un partenaire de confiance pour les parties prenantes du secteur automobile. Vous les accompagnerez dans l’intégration et le déploiement de l’IA, en explorant tout son potentiel dans les domaines de l’ingénierie et de la conception, des opérations de fabrication, des services de véhicules connectés et de l’après-vente. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez continuellement notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement sur le marché afin de répondre aux besoins des décideurs du secteur automobile. Le candidat idéal est passionné par le développement de nouveaux segments de marché, par l'identification des opportunités à fort potentiel et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en favorisant le développement éthique de l'IA. Responsabilités: Développez le portefeuille clients et stimulez les revenus d’Anthropic dans le secteur automobile. Naviguez au sein d’organisations complexes du secteur automobile pour identifier les décideurs clés, les informer sur nos services et les accompagner vers le succès avec Anthropic. Vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de vente, depuis le premier contact jusqu’à la conclusion. Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies de vente innovantes adaptées aux cycles d'approvisionnement automobiles, à la qualification des fournisseurs et aux processus budgétaires afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. About the Role: As the 2nd-line leader for the Applied AI Industries team in Southern Europe and the Middle-East at Anthropic, you will drive the adoption of frontier AI in partnership with the rest of the go to market organization. Our Industries customers in France, Iberia and Italy include many of the region's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, telecom, retail, energy, and other sectors. You'll leverage your experience building and leading technical sales teams to drive positive AI transformation that addresses our customers' business needs, meets their technical and regulatory requirements, and provides a high degree of reliability and safety. You will be responsible for leading and growing the solutions architect team that partners with account executives to help companies adopt and deploy Anthropic's products, including Claude Cowork, Claude Code, and the Claude Development Platform (our API). This will include leveraging your technical skills and consultative sales experience to hire great 1st line managers and individual contributors, establish processes to scale your team, and represent Anthropic directly at strategic customer engagements. Your team covers several countries and industries at once, so you will be responsible for thinking strategically about complex industry accounts and for identifying and rolling out solutions that resonate in each market, with its own language, business culture, and regulatory context. Responsibilities: Hire, manage, and guide a team of 1st line managers who will in turn build teams of pre-sales Applied AI Architects across France, Iberia and Italy. Set goals for your team in collaboration with sales leadership and establish baseline expectations for performance across your team. Act as a technical and executive sponsor for high-value strategic customers in the region and advise them on their overall AI adoption strategies or use case scoping and pilot execution. Partner closely with Southern Europe sales leadership (also covering the Middle-East and Africa) to build strategies for complex industry accounts and identify new ways to drive adoption of Anthropic products within specific verticals or horizontal use cases. Help customers navigate local and European regulatory requirements (for example the EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, and data residency expectations) and adapt how your team engages to the business culture of each market. Work with cross-functional teams like product and engineering to ensure Anthropic prioritizes customer feedback or resolves blockers to adoption in the region. Travel regularly across Southern Europe to customers or conferences for executive-level sessions, technical workshops, and relationship building. Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI in technology products. Contribute to thought leadership through conference presentations, webinars, and technical content creation. Stay current with emerging AI trends and the competitive landscape. You may be a good fit if you: 7+ years of technical pre-sales management experience, including 2nd-line leadership or above (leading managers). Have sold complex technical products to large enterprises in France, Iberia, Italy, the Middle-East and Africa. Have worked across multiple industries, such as financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, telecom, retail, and energy. Understand the cultural differences between Southern European markets and the regulatory context your customers operate in, and adapt your approach to each. Think highly strategically about complex industry accounts, and turn that thinking into plans your team and sales counterparts can execute. Have deep technical proficiency with enterprise AI use cases, API integrations, and LLM deployments. Thrive in building and rapidly scaling teams and processes within ambiguous and fast-moving environments. Have excellent communication, collaboration, and coaching abilities. Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with business and technical leaders at the region's largest companies. Have at least a high level familiarity with the architecture and operation of LLMs. Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial. Stay up-to-date and informed by taking an active interest in emerging research and industry trends within AI. Strong candidates may have: Enterprise pre-sales leadership at scale: 5+ years leading solution architect teams through hypergrowth (ideally dozens of people across several countries), with direct experience leading managers and developing talent in complex enterprise software sales environments. Multilingual and multicultural range: In addition to English, fluency in one or more of French, Italian, Spanish or Portuguese, and experience leading teams distributed across several countries. Experience with consumption business models: Ideal candidates have built GTM frameworks anchored on consumption, not just SaaS-based licenses. AI Technical Depth + Executive Engagement: Hands-on experience with AI platforms and enterprise integration patterns, combined with proven track record engaging C-level stakeholders in €10M+ technical evaluations and enterprise sales cycles. Multi-industry GTM experience in regulated sectors: Demonstrated success adapting technical approaches to different verticals, in particular regulated ones such as banking, insurance, and healthcare, including working with risk, compliance, and works council stakeholders. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €265.000 — €310.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Public Sector & Defense, France
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the French public sector and government landscape to lead our most strategic government accounts. This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of French government organizations.

What You'll Do

Strategic Customer Partnership:

  • Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere's French public sector customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions

  • Build deep, trusted relationships with senior French government stakeholders, including Ministres d'État, Préfets, CIOs, digital transformation leads, and ministerial executives

  • Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization's mission, digital strategy, budget cycles (lois de finances), and unique constraints

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction

  • Define and track success metrics aligned with French public sector priorities: citizen satisfaction, service delivery improvements, cost savings, operational efficiency, accessibility outcomes

AI Adoption & Implementation Leadership:

  • Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption—from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling

  • Lead secure AI implementation projects in complex French government environments, including sensitive systems and on-premises deployments

  • Navigate the unique challenges of French public sector AI adoption: legacy system integration, data sensitivity, lengthy approval processes (marchés publics), and regulatory compliance requirements

  • Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse government workforces

  • Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value

  • Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships

Customer Advocacy & Product Influence:

  • Serve as the voice of the French public sector customers within Cohere, advocating for features and capabilities that address government-specific needs

  • Provide strategic feedback to Product and Engineering teams on requirements related to security, explainability, accessibility, French language support, and ethical AI

  • Contribute to the development of French public sector-specific offerings, implementation playbooks, documentation, and best practices

  • Share customer insights to inform Cohere's French public sector go-to-market strategy and positioning

  • Represent Cohere at French government forums, working groups (groupes de travail), roundtables, and industry events

You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or French government contexts

  • At least 3-5 years working directly with French ministries, regional authorities, or public institutions in a technology, digital transformation, or consulting capacity

  • Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines

  • Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments

  • Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs

  • Deep understanding of how French government organizations evaluate, procure (following Code des marchés publics), implement, and govern technology solutions

  • Active Confidentiel-Défense or higher security clearance (mandatory)

  • Fluent French language proficiency—essential for working across the French public sector

French Public Sector & Government Acumen:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the French public sector ecosystem: central ministries, regional governments (régions), departmental authorities (départements), public enterprises, and critical infrastructure

  • Knowledge of relevant legislation and frameworks: RGPD, loi Informatique et Libertés, ANSSI standards, accessibility standards

  • Experience with French government cloud strategies and security frameworks: France Cloud, Souveraineté numérique

Nice to Have:

  • 3+ years specifically managing GenAI, LLM, or conversational AI implementations

  • Experience with specific French public sector digital transformation initiatives: France Relance, France 2030

  • Direct experience working with French defense, intelligence, public safety, or national security organizations

  • Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for French public sector clients

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Integration/RL Team (Research Engineer)
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview:

The integration team is responsible for developing and scaling machine learning algorithms and infrastructure for LLM post-training, with a focus on large-scale, distributed RL methods. We strive for excellence in both engineering and science by meticulously designing experiments and design docs. While tasks are assigned according to everyone’s expertise, there is a global team effort to write production code and support the team research efforts, depending on individual interests and organizational needs.

In particular, this role aims to enhance the global quality of the post-training codebase by implementing new tools to ease and support research, optimizing post-training algorithms, and scaling distributed RL to unprecedented levels.

Please Note: We have offices in London, Paris, Toronto, San Francisco, New York but we are also remote-friendly! Applicants for this role may work anywhere between UTC−06:00 and UTC+01:00.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and write high-performing and scalable software for training models.

  • Develop new tools to support and accelerate research and LLM training.

  • Coordinate with other engineering teams (Infrastructure, Efficiency, Serving) and the scientific teams (Agent, Multimodal, Multilingual, etc.) to create a strong and integrated post-training ecosystem.

  • Craft and implement techniques to improve performance and speed up our training cycles, both on SFT, offline preference, and the RL regime.

  • Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our cluster and data infrastructure.

  • Collaborate, Collaborate, and Collaborate with other scientists, engineers, and teams!

Qualifications:

  • Extremely strong software engineering skills.

  • Value test-driven development methods, clean code, and strive to reduce technical debts at all levels.

  • Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX, Pytorch and/or XLA/MLIR.

  • Experience using and debugging large-scale distributed training strategies (memory/speed profiling).

  • [Bonus] Experience with distributed training infrastructures (Kubernetes) and associated frameworks (Ray).

  • [Bonus] Hands-on experience with the post-training phase of model training, with a strong emphasis on scalability and performance.

  • [Bonus] Experience in ML, LLM and RL academic research.

This role is perfect for you if you:

  • Have a deep passion for quality work.

  • Enjoy tuning and optimising large LLM models.

  • Comfortable working with people with different levels of software engineering skills, from beginner to more advanced.

  • Comfortable diving into complex ML codebases to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our systems.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment, where you can contribute your innovative ideas and solutions.

Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Delivery for Public Sector & Defense, France
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on public sector and defence accounts in Europe, particularly in France. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Ministries, Agencies, and defence organisations across Europe. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government and defence engagements.

Location: France

Eligibility: Critically, this individual is required to be a French citizen living in France with fluency in French as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers.

Security Clearance: Active French Secret clearance is preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.

What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

  • Own end-to-end technical program delivery for French and broader European public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

  • Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

  • Translate complex public sector and defence requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

  • Navigate complex procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

  • Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, pubic sector and defence leadership

  • Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

  • Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior stakeholders including departmental executives

  • Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

  • Create and manage project schedules that account for public sector and defence timelines, security review processes, and approval cycles

  • Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

  • Navigate risks unique to government and defence deployments: privacy compliance, security, political and regulatory, technology and infrastructure.

  • Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific customer requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

  • Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

  • Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

  • Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government and defence deployments

  • Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

  • Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers.

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

  • Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

  • Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

  • Deep understanding of how government and defence organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

  • Familiarity with European government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

  • Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

  • Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

  • Eligible to obtain French security clearance

Nice to Have:

  • Active French security clearance (Secret or Top Secret)

  • Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

  • Background in or strong familiarity with European defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

  • Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

  • Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for French government security clearance.

Candidates must be eligible for French government clearance, meaning that they require French citizenship. In addition, this individual is required to be based in France and be fluent in French as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers.

What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management - it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government and defence engagements. Location: France Eligibility: Critically, this individual is required to be a French citizen living in France with fluency in French as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers. Security Clearance: Active French Secret clearance is preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered. What You'll Do Customer Program Leadership: - Own end-to-end technical program delivery for French and broader European public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling - Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams - Translate complex public sector and defence requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans - Navigate complex procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations. Strategic Communication: - Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, pubic sector and defence leadership - Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds - Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior stakeholders including departmental executives - Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts. Complex Program Management: - Create and manage project schedules that account for public sector and defence timelines, security review processes, and approval cycles - Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams - Navigate risks unique to government and defence deployments: privacy compliance, security, political and regulatory, technology and infrastructure. - Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific customer requirements. Technical Delivery & Execution: - Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards - Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support - Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government and defence deployments - Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments. You May Be a Good Fit If: Required Experience: - 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery. - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management. - Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers. - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements. - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus. Technical Background: - Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped) - Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator - Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders. Government & Defence Acumen: - Deep understanding of how government and defence organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology - Familiarity with European government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications - Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment - Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset - Eligible to obtain French security clearance Nice to Have: - Active French security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - Bilingual (English/French) proficiency - Background in or strong familiarity with European defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors - Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments - Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies. Security Clearance Requirements This role requires eligibility for French government security clearance. Candidates must be eligible for French government clearance, meaning that they require French citizenship. In addition, this individual is required to be based in France and be fluent in French as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers. What Makes This Role Unique This isn't typical program management - it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability. If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect, France
jobs.description_html:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

  • Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

  • Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

  • Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

  • Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

  • Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

  • Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

  • Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

  • Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

  • Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

  • Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

  • Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

  • Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

  • Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

  • Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €106,000 - €119,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

  • Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

  • Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

  • Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

  • Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France.

  • Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

  • Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

  • Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

  • Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

  • Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

  • Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

  • Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

  • Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.

Who We're Looking For:

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France.

  • Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise)
