jobs.title: Project Manager, Brand Marketing & Creative
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

If you're a brand marketing & creative project manager who thrives in fast-moving environments and knows how to balance artistic ambition with operational excellence, this is the role for you. As the Integrated Project Manager, Brand Marketing & Creative at Suno, you'll be the operational heartbeat of the Brand & Creative team - owning end-to-end project management across two connected pillars: brand marketing campaigns and creative studio production. You'll be the connective tissue between ideas and execution, making sure every campaign and every asset - from copy to motion to video to print - gets made on time, to spec, and without anything falling through the cracks. Reporting to the Senior Project Manager & Operations Lead, you'll work closely with internal teams and external partners alike, and play a direct role in helping a world-class creative team do its best work.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/RheZlTv8blpBmZep

What You'll Do

Creative Studio Production Management

  • Own creative intake and trafficking for the creative studio - managing the full pipeline of deliverables (copy, design, motion, video, print) from brief to final delivery supporting all cross-functional teams and needs

  • Drive project management end-to-end across all creative studio asset types, building production timelines and tracking progress to keep the team's output on schedule and on spec

  • Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and freelancers supporting creative studio production - managing relationships, scopes, and deliverables to keep external work running smoothly

Brand Marketing Campaign Management

  • Own end-to-end project management of brand marketing campaigns spanning tentpole brand moments, social and editorial/content initiatives - working closely with stakeholders across creative, music, press, influencer, product etc - from initial brief through launch and wrap-up

  • Build and maintain campaign timelines and workstreams, tracking milestones across teams and proactively surfacing blockers before they become problems

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for campaign intake, coordinating prioritization and workflow across cross-functional partners including creative, music, editorial, social, product and more

Cross-Team Operations

  • Own stakeholder communication across the org - keeping teams informed, aligned, and unblocked with clear, timely updates on both brand campaign and creative studio status

  • Partner directly with the Sr. PM & Operations Lead to support day-to-day operations of the Brand & Creative team, helping build a team where creative ambition and operational rigor reinforce each other

  • Contribute to Suno's mission of making the world more musical and supporting the creative infrastructure that helps the world's most advanced music platform tell its story

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 3-5 years of experience in creative and/or campaign project management, either in-house at a creative or brand team or at a creative/marketing agency

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously - both marketing campaigns and creative production - across diverse asset types (copy, design, motion, video, print) without losing detail or momentum

  • Fluency in Notion or a comparable project management tool (Asana, Monday.com, etc.)

  • Exceptional communication skills - you write clearly, follow up consistently, and know how to move a room without stepping on toes

  • Obsessively organized and detail-oriented - you find satisfaction in structure and nothing slips past you

  • Experience coordinating with external vendors, freelancers, or agencies

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how it's changing creative work

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in music, entertainment, or creative media

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

  • $120,000 - $150,000 base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

Suno's paid search program spans every international market we operate in, and it needs someone who can bring both rigor and range to its management. As our SEM Manager, you'll own paid search acquisition strategy, signaling, and testing across Google, Bing, and Apple Search Ads while joining our Growth Marketing team at a time when speed and exploration is key. You'll work closely with our SEM Lead, Paid Social, Data Science, Finance, and Creative teams to scale enterprise-level accounts with the depth of nuance and structure it requires.

This role is designed for someone with high accountability, desire for ownership, and has proven effectiveness at-scale. You’ve managed +$20M annual budgets with a deep comfort in digging through large data sets, managing bid/budgets globally, creative testing, and executing for alpha via recurring optimizations. You are responsible for identifying growth opportunities and driving efficiency across one of Suno’s key acquisition channels.

Here’s a song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/knk1K1XI28KqQaAi

What You'll Do

  • Manage SEM suite: Scope spans a full array of networks from Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Apple Search Ads, and beyond. Manage budgets, bids, and audience strategy/structure to consistently drive towards our KPI targets.

  • Own Channel Performance Globally: Optimize campaigns driving new users, subscriptions, and team acquisition KPIs across web and app surfaces in multiple geographic markets with nuance and attention.

  • Drive KPIs using the full scope of campaign types: Meet users where they are and optimize funnel from first impression to subscription. Understand audience overlap and cross-channel pollination to maximize impact not just of your directly managed campaigns, but the overall effectiveness of a market or initiative.

  • Own analysis and reporting: Proactively dig into campaign performance and anomalies to diagnose trends and deliver actionable insights to the growth team.

  • Build your own tools: Leverage AI, internal tools, and data pipelines to remove blockers in your day-to-day. When something is broken or a desired dashboard doesn’t exist, try building the functionality yourself first rather than waiting for sprint backlogs from other teams.

  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Share copy/keyword insights back and forth with the Creative and Lifecycle teams. Solve data gaps with the Engineering team. Answer the impregnable questions with the Data science team.

  • Own Channel partner relationship: own the relationship with channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

  • Develop Testing Roadmap: Leverage industry, partner, and personal knowledge to identify the areas of deficiency or untapped potential. Always aware of the latest platform betas and which are useful/irrelevant. Not afraid of learning phases or testing entirely new directions in campaign structure.

What You'll Need

  • 4+ years of experience in SEM / paid search.

  • Deep platform expertise and understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and cross-channel overlap.

  • Experience managing large media budgets, with examples to share.

  • Background in highly competitive industries.

  • International campaign management experience - specifically in non-english markets.

  • Experience with UAC dynamics/nuance with understanding of MMPs for attribution modeling/tracking.

  • Hands-on expertise with Bulk & Offline Editors for large-scale account management.

  • Track record across reporting, bid management, and test planning.

  • Comfort operating with goal ambiguity, and the ability to explain SEM auction and trend nuance clearly and concisely to other teams.

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, especially with Data and Engineering partners.

  • A collaborative instinct where you lean on teammates for context and support rather than guessing.

  • Comfort using Claude (including Claude Code) or similar AI tools to speed up and sharpen day-to-day work.

  • Composure when working through complex datasets or ambiguous problems.

  • Nice to have: High proficiency in Excel; SQL is a plus.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days per week in our NYC office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is: $104k -$170k (before equity)

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer to make safe behavior the path of least resistance at Suno. Instead of only catching abuse after it happens, you'll work upstream. You'll study how bad actors exploit our product and where well-intentioned employees fall into risky shortcuts. Then you'll redesign the flows, defaults, friction points, and incentives underneath so that harmful behavior is structurally harder to carry out. Working at the intersection of behavioral science, product design, and security and trust & safety, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to build risk-reducing changes directly into their roadmaps. This work will help lay the foundation for Suno's security programs and strengthen our overall risk posture across security, trust & safety, fraud, and privacy.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/PWNyTikQfKQyZZ9V

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Investigate how abuse and risk actually happen on our platform and inside the company. That includes reading logs, interviewing support and ops teams, and reconstructing user and employee journeys to find the easy paths to harm.

  • Design concrete changes to signup flows, permission defaults, rate limits, approval steps, and verification gates, working alongside PMs and designers.

  • Get your recommendations onto other teams' roadmaps by making the case in planning meetings, writing proposals, and negotiating trade-offs, all without owning the roadmap yourself.

  • Measure changes in real behavior, not just detection rates. You'll define success metrics before a change ships and run before/after comparisons to prove impact.

  • Lead cross-functional root-cause reviews after incidents and near-misses by asking what about the design made risky behavior the easy option, then turning the answers into concrete backlog items.

  • Stay ahead of new attack patterns by tracking industry incidents and behavioral science research. You'll design targeted awareness and training only where it's the best lever, and make sure people actually find it useful.

  • Help make safe, trustworthy experiences part of how Suno builds every product, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES

  • 6+ years of experience in trust & safety, security, fraud, anti-abuse, or risk-focused product work, with the technical fluency to dig into logs and data yourself and to work credibly with engineers on implementation.

  • A track record of reducing risky behavior through product and process design (flows, defaults, friction, incentives), with measurable before/after results.

  • Strong influence skills, including a history of getting changes prioritized on roadmaps you didn't own by building trust with Product, Engineering, and Design partners.

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research.

  • Experience at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments.

  • Experience supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

NICE-TO-HAVES - Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research. - Experience at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments. - Experience supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function. jobs.title: Senior / Staff Data Scientist, Growth Monetization
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

As a Data Scientist on Growth Monetization, you'll drive all things monetization from the data science perspective: how we price, package, convert, and retain. That spans our subscription business today and new business bets we're actively exploring. You'll shape how we grow revenue at Suno, and work very cross functionally across product, engineering, design, and the rest of the data science team

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/RXQ8qqzbx6UGlHsc

What You'll Do

  • Drive all things monetization, from subscription conversion and churn to the revenue models for our newest business bets

  • Design and run experiments across pricing, packaging, paywalls, offers, and other revenue surfaces

  • Build the data foundation for new business lines from day one: the metrics, funnels, and unit economics for products that are just taking shape

  • Sit on a centralized data science team but serve as the lead DS for your product area, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and design

  • Advance our mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by building a business model that works for every kind of creator

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 6-8+ years in data science or product analytics roles, ideally owning a revenue or growth surface

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and statistical modeling

  • Deep experimentation experience grounded in statistical rigor: designing and running experiments end to end, deriving clear insights, and making strategic recommendations

  • Hands-on experience with monetization problems (conversion funnels, churn and retention, pricing and packaging, or the economics of a new product line)

  • A broad data science toolkit and the judgment to pick the right tool for the right question

  • Thrive in ambiguity, excited to wear multiple hats, and never stop learning

  • Excellent cross-functional collaborator: can work closely with product, eng, and design, and influence stakeholders across the company through data

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience monetizing more than one kind of product: consumer and business, self-serve and sales-assisted, or subscription and usage-based

  • Experience taking a new product or business line from zero to its first revenue

  • Hands-on AI usage in day-to-day data science work (agents, prompting, building small tools)

  • A love of music or creative tools

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $220K – $320K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Advance our mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by turning first visits into daily creative habits

  • 5-7+ years in data science or product analytics roles, ideally on consumer products

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and statistical modeling

  • Deep experimentation experience grounded in statistical rigor: designing and running experiments end to end, deriving clear insights, and making strategic recommendations

  • A self-starter mentality with an ownership mindset: you thrive in ambiguity, wear multiple hats, and never stop learning

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration: you work closely with product, eng, and design, and influence stakeholders and teams through data insights

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a fast-growing consumer app, or a startup that scaled through strong product-led growth

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the cloud that runs Suno. That covers our Kubernetes clusters, the GPU compute behind our AI workloads, and the network that connects them. You’ll report to our Security Lead, work closely with Platform Engineering, and partner with AppSec engineers and our Detection & Response team as they grow alongside you. This is a building job. You’ll write threat models, set hardened defaults, and create paved paths that engineers actually want to use. Some of the work is familiar cloud security. Some of it, like securing AI infrastructure, is new for everyone.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/Utj2JDlLzR4Dvs3p

What You'll Do

  • Build Suno’s infrastructure threat model across cloud, Kubernetes, GPU compute platforms, and networking, and use it with the Security Lead to decide where to focus first.

  • Harden our EKS clusters, GPU compute environments, and infrastructure-as-code pipeline, including who can change infrastructure and how.

  • Design paved paths and secure defaults, such as trusted base images, network segmentation, and scoped access, and ship the fixes yourself rather than handing off a list of findings.

  • Define the infrastructure detections and alerts we need beyond out-of-the-box tooling, working with Detection & Response, and be the expert they call when those alerts fire.

  • Partner with Platform Engineering and the broader engineering org to land changes in a fast-moving environment, and help shape a growing Security team.

  • Protect the systems that let millions of people make music, so creative fulfillment can be part of everyone’s day.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • At least 7 years of experience in infrastructure security or adjacent fields.

  • An engineering background building secure-by-default tooling and paved paths, not primarily running scans and reporting findings.

  • Hands-on depth in cloud-native security (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure are fine), plus Kubernetes and container security, including image provenance and software supply chain security, or the ability to learn them quickly.

  • Strong enough coding skills to build your own tooling and implement fixes without needing another engineer to carry them out.

  • End-to-end ownership of security projects, with the comfort to build in a greenfield environment where structure is still taking shape.

  • A collaborative working style and genuine interest in learning how to secure AI infrastructure.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience rolling out a cloud security posture management (CSPM) platform.

  • Experience securing AI or GPU compute platforms, or serverless container environments.

  • Experience building or maintaining the pipeline other engineers use to deploy infrastructure-as-code, such as plan/apply approvals, state management, or policy checks.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $276,960 - $363,510 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for early members of our iOS team at the Senior and Staff levels. These aren’t maintenance roles — you’ll help define the architecture and experience of a product that’s genuinely changing how the world makes music.

You’ll work directly alongside the founding team, shaping technical and product decisions from the ground up. The Suno iOS app is far more than a music player: it’s a real-time AI creation studio, a social platform for sharing and discovering original music, and a showcase for some of the most advanced generative audio technology ever shipped to consumers.

At the Senior level, you’ll own major features end-to-end, drive engineering quality, and contribute to architectural decisions. At the Staff level, you’ll set the technical direction for the iOS platform, mentor the team, and define the foundations that scale us to 10x our current user base and beyond.

If you care deeply about performance, polish, and building things that feel magical to use — and you want to do that in one of the most dynamic problem spaces in tech — this is the role for you.


Check out the Suno song we made about this role: https://suno.com/s/oEdmOtkZDLHCopSG

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build Suno’s iOS app across creation, discovery, playback, and social experiences

  • Create foundational abstractions and libraries for performant, highly interactive audio and animation

  • Collaborate closely with product and design to shape the feel, flow, and direction of the app

  • Optimize for performance, responsiveness, and delight — from frame rates to load times to micro-interactions

  • Instrument and monitor the app’s health, and iterate rapidly post-launch based on real user data

  • Set the technical direction for the iOS platform and define architectural patterns the team builds on

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, abstractions, and engineering culture

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years (Senior) or 7+ years (Staff) shipping production iOS apps

  • Advanced expertise in Swift — we use SwiftUI with UIKit where necessary

  • Deep experience building fluid, polished animations and translating design prototypes into robust, production-grade code

  • Strong sense for performance: you profile, benchmark, and fix, from UI thread contention to network efficiency

  • An obsession with great user experience — you care about the details that most engineers skip

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can scope work, make tradeoffs, and ship without a fully-defined spec

  • A collaborative spirit and strong communication — you work fluidly with designers, PMs, and backend teams

Strong Plusses

  • Experience working with audio playback systems, streaming pipelines, or real-time audio

  • Experience with social product features: feeds, follow graphs, notifications, publishing flows

  • Background designing or consuming mobile-first APIs in close collaboration with backend engineers

  • Track record building 0→1 consumer products at a fast-moving startup

  • Technical leadership or mentorship experience (especially important for Staff candidates)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is a 5 day a week role in our Chelsea, NYC locations

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $200K – $300K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO with HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Life at Suno: https://suno.com/about
Series D Announcement: https://suno.com/blog/series-d-announcement

jobs.title: Senior CRO Manager, Growth Marketing
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

  • Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

  • Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

  • Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

  • Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

  • Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

  • Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

  • Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

  • Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

  • Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

  • Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

  • Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

  • You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

  • 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

  • You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

  • You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

  • You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

  • You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

  • You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

  • You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

Compensation

$160k - $185k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description_html:

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Scientist on Content + Social, you'll build the analytical foundation for how people discover, listen to, share, and engage with music on Suno. You'll partner across three product areas — content experiences (listening, playlisting, and feed), social (shaping what community and interaction look like on Suno), and artists + creators (understanding what makes creators successful and how we amplify their work). This is a high-impact role where you'll set the strategy for how we measure and grow these interconnected experiences, working closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional partners on everything from strategy to execution.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/song/ca500252-9b76-442b-88bf-54befaff02ef?sh=LeSCpIrEXhGHEmS0

What You'll Do

  • Build comprehensive frameworks for understanding how users discover and engage with content and each other and design experiments to improve these experiences

  • Shape the analytical approach for our emerging social experiences, helping define what healthy social engagement looks like on a music platform and how to measure it

  • Develop deep understanding of creator and artist success which will drive our creator programs and incentives

  • Surface insights that connect content, social, and creator dynamics

  • Collaborate closely with product, business, and music functions

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years experience in data science roles, ideally with experience in content platforms, social products, or creator ecosystems

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly creative, multidisciplinary Senior Designer, Creative Studio to join Suno’s Brand & Creative Team. You’ll work across brand, culture, and product—helping translate Suno’s creative vision into expressive, high-impact design across platforms and formats.

This role plays a key part in evolving Suno’s brand across marketing campaigns, artist partnerships, in-product brand moments, and culture-defining activations. You’ll help shape how Suno shows up visually at moments that matter—from product launches and campaigns to artist collaborations and creative brand expressions.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with creative leadership, designers, writers, motion artists, project managers, product designers, and cross-functional teams to concept, design, and execute work that evolves Suno’s brand.

This role is ideal for a designer who delivers innovative, standout work with precision—evolving the brand through bold ideas that are executed confidently and consistently within Suno’s creative direction.

Check out the Suno version of this role here! https://suno.com/s/p71hcfuWMLRPqgt8

What You’ll Do

  • Design and execute multidisciplinary creative work that evolves Suno’s brand across campaigns, artist partnerships, in-product moments, and brand activations.

  • Create innovative, high-impact design while maintaining precision and consistency within Suno’s creative direction and brand guidelines.

  • Support artist collaborations and partnerships, developing visuals and assets that authentically reflect both the artist’s voice and Suno’s identity.

  • Contribute to product launches and in-product brand moments, partnering with the Design Director and cross-functional teams (product design, GTM, Growth) to ensure a cohesive visual experience.

  • Translate ideas into polished, production-ready assets across digital, social, print, and motion formats.

  • Iterate quickly and thoughtfully in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, embracing feedback to evolve ideas and elevate the work.

  • Design with a global audience and end-to-end user experience in mind.

  • Maintain a high bar for craft and attention to detail across every execution.

  • Collaborate closely with designers, writers, motion artists, and cross-functional partners to bring great work to life.

  • Use AI and emerging creative tools as a core part of the creative and systems workflow, bringing hands-on experience with AI tooling to develop new creative approaches, accelerate production and build scalable, repeatable systems.

What You’ll Need

  • 8+ years of experience as a graphic designer working across multiple disciplines (brand, marketing, digital, social, campaigns, content, etc.).

  • A strong portfolio showcasing innovative thinking and executional excellence across a range of formats and platforms.

  • A multidisciplinary designer. You have experience working across brand, marketing, campaigns, content, and digital surfaces, and you adapt your craft fluidly across formats. Motion experience is a strong bonus.

  • Craft-obsessed. You can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom all the way in to the smallest details—from typography and layout to motion, spacing, and final polish. You know great work is built through care, precision, and attention to detail.

  • Collaborative to your core. You love working closely with designers, motion artists, writers, product teams, and partners—embracing feedback and shaping ideas together to create work that’s both inspiring and practical.

  • A proactive builder. You thrive in ambiguity, spot opportunities early, and bring structure to creative chaos—proposing ideas, improving systems, and pushing work forward.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment. You can juggle multiple projects, iterate quickly and thoughtfully, and maintain a high bar for quality under changing timelines.

  • Brand-forward and user-aware. You think globally, care about the end-to-end user experience, and design with both consistency and cultural relevance in mind.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma; motion design skills (After Effects, animated prototypes, etc.) are a strong bonus.

  • Passionate about music and culture. You’re excited by artists, creative expression, and emerging technology—and motivated by shaping how people experience music.

  • Fluent in AI tooling and systems. You understand how to integrate emerging AI tools into design and system workflows, using them to expand creative possibilities, accelerate production and build repeatable systems.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in-person role working at our NYC offices.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $150-175K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

Suno is hiring two Senior Engineering Managers to help lead our Product Engineering organization as we build the applications that unlock creative fulfillment for over 100 million creators. Each Senior EM will own a pillar of the product, manage a group of Engineering Managers, and partner closely with product, design, and data science to set direction and ship experiences people love. These are hands-on leadership roles for people who want to shape both the technical roadmap and the managers who execute it, in a fast-paced, music-obsessed environment.

You'll bring together a group of engineering teams under a shared roadmap, set the technical bar across that group, and grow the managers and engineers who report to you. You'll work closely with the other Senior Engineering Managers and with senior product, design, and data science partners to make sure your teams' work connects to Suno's broader strategy.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/c3oBVSyd2ywwKIcc

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical direction across your pillar, setting architecture strategy and ensuring scalable, high-quality systems that serve millions of creators

  • Manage and coach a group of Engineering Managers — setting a hiring bar, running effective performance cycles, and building a culture where teams do their best work

  • Partner with senior product, design, and data science leaders to define multi-team roadmaps, sequence bets, and ship features that move the needle

  • Navigate the full development lifecycle from ideation through launch across multiple teams simultaneously, managing tradeoffs and removing blockers at the organizational level

  • Champion engineering craft across your pillar — code quality, robust testing, and the right balance of rapid iteration with long-term maintainability

  • Represent your pillar in cross-functional planning and leadership discussions, connecting day-to-day execution to Suno's broader strategy

  • Contribute to Suno's mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by delivering the tools and platform that turn imagination into music

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We have a large and growing user base, with an opportunity to deepen our understanding of what drives conversion, willingness to pay, and long-term subscription value.

We’re looking for a Senior Mixed Methods UX Researcher in New York to lead this work. This is a quantitatively oriented role focused on using rigorous research and measurement to shape product and growth decisions, complemented by qualitative research when deeper user insight is needed.

You’ll partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders across growth, monetization, and subscriptions, helping inform fast-moving decisions around pricing, packaging, and conversion.

This role adds deep research expertise to the team. You’ll set a high bar for methodological rigor, clarify what the research can reliably answer, and guide stakeholders toward well-supported decisions.

Listen to the song we made about this role! https://suno.com/s/xVPN3bUuZ4xbO8M9

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end research that informs product, growth, and monetization decisions.

  • Use a range of research methods to understand customer needs, behaviors, and preferences.

  • Partner closely with product, design, data, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Build scalable approaches for measuring customer sentiment and product performance over time.

  • Clearly communicate what the research shows, what it does not show, and what the team should consider next.

Who You Are

  • You have experience leading quantitative or mixed-methods research for consumer products or services.

  • You can select practical, rigorous research methods based on the question and business context.

  • You are comfortable working with surveys, experiments, behavioral data, or related forms of customer insight.

  • You communicate clearly and can help cross-functional partners turn research into decisions.

  • You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable working through ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.

Additional Notes

  • You must be authorized to work in the United States

  • You must be willing to work 5 days per week at our New York City office

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is: $176K – $220K (before equity)

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

The Commerce Platform is one of the most consequential systems at Suno - it's where every product decision about value becomes real. We're looking for a detail-obsessed engineer to own our commerce platform end-to-end: the billing, subscription, payment, and metering services that power how Suno makes money, and the surrounding systems that keep it correct - entitlements, involuntary churn recovery, fraud prevention, and accounting. You'll set the technical direction, be a key voice in how we think about the future of our revenue model, and build infrastructure that has to be exactly right at scale.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/xPykr78gYvHQLhZn

What You'll Do

  • Own Suno's commerce platform across web and mobile, including our vendor integrations and the core billing, subscription, payment, and metering services.

  • Build and evolve subscription and entitlement management - the source of truth for what every user has paid for and what they get access to.

  • Own payment methods and payment processing, expanding how users around the world can pay for Suno.

  • Recover revenue that would otherwise be lost: own involuntary churn (failed payments, dunning, recovery flows) and fraud prevention.

  • Build the financial correctness layer - accounting and reconciliation systems where the money has to be exactly right.

  • Lead the evolution of our billing architecture - including an in-progress migration to a modern ledger-based model - making it more maintainable and easier to reason about as the business grows.

  • Participate in product and strategy discussions about how Suno monetizes, bringing technical judgment to decisions that have direct revenue impact.

  • Build tools, systems, and interfaces that give the broader team more leverage to build products and perform analyses.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally building systems where being wrong has immediate real-world consequences - payments, financial infrastructure, distributed systems, or similar.

  • A natural instinct to think about failure modes first: what happens if this event arrives twice, out of order, or not at all?

  • Strong product sense alongside technical depth - you care about what users experience, not just what the code does.

  • A high bar for correctness that you hold yourself and others to without being told.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Experience with Stripe, RevenueCat, or payments/fraud systems is a plus.

  • A love for music is a huge plus.

Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Location: This is an onsite role in our NYC or Cambridge, MA office.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $220K – $280K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Community Manager to be the voice of Suno across our social platforms and the daily connective tissue between our fans, creators, and brand. This is a full time role reporting to the Director of Social Media, and it sits at the heart of how Suno shows up in culture—shaping the tone, energy, and relationships that turn casual listeners into passionate advocates.

In this role, you’ll live inside our comments, DMs, replies, and community spaces—engaging with Suno’s audience in a way that feels human, witty, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll partner closely with the social, brand, and content teams to surface cultural moments, amplify creators, and translate community signal into insight that shapes how we talk and what we make. You’ll help build a community that feels alive, inclusive, and creatively inspired.

This is a role for someone who genuinely loves the internet—who can spot a meme before it peaks, write a reply that earns a screenshot, and spark conversations that make people feel seen. You understand the rhythm of platforms like TikTok, Instagram, X, and Reddit, and you move with the speed and fluency that real-time community work demands. You’re equally comfortable celebrating a creator’s moment, defusing a tense thread, and turning a random comment into a reason for a thousand more.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/D0jCWAkn2JR4Kzik

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day community engagement across Suno’s social channels (TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms), responding to comments, DMs, and mentions in a voice that is distinctly Suno.

  • Build genuine relationships with Suno creators and superfans—celebrating their work, surfacing their songs, and helping them feel recognized as part of the Suno story.

  • Spot cultural moments, memes, and trends in real time and partner with the social team to jump on them quickly with on-brand, high-quality responses.

  • Moderate community spaces (Discord, Reddit, comments sections) with care and good judgment—keeping conversations healthy, welcoming, and aligned with our community guidelines.

  • Act as the first line of listening for the brand—tracking sentiment, surfacing emerging themes, and escalating issues, bugs, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate teams.

  • Drive a proactive social listening practice—monitoring conversations across owned channels, broader social platforms, and creator communities to identify recurring themes, sentiment shifts, white-space opportunities, and early signals of issues.

  • Translate those themes into clear, prioritized actions: content ideas for the social team, talking points for brand and PR, product feedback for the Suno team, creator outreach opportunities, and adjustments to community strategy. Share these insights through regular readouts so listening consistently turns into decisions and meaningful follow-through.

  • Partner with the Director of Social Media to shape community strategy, contribute to content ideas, and help plan engagement around launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Support, and Trust & Safety to ensure community feedback informs how we build, communicate, and respond.

  • Develop lightweight community rituals—weekly highlights, creator spotlights, AMAs, and other recurring programs that give fans something to show up for.

  • Maintain playbooks and documentation for response guidelines, escalation paths, tone of voice, and community best practices.

  • Report on community health and engagement—tracking qualitative and quantitative signals that help the team understand what’s resonating and where to invest next.

  • Champion the Suno community internally, ensuring creators and fans are represented in the decisions we make.

What You’ll Need

  • 2+ years of community management or social media experience, ideally at a consumer tech company, music or entertainment brand, creator platform, or culture-forward agency.

  • A strong, distinctive writing voice—you can match a brand’s tone while still sounding like a real person, and you know when to be playful, warm, hype, or measured.

  • Deep fluency in internet and platform culture—TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit each have their own norms, and you understand them intuitively.

  • A love of music and creativity—you get why Suno matters to people and are excited to build community around the act of making something.

  • Excellent judgment and emotional intelligence, especially in sensitive, ambiguous, or high-visibility moments; you know when to engage, when to listen, and when to escalate.

  • Experience moderating online communities and navigating feedback, criticism, and the occasional troll with grace and confidence.

  • Comfort with the pace of real-time work—you can move quickly without sacrificing quality, and you’re energized (not overwhelmed) by a full inbox and a lit-up mentions tab.

  • Familiarity with community and social tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Khoros, Discord admin tools, native platform analytics) and a willingness to learn new ones.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach—you partner well with designers, writers, producers, and cross-functional teammates, and you’re excited to build something together.

  • Bonus: personal experience as a creator, musician, or active participant in online communities.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in person role working at our NYC office.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Social Media Community Manager to be the voice of Suno across our social platforms and the daily connective tissue between our fans, creators, and brand. This is a full time role reporting to the Director of Social Media, and it sits at the heart of how Suno shows up in culture—shaping the tone, energy, and relationships that turn casual listeners into passionate advocates. In this role, you’ll live inside our comments, DMs, replies, and community spaces—engaging with Suno’s audience in a way that feels human, witty, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll partner closely with the social, brand, and content teams to surface cultural moments, amplify creators, and translate community signal into insight that shapes how we talk and what we make. You’ll help build a community that feels alive, inclusive, and creatively inspired. This is a role for someone who genuinely loves the internet—who can spot a meme before it peaks, write a reply that earns a screenshot, and spark conversations that make people feel seen. You understand the rhythm of platforms like TikTok, Instagram, X, and Reddit, and you move with the speed and fluency that real-time community work demands. You’re equally comfortable celebrating a creator’s moment, defusing a tense thread, and turning a random comment into a reason for a thousand more. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/D0jCWAkn2JR4Kzik WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own day-to-day community engagement across Suno’s social channels (TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms), responding to comments, DMs, and mentions in a voice that is distinctly Suno. - Build genuine relationships with Suno creators and superfans—celebrating their work, surfacing their songs, and helping them feel recognized as part of the Suno story. - Spot cultural moments, memes, and trends in real time and partner with the social team to jump on them quickly with on-brand, high-quality responses. - Moderate community spaces (Discord, Reddit, comments sections) with care and good judgment—keeping conversations healthy, welcoming, and aligned with our community guidelines. - Act as the first line of listening for the brand—tracking sentiment, surfacing emerging themes, and escalating issues, bugs, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate teams. - Drive a proactive social listening practice—monitoring conversations across owned channels, broader social platforms, and creator communities to identify recurring themes, sentiment shifts, white-space opportunities, and early signals of issues. - Translate those themes into clear, prioritized actions: content ideas for the social team, talking points for brand and PR, product feedback for the Suno team, creator outreach opportunities, and adjustments to community strategy. Share these insights through regular readouts so listening consistently turns into decisions and meaningful follow-through. - Partner with the Director of Social Media to shape community strategy, contribute to content ideas, and help plan engagement around launches, campaigns, and cultural moments. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Support, and Trust & Safety to ensure community feedback informs how we build, communicate, and respond. - Develop lightweight community rituals—weekly highlights, creator spotlights, AMAs, and other recurring programs that give fans something to show up for. - Maintain playbooks and documentation for response guidelines, escalation paths, tone of voice, and community best practices. - Report on community health and engagement—tracking qualitative and quantitative signals that help the team understand what’s resonating and where to invest next. - Champion the Suno community internally, ensuring creators and fans are represented in the decisions we make. WHAT YOU’LL NEED - 2+ years of community management or social media experience, ideally at a consumer tech company, music or entertainment brand, creator platform, or culture-forward agency. - A strong, distinctive writing voice—you can match a brand’s tone while still sounding like a real person, and you know when to be playful, warm, hype, or measured. - Deep fluency in internet and platform culture—TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit each have their own norms, and you understand them intuitively. - A love of music and creativity—you get why Suno matters to people and are excited to build community around the act of making something. - Excellent judgment and emotional intelligence, especially in sensitive, ambiguous, or high-visibility moments; you know when to engage, when to listen, and when to escalate. - Experience moderating online communities and navigating feedback, criticism, and the occasional troll with grace and confidence. - Comfort with the pace of real-time work—you can move quickly without sacrificing quality, and you’re energized (not overwhelmed) by a full inbox and a lit-up mentions tab. - Familiarity with community and social tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Khoros, Discord admin tools, native platform analytics) and a willingness to learn new ones. - A collaborative, low-ego approach—you partner well with designers, writers, producers, and cross-functional teammates, and you’re excited to build something together. - Bonus: personal experience as a creator, musician, or active participant in online communities. Additional Notes: - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. - This is an in person role working at our NYC office. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Growth Engineering at Suno owns the path from "someone hears about Suno" to "someone who creates music, comes back, and subscribes." That includes onboarding, paywalls and pricing, credits and billing, lifecycle messaging, logged-out surfaces and SEO, and the attribution and experimentation systems underneath all of it. Millions of people hit these surfaces every day.

You'll work on a team of web, iOS, and Android engineers. The team runs on experiments: you'll form a hypothesis, ship the test, read the result, and either scale it or retire it. Most projects have a small lean team on them.

We're a small team inside a company that is still moving fast. You'll have a say in what gets prioritized, and work directly with PMs, designers, data scientists, and marketers to deliver results for Suno.

Check out our Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/fgke9OYJlf54RMKs

What You’ll Do

  • Own user growth or revenue projects end-to-end: from identifying opportunities through shipping and measuring results.

  • Partner closely with product, marketing, and design to translate their goals into a prioritized plan, ship fast, and measure impact with data.

  • Build and iterate across the full stack: frontend, backend, and data analysis.

  • Design and run experiments, working with product and data science on instrumentation, measurement, and result interpretation.

  • Create scalable and performant infrastructure that support growth campaigns and initiatives.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

  • Experience shipping full-stack web features to production.

  • History of owning outcomes rather than tickets: projects where you chose what to build, shipped it, and can say what happened to the metric afterward.

  • Comfort with data: asking critical questions about data, running queries on it, isolating signal from noise, and reading out results

  • A bias toward shipping fast without sacrificing code quality or user experience, and the judgment to decide when to optimize for what.

  • Genuine interest in music, and in the people making it with Suno.

Nice to have

  • Experience in at least one of our core areas: consumer growth and experimentation, subscriptions and monetization, or marketing engineering (SEO/AEO, CRO, CMS, attribution, lifecycle/CRM).

  • Cross-platform experience shipping features on web and mobile.

Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. 

Location: This is an onsite role in our Chelsea, NYC office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
