jobs.title: Full Stack Staff & Software Engineer, Consumer Monetization
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Consumer Monetization builds the experiences and systems that power how customers purchase and pay for OpenAI products. Our scope spans purchasing flows, payments, subscriptions, and billing, along with the shared capabilities that support new products, offers, and distribution channels.

We own both customer-facing experiences and the underlying platforms that power them. We partner closely with Product, Design, Growth, Data Science, and engineering teams across OpenAI to make purchasing effective and reliable, and new offerings easier to launch and monetize.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced Staff+ full-stack engineers to shape purchasing experiences and monetization capabilities across OpenAI products.

You’ll work across web experiences, product APIs, and shared components, combining strong product judgment with technical depth. The work ranges from improving checkout conversion and performance to enabling new pricing models, offers, and ways for customers to purchase our products.

You’ll help identify opportunities, turn ambiguous goals into concrete technical plans, and lead initiatives from exploration through launch. As patterns emerge across products, you’ll develop reusable capabilities that make future launches faster and more consistent.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with substantial ownership over architecture, implementation, and product outcomes.

This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and build purchasing experiences end to end, from frontend interactions through the product APIs and backend integrations that support them.

  • Improve checkout conversion, performance, and reliability through experimentation, product analytics, and customer insights.

  • Develop shared checkout components and monetization capabilities that support new products, pricing models, offers, and distribution channels.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Growth, and Data Science to identify opportunities, define experiments, and evaluate results.

  • Lead initiatives from early exploration and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.

  • Shape frontend and product API architecture, balancing immediate delivery with maintainability and reuse across products.

  • Work across engineering teams and business functions to turn complex requirements into simple, effective customer experiences.

  • Provide technical leadership through hands-on development, design reviews, and mentorship.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have demonstrated technical ownership at Staff level or beyond, shaping architecture and delivering substantial initiatives across teams.

  • Have strong experience building sophisticated web applications and the backend APIs that power them.

  • Have repeatedly taken customer-facing products from ambiguous ideas through production and ongoing iteration.

  • Understand how frontend performance, latency, interaction design, and API architecture affect customer experience and business outcomes.

  • Combine strong product instincts with experience using experimentation and A/B testing to decide what to build and measure its impact.

  • Make pragmatic tradeoffs between shipping quickly and investing in reliable, reusable systems.

  • Communicate clearly across functions and can move work forward without a fully defined roadmap.

  • Enjoy hands-on engineering while helping other engineers develop their judgment and take on broader ownership.

Experience in e-commerce, growth, checkout, subscriptions, offers, or monetization is particularly valuable. Direct payments experience is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, ChatGPT Education  & Learning
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The ChatGPT Learning team focuses on building the next generation of learning experiences inside ChatGPT. Learning is already one of the largest consumer use cases on the platform, with millions of people each week using ChatGPT to understand concepts, practice skills, and get unstuck while learning.

Our goal is to evolve ChatGPT from a place people go for one-off answers into a platform that helps people learn, grow, and make progress over time. We are exploring how AI can expand access to powerful learning tools for people everywhere—helping individuals better understand the world, build new skills, and pursue their goals.

This team sits at the intersection of product engineering, design, AI research, and education, working to bring powerful learning experiences to a global audience.


About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer on the ChatGPT Learning team, you will help design and build new product experiences that enable millions of people to learn with ChatGPT.

You’ll work across the stack—from user-facing interfaces to backend services—to ship product features that make learning more intuitive, engaging, and effective. You’ll collaborate closely with researchers and platform teams to bring cutting-edge model capabilities into real-world products, helping translate advances in AI into experiences that people can use every day.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy building polished product experiences, operating with high ownership, and solving ambiguous problems that sit at the intersection of AI research and consumer software.

This role is based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

What You’ll Do

  • Build end-to-end product experiences that help people learn with ChatGPT.

  • Design and implement new multimodal capabilities that bring text, images, voice, and interactive interfaces into learning workflows.

  • Develop scalable backend services and APIs that power learning features across ChatGPT.

  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and other engineers to prototype and ship new ideas quickly.

  • Improve performance, reliability, and usability of learning experiences across ChatGPT surfaces.

  • Iterate on features using experimentation and user feedback to continuously improve the learning experience.

You Might Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy building high-quality consumer product experiences across the full stack.

  • Are comfortable owning features from concept to production.

  • Have experience working with modern web technologies such as React, TypeScript, and backend services in Python, Node.js, or similar.

  • Like tackling ambiguous problems and shaping them into clear product solutions.

  • Care about building products that have meaningful real-world impact at global scale.

  • Experience building interactive educational tools or learning products.

  • Strong product engineering instincts and a high bar for UX quality.

  • Experience with AI-powered applications or LLM-based systems.

  • Interest in improving access to education and expanding opportunities for learners worldwide.

jobs.description_html:
Overview:
The Data Acquisition team within the Foundations organization at OpenAI is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. Our team manages web crawling and GPTBot services and works closely with Data Processing, Architecture, and Scaling teams. We are looking for a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to join our Data Acquisition team to build and optimize the interfaces and tools that power our data infrastructure.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Child Safety Tools & Systems
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Intelligence & Investigations Engineering team builds systems that detect, analyze, and disrupt abuse across OpenAI’s products. We partner closely with the Child Safety team and cross-functional groups to protect users while advancing OpenAI’s goal of developing AI that benefits everyone.

About the Role

As a Fullstack Engineer focused on child safety, you’ll build data-intensive, AI-powered applications and infrastructure that enable operators and investigators to work effectively and responsibly. You’ll adapt quickly in ambiguous, fast-moving environments to deliver well-crafted, reliable tooling for high-severity safety work.

*Candidates should understand this role involves exposure to sensitive and egregious content.


In this role, you will:

  • 7+ years of experience as a software engineer

  • Prototype, build, and maintain intelligence systems that detect, triage, and enable efficient human review of possible high severity harm

  • Work hand in hand with operators and investigators, designing and delivering systems that enable them to do their work faster, more accurately, and more safely.

  • Develop across the stack: UIs, services, pipelines, and anything else required to solve the problems we face.

  • Interact with partners across Product Policy, Platform Integrity, Safety Systems, and Research

  • Contribute to the team’s technical strategy, especially for child safety related tools and systems

  • Report on impact in a data-driven fashion

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation and enjoy owning systems end-to-end—from infrastructure and data ingestion to frontend tooling

  • Are energized by working at the frontier of AI capabilities, integrating new models and APIs into practical systems

  • Have experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines or search/retrieval systems

  • Are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, and familiar with tools like Spark, Kafka, Flink, data warehouses, and SQL

  • Take a product-minded approach, design with user workflows in mind, and iterate quickly based on feedback

  • Favor pragmatic solutions and can ship in hacky, low-support environments when needed

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and open-ended problem spaces with evolving goals

  • Have prior experience working on engineering for high-severity harms

  • Bring intuition for the pain points and workflows of operations and investigative teams, and curiosity about solving complex investigations

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Emerging Products
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Emerging Products team is a lean, high-output product lab group that builds products at the forefront of model capabilities. We collaborate across all teams within the company, from research and infrastructure to consumer products.

The team is responsible for identifying new product opportunities, building them quickly, dogfooding them internally, and then launching the successful products to users. We use data, user research, and analytics to inform our ideas, and make decisions on what experiments are worth iterating, stopping, or scaling.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior, product-minded software engineer to own ambiguous 0-to-1 work from idea through prototype, validation, and handoff. This is a full-stack role with a strong frontend and product emphasis: you will build the interfaces and supporting backend systems needed to test new experiences quickly, while making sound architectural choices that enable successful concepts to scale. This role is based in our Mission Bay office in San Francisco.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and ship high-quality, product experiments across the full stack.

  • Turn ambiguous user needs and emerging technical capabilities into testable product concepts, using research and metrics to guide iteration.

  • Own technical direction for 0-to-1 projects, balancing speed, reliability, and a clear path from prototype to scalable product.

  • Partner closely with design, product, research, and engineering teams to dogfood, evaluate, launch, and transition successful experiments.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a track record of building and shipping end-to-end products in fast-moving, startup, founder-led, growth, or other high-ownership environments.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Intelligence & Investigations
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Intelligence & Investigations team helps OpenAI understand and respond to the risks that can accompany increasingly capable AI. Our work has two central responsibilities: investigating potential high-severity misuse or harm involving our models, and monitoring and characterizing risks to OpenAI, our users, and the broader world. We bring together analysts, investigators, engineers, and other subject matter experts to turn complex signals into a clearer picture of what matters and support informed action.

About the Role

As an engineer on Intelligence & Investigations Engineering, you will build the systems that support both sides of this mission: giving OpenAI’s leadership superhuman situational awareness of important risks and developments, and accelerating expert investigators and analysts as they assess potential high-severity misuse or harm.

You will design, prototype, ship, and maintain end-to-end products that use OpenAI’s models and infrastructure to make sense of large, complex information environments. These systems will surface meaningful signals, synthesize important developments, and help people make well-informed decisions when the stakes are high.

You will work directly with analysts, investigators, and other subject matter experts to understand their needs and build products that make their work faster, more effective, and more scalable. Your engineering work will be central to how the team investigates potential misuse, develops situational awareness, and informs decisions.

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong technical and analytical skills with product judgment and the ability to move between rapid prototyping and reliable production systems. You should be comfortable working with ambiguous problems, complex data, and evolving AI capabilities—and excited to build tools that expand what human experts can understand and accomplish.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • 7+ years of experience as a software engineer

  • Build intelligence systems that monitor and characterize emerging risks, synthesize internal and external signals, and give OpenAI leadership a timely, decision-ready view of what matters

  • Develop investigative tools that help analysts, investigators, and subject matter experts assess potential high-severity misuse or harm with greater speed, depth, and consistency

  • Own technical solutions end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping new capabilities to deploying, maintaining, and improving production systems

  • Apply OpenAI’s models to research and investigative workflows, including lead generation, triage, synthesis, and analysis across large, complex datasets

  • Design effective interfaces and workflows that help expert users explore evidence, follow leads, and make well-informed decisions

  • Shape the team’s technical and product direction as model capabilities, risk landscapes, and investigative needs evolve

  • Collaborate closely with analysts and investigators, as well as partners across Applied, Safety Systems, Research, User Operations, and Strategy

You might thrive in this role if you have / are:

  • 4+ years of experience as a software engineer

  • Experience designing, building, and operating production software, ideally for intelligence, investigations, security, research, or other complex analytical workflows.

  • A track record of owning products or systems end to end and translating ambiguous, high-stakes problems into useful tools.

  • Strong programming and data skills, including experience working with Python, SQL, and large or unstructured datasets.

  • Sound product and technical judgment, with the ability to partner closely with expert users and work effectively across functions.

  • Excitement about using increasingly capable AI systems to expand human situational awareness and accelerate expert investigation.

jobs.title: GPT Infrastructure Lead
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Industrial Compute team is responsible for building and scaling large-scale compute capacity across first-party data centers, strategic partners, and industrial infrastructure environments. We focus on converting power, land, hardware, and operational execution into reliable compute capacity that can support frontier AI training and inference workloads.

This team operates at the intersection of infrastructure delivery, hardware systems, utilities, supply chain, and capacity strategy—ensuring OpenAI can scale compute faster than traditional models allow.

About the Role

We are seeking a GPT Infrastructure Lead to drive the end-to-end conversion of industrial-scale infrastructure investments into usable token capacity for OpenAI workloads.

In this role, you will own execution across complex compute programs where raw infrastructure capacity must be transformed into operational GPU throughput. You will coordinate across data center delivery, power, networking, hardware deployment, workload enablement, finance, and external partners to ensure capacity becomes productive tokens as quickly and efficiently as possible.

This role is ideal for someone who can bridge physical infrastructure delivery with compute utilization outcomes. Success requires strong systems thinking, elite program leadership, and the ability to drive accountability across internal teams and strategic partners.

In this role, you will

  • Lead GPT Infrastructure programs across industrial compute environments, including first-party and partner-owned capacity.

  • Convert delivered power, space, and hardware capacity into production-ready token throughput.

  • Build integrated execution plans spanning construction, power energization, rack deployment, networking, cluster readiness, and workload onboarding.

  • Partner with infrastructure engineering, hardware, networking, finance, supply chain, and operations teams.

  • Drive external providers, EPCs, OEMs, utilities, and strategic partners toward aggressive timelines.

  • Identify bottlenecks between physical delivery and usable compute output, then lead resolution.

  • Build operating cadences, dashboards, forecasts, and executive reporting for TaaS programs.

  • Develop repeatable deployment models for future industrial compute expansion.

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Have led hyperscale infrastructure, data center, manufacturing, or industrial deployment programs.

  • Understand how power + hardware + networking + software combine into usable compute.

  • Can operate equally well with engineers, operators, executives, and external partners.

  • Are highly structured in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Know how to escalate intelligently and maintain momentum under pressure.

  • Can translate technical execution into business outcomes.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with GPU clusters, AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, or industrial technology programs.

  • Background in program management, operations leadership, capacity delivery, or strategic infrastructure execution.

  • Familiarity with utilities, construction, commissioning, networking, hardware deployment, or cluster bring-up.

jobs.title: GRC Program Manager, Audit & Controls
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance team helps ensure security and privacy are grounded in how our products and systems actually operate. Assurance Operations partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Privacy, and Legal to make controls provable, risk decisions explicit, and audit readiness a result of well-designed systems.

About the Role

We are hiring a technical, product-minded GRC builder who can own consequential audits while improving the control and evidence systems behind them. You will build a reusable common control framework, use Codex to automate assurance work, validate changing system scope, and turn repeated audit friction into measurable improvements. We are looking for someone who questions inherited assumptions, solves novel problems creatively, works closely with engineers, and makes the next audit easier by improving the underlying system.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Lead external, internal, customer, and certification audit work from scoping through evidence review, fieldwork, remediation, and closeout.

  • Build a common control framework linking risk, control intent, implementation, owner, system, environment, evidence, and applicable frameworks.

  • Validate actual scope and ownership instead of assuming last year's controls, product boundaries, or evidence remain accurate.

  • Use Codex to build and test evidence checks, control mappings, request triage, owner workflows, monitoring, and remediation reporting.

  • Partner with engineers on cloud architecture, identity, logging, data flows, software changes, vulnerabilities, and control effectiveness.

  • Design maintainable, permission-aware tools that preserve source provenance, human review, and evidence integrity.

  • Reduce repeated requests and operational burden for control owners through measurable workflow improvements.

  • Define roadmaps, decision rights, milestones, success metrics, and clear cross-functional escalations.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Direct ownership of meaningful audit, security, customer-assurance, or regulatory outcomes.

  • Practical knowledge of control design, evidence, testing, operating effectiveness, and remediation.

  • Technical fluency across cloud systems, identity, logging, APIs, data flows, and system boundaries.

  • Ability to use Codex or comparable AI-assisted development tools to build, run, inspect, and test a working solution.

  • Experience using code, SQL, APIs, structured data, automation, or data workflows to solve an operational problem.

  • Ability to design reusable cross-framework controls without erasing framework-specific test and evidence requirements.

  • First-principles curiosity, creative problem solving, intellectual humility, and the ability to update when facts change.

  • Product and program judgment: define the user, scope, milestones, ownership, adoption, and measurable outcome.

  • Clear, constructive partnership with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Privacy, Legal, and audit teams.

  • Frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017, PCI DSS, NIST, or FedRAMP are helpful; a specific degree, certification, or prior access to internal OpenAI tools is not required.

jobs.title: GRC Technical Program Manager, Product Lifecycle Assurance
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is foundational to Security delivering mission outcomes at OpenAI. The GRC team provides security assurances and builds compliance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but operational in how we do our work, and we partner deeply with Product, Security, Legal, Privacy, GTM, and Field Security to help OpenAI move quickly while maintaining trust with customers, auditors, regulators, and the public.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Product Lifecycle Assurance IC to help scale OpenAI’s GRC function across our product stack to ensure products address customer and regulatory compliance requirements at launch and regressions are detected promptly and corrected.

You will partner closely with Product, Security, Legal, and Privacy teams to make sure OpenAI can move quickly while maintaining our security, privacy and compliance claims and giving customers, auditors, and regulators assurance about how OpenAI handles user data. You are responsible for product assurance end-to-end from inception to post-launch (continuous) monitoring. You leverage existing workflows, reviews, and data and enhance, augment and build the components needed to create an end-to-end product assurance program.

This role is not about supporting SOC or ISO audits; it's a highly cross-functional and deeply technical operations role to ensure that OAI products meet the compliance bar at launch, regressions are prevented and detected, and our compliance state can be evidenced. This role also helps ensure that our product launch governance program operates effectively across key safety, privacy, legal and security stakeholders and lessons-learned from incidents and regressions are used to improve the program.

You or in partnership with engineering teams, build key controls in our infrastructure stack, developer workflows and launch tooling to provide developers with guardrails, perform CI/CD conformance checks, and surface launches that need GRC guidance. You ensure that teams have the information needed to design and launch safety and meet them where they are. You exercise sound judgement in making high-stakes decisions related to product launch risk and controls.

You are comfortable working in high velocity, low friction development environments. Your work goes across team boundaries and you assist and enable other teams to realize product assurance objectives. You should be comfortable with complex (Kubernetes) system architectures and dataflows, working with engineering teams to understand what could go wrong and where and how controls should be applied. You should be comfortable working with Privacy engineering and Data Science to understand data maps and database schemas and leverage existing processes and controls to further product assurance goals.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Strong technical product lifecycle assurance and security and privacy compliance experience working in high velocity, low friction development environments.

  • Experience building technical controls, metrics, monitoring tools, CI/CD tooling, high-fidelity risk signals and dashboards to meet product assurance goals

  • Ability to run an end-to-end, cross-functional, product assurance program applying judgement where what type of process or controls should be in place to meet a high assurance bar

  • Capacity to shift product assurance to the left in the product development cycle with just-in-time controls, guidance, guardrails and responsible friction for developers

  • Low ego outcome oriented mindset to achieve the product assurance goal required for OAI’s mission

  • Strong technical cross-functional leadership and don’t work in a vacuum - they influence, align and direct partner teams to achieve product assurance goals.

  • Exercise sound judgement in making high-stakes decisions related to product launch risk and controls.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • The end-to-end effective operation of OAI’s product assurance program from product development to post-launch (continuous) monitoring

  • Owning the GRC product assurance program, providing governance over Safety, Deployment, Security, Legal reviews to ensure we effectively surface product risk and design scalable mitigations

  • Driving cross-function collaboration and accountability in all aspects of the product assurance program

  • Building controls and low-friction, scalable processes in our infrastructure stack, developer workflows and launch tooling to ensure effective product assurance

  • Ensuring that teams have the guidance needed to design and launch safety and meet them where they are

  • Ensuring compliance, security and privacy claims and maps to verifiable controls

  • Recognizing how the product lifecycle assurance program fits into the large organizational objectives and when to build and when to influence and maintain strong partnerships with partner teams and influence roadmaps to further assurance goals

  • Applying sound judgement in launch reviews, technical assurance trade-off and management of OAI risk posture to guide product and engineering teams on the highest priorities

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor to lead GTM Strategy & Operations for Security & Safety, in close partnership with the Policy team. This role will help translate policy, security, and safety considerations into clear GTM strategies, operating models, launch plans, and scalable execution mechanisms.

You’ll work across Product, Policy, Safety, Security, Legal, Data, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to understand customer and field needs, shape business recommendations, and support the successful adoption of security- and safety-critical products and capabilities.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong strategic and operational judgment with the ability to work effectively on complex policy-adjacent topics. You’ll help ensure that GTM plans reflect relevant policy requirements and that recurring customer and field insights inform future policy and product decisions.

In this role, you will:

  • Define the GTM operating model for the Security & Safety program, including ownership, decision forums, planning cadences, and escalation paths.

  • Partner with Policy, Product, Security, Safety, Legal, and Data to translate policy considerations into actionable GTM guidance and operating processes.

  • Develop go-to-market strategy for cybersecurity models, including target customers, use cases, commercialization approach, launch readiness, success metrics, and field enablement.

  • Build mechanisms to capture recurring customer and field needs related to security, safety, application security, and policy implementation.

  • Translate customer feedback and field requirements into recommendations for product roadmaps, policy development, enablement, and operational priorities.

  • Support the operationalization of data-retention policies and related customer or deployment requirements across GTM.

  • Track customer demand, implementation blockers, and market signals to refine GTM strategy and inform Policy and Product partners.

  • Establish operating rhythms that improve coordination across GTM and partner functions.

  • Prepare concise analyses, recommendations, and materials for senior stakeholders and executive decision-making.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations, Professional Services
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI's Professional Services team helps organizations move from AI ambition to durable production outcomes. We partner with customers on complex deployments and build the strategy, commercial models, operating mechanisms, and delivery capacity needed to realize value from OpenAI's models and products.

The team works across Go-to-Market, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Success, Finance, Product, Legal, Data, Systems, and delivery partners. We are building a services motion that is customer-centered, commercially rigorous, operationally scalable, and deliberately connected to product adoption.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior GTM Strategy & Operations professional to build and scale the operating system for OpenAI's Professional Services business. This is a foundational, hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of business strategy, finance, go-to-market, and delivery. You will turn ambiguous questions—what we offer, how we price and package it, how we plan capacity, and how we measure performance—into clear decisions and repeatable mechanisms.

You will own business planning, pricing and packaging, forecasting and modeling, management reporting, and cross-functional strategic initiatives. You will build integrated views of demand, staffing, revenue, margin, and delivery performance; replace one-off analyses with durable processes; and create operating cadences that help leaders act early.

You will be a trusted partner to Professional Services, GTM, FDE, Technical Success, Finance, Product, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Data leaders. The right person combines direct Professional Services judgment with rigorous analytics, executive communication, and the willingness to build the model, process, or dashboard themselves.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Define and drive the business and GTM strategy for Professional Services, including target customer needs, offer portfolio, positioning, pricing and packaging, partner motions, and where to standardize versus tailor delivery.

  • Own long-range, annual, and quarterly planning for the services business, translating goals into bookings, revenue, margin, capacity, utilization, role mix, geography, hiring, and investment assumptions.

  • Build and maintain integrated demand, capacity, staffing, and revenue models; develop scenarios and sensitivities; improve bottom-up forecast accuracy; and turn the output into clear executive recommendations.

  • Design the management system for the business: KPIs, source-of-truth reporting, dashboards, pipeline and staffing reviews, and monthly and quarterly operating cadences.

  • Improve the end-to-end services lifecycle from opportunity intake and scoping through commercial design, contracting, staffing, delivery, and expansion, partnering with Revenue Operations and Systems rather than duplicating their ownership.

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, GTM, FDE, Technical Success, and delivery leaders on business cases, services economics, deal tradeoffs, resource allocation, and investment decisions.

  • Lead ambiguous cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation, creating clear decision rights, mechanisms, and accountability.

  • Translate recurring customer and delivery patterns into inputs for product strategy, enablement, partner strategy, and more repeatable product-plus-services offerings that accelerate durable product adoption.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • 8+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Strategic Finance, management consulting, or a comparable role, including direct experience in a technology Professional Services, implementation, systems-integration, consulting, or managed-services business.

  • Deep command of services economics and operating levers such as pipeline, bookings, backlog, revenue timing, gross margin, utilization, capacity, staffing mix, delivery quality, and customer outcomes.

  • Exceptional quantitative modeling skills: you can build auditable demand, staffing, revenue, and scenario models; work fluently in spreadsheets; and use SQL, BI, or other data tools to test assumptions and improve decisions.

  • Strong commercial and GTM judgment across pricing and packaging, offer design, forecasting, resource allocation, and complex enterprise delivery motions.

  • A record of turning ambiguous strategy into repeatable operating mechanisms, decision frameworks, reporting rhythms, and measurable results.

  • Excellent executive communication and influence; you can frame choices, surface assumptions, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical leaders.

  • Demonstrated leadership of complex cross-functional programs and teams. People-management experience is helpful, but this role is initially scoped as a senior individual contributor.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership working style, comfort with rapid change, and genuine interest in how frontier AI can create durable customer value.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. jobs.title: Global Candidate Experience Manager
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Candidate Experience team ensures that every interaction candidates and interviewers have with OpenAI reflects excellence, fairness, and humanity. This team owns global coordination, interview logistics, onsite experience, Interview Programs, and the operational workflows that support all recruiting functions, from Executive and Research to Technical, GTM, and G&A. The Candidate Experience team supports a wide range of hiring modalities (from executive and research to high-volume technical roles), and we need someone who understands how to adapt across them. As OpenAI scales globally, this team plays a critical role in designing experiences that are both bespoke for highly specialized searches and scalable across rapidly growing teams and offices.

About the Role

As Global Candidate Experience Manager, you will manage CE managers and Interview Programs program managers, with global responsibility for candidate experience, coordination and interview program delivery. You will lead through the team’s managers, leads and program owners while staying close enough to daily work to understand where it breaks. You will own service quality, capacity planning, interviewer readiness, program delivery and continuous improvement across high-volume and highly bespoke hiring.

We are looking for a hands-on operating leader who can build useful AI-enabled workflows, forecast and allocate capacity, and drive complex programs from diagnosis through launch and sustained adoption. You should be comfortable reviewing a queue with coordinators, testing a workflow with technical partners, and translating a broad goal into clear owners, milestones and decisions. Your aim is to strengthen the team’s judgment and autonomy while improving candidate care.

You can move between global operating design and frontline detail, reprioritize as demand changes, and deliver high-quality work quickly despite ambiguity. You know when to standardize and automate, when a human should remain accountable, and how to explain practical tradeoffs among speed, quality, workload and fairness.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage and develop CE managers and Interview Programs program managers; support their leads and coordinators through clear priorities, delegated decisions, timely feedback and fair accountability.

  • Stay close to daily work through queue reviews, workflow walkthroughs and direct team feedback. Diagnose system, capacity and skill problems, and personally lead selected projects with clear ownership.

  • Own CE service delivery across high-volume and confidential Executive/Research hiring. Improve scheduling, routing, handoffs and onsite experience, with clear exception and escalation boundaries.

  • Build and maintain a capacity model covering demand mix, handling time, productive hours, skills, regional coverage, leave, rework and backlog recovery.

  • Set priorities across CE service and Interview Programs with recruiting leaders. Make staffing and service tradeoffs early, accounting for regional coverage, workforce continuity, interviewer bandwidth and fair coordinator workloads.

  • Drive programs and projects end to end: define the problem and success measures; manage owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, launch readiness and adoption.

  • Own Interview Programs’ operating model, priorities and delivery through accountable program owners, including readiness, onboarding, calibration support, question governance, integrity escalation and loop health. Preserve technical approval, hiring and investigation decisions with their designated owners.

  • Personally shape and test practical AI-enabled workflows with Recruiting Optimization and People Technology; use approved data, evaluation cases, human review, monitoring and rollback.

  • Measure net improvements after review and rework, and turn successful pilots into adopted processes with training, documentation and accountable owners.

  • Run a focused service-health cadence using queue age, SLA attainment, demand/capacity variance, scheduling efficiency, quality/rework, candidate feedback and interviewer load.

  • Partner with Recruiting, Executive Operations, People Technology, People Analytics, Workplace, IT and HR Operations to remove cross-functional bottlenecks.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong operations leadership: Led high-performing teams in People Operations, Recruiting Operations or another operations function, with clear accountability for service quality and results.

  • Experience at scale: Managed high-volume operations in a high-growth environment, adapting staffing, workflows and priorities as demand and complexity increased.

  • Excellent program management: Delivered complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through launch and sustained adoption, with clear owners, milestones, dependencies and measures of success.

  • People leadership: Managed and developed managers and program owners through effective coaching, delegation, feedback and accountability.

  • Hands-on execution and bias to action: Stays close to frontline work, uses data to diagnose problems and moves work forward with sound judgment—even when the path is unclear.

  • Practical AI experience: Personally built, configured or tested AI-enabled workflows and can explain what improved, how they evaluated it and what they learned.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running multi-region coverage or supporting a mix of high-volume and confidential, bespoke hiring.

  • Contingent-workforce planning, including vendor coordination, handoffs and continuity through departures.

  • Ashby and Guide experience, or deeper experience with question governance, integrity escalation and interviewer readiness.

Workplace and Location

San Francisco headquarters. Hybrid schedule - Monday to Wednesday in office.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our Go To Market team helps customers understand, adopt, and deploy AI, bringing together Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnerships.

Our education work spans higher education, country-level partnerships, and K–12 teachers. We help institutions and students build durable AI capabilities for the future and explore how AI can support teaching, learning, research, and institutional operations.

About the Role

We are seeking a Head of Global Education GTM to lead our education partnerships & sales, shape GTM strategy, and scale the team for its next stage of growth. You will set priorities across markets and customer segments, lead representatives and regional management, and stay close to complex opportunities and senior customer relationships.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role at the intersection of partnerships, product, and adoption. You will help the team move customers from experimentation to responsible, sustained use of frontier AI. Seats and meaningful capability building and adoption are the primary goals, alongside disciplined management of the team’s commercial responsibilities.

You will lead technical, consultative Account Directors who own the customer journey from territory strategy and pipeline creation through use case identification, evaluation, procurement, deployment, adoption, consumption, value realization, and expansion. Your judgment will help the team connect executive ambition with credible technical and training plans as well as institutional readiness.

You are a strategic thinker who is comfortable speaking with leaders on the future of AI in education, and shaping GTM while technology and capabilities are still being built. Education experience is welcome but not required; we are looking for a strategic technology sales leader with strong learning agility, product sense, scrappiness, and mission alignment. International experience is helpful but not required.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and execute a global education GTM strategy across higher education, country-level partnerships, and K–12 teachers, making clear choices about segments, markets, and resource allocation.

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Directors and regional management, building the hiring plan and management capacity needed to scale.

  • Stay hands-on with major opportunities, helping the team navigate executive alignment, decentralized stakeholders, technical evaluation, governance, procurement, and deployment.

  • Develop trusted relationships with institutional leaders, education systems, country-level stakeholders, and partners.

  • Build repeatable sales and partnership approaches that expand seats and support sustained adoption and value realization.

  • Establish territory planning, pipeline reviews, forecasting, and account management that connect adoption goals with subscription and consumption responsibilities.

  • Partner with Product, technical teams, Marketing, Strategy and Operations, and other functions to shape credible customer plans and inform product priorities.

  • Help institutions build faculty and educator AI capabilities, connecting access with practical use and learning.

  • Guide the team through product change and ambiguity, distinguishing available capabilities from dependencies that require validation.

We’re seeking someone with:

  • A track record of leading and developing sales teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building repeatable operating practices.

  • Strong strategic judgment: the ability to make explicit tradeoffs, prioritize opportunities, and translate a long-term vision into frontline execution.

  • Experience leading complex enterprise technology sales or partnerships involving executive, technical, operational, and procurement stakeholders.

  • Strong product sense and technical curiosity, with the ability to learn evolving AI capabilities and partner effectively with technical experts.

  • Evidence of building in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments with limited resources, incomplete processes, or products still evolving.

  • A customer-centered approach that extends through deployment, adoption, usage, and expansion.

  • Clear communication and cross-functional influence across senior leaders, specialists, and frontline teams.

  • A mission-driven interest in expanding access to AI and helping educators and institutions build durable capability.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a strategist who makes difficult choices and brings teams along with a clear rationale.

  • Are a builder who creates systems and teams while staying willing to do the frontline work.

  • Enjoy learning new technology and translating it into practical customer opportunities.

  • Can move between an executive conversation, a deal review, and a discussion about deployment readiness.

  • Measure progress through meaningful customer use and can balance mission, adoption, and commercial discipline.

jobs.title: Global Head of Events
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Events team advances that mission by connecting the people building AI with the people using it to solve problems, create new things, and open up opportunities for others.

We bring developers, business leaders, customers, partners, and communities together to experience our technology firsthand and imagine what they can build with it. From global gatherings to hands-on experiences, our ambition is to inspire people to think bigger—and give them the ideas, relationships, and confidence to help shape what comes next.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Global Head of Events to lead a large, established global events and production team, with the opportunity to define what comes next.

Working with OpenAI’s executive team, you’ll set the direction for our event portfolio, focus investment on the experiences that matter most, and give the team the clarity and support to do its best work. This is a chance to build on a substantial foundation and create the experiences people will associate with OpenAI for years to come.

Your remit will span the company: flagship conferences, product launch experiences, developer gatherings, executive programs, regional events, and our presence at important industry and cultural moments. You’ll own the strategy, team, investments, and agency relationships that make that work possible. The team also leads in-house production for OpenAI’s town halls, webinar studio, and film projects.

You’ll bring creative judgment, business instincts, and a love of bringing people together. You’re entrepreneurial and deeply curious: ready to start with an open question, find a direction, and learn by making things. You can make good decisions with incomplete information, bring others along, and change course when you learn something new.

You’re also excited to use AI in your own work and help the team discover better ways to plan, create, and deliver experiences.

In this role, you will

  • Set OpenAI’s global events strategy and focus investment on the experiences that matter most.

  • Partner with executives on event priorities, programming, and participation in key moments.

  • Create flagship gatherings and original formats that bring our products, ideas, and communities together.

  • Work across Brand, Creative, Product, Research, and Communications to create thoughtful, cohesive attendee experiences.

  • Lead and develop a global events and production team, while helping regional teams adapt experiences for their markets.

  • Own budgets, agencies, vendors, and complex production in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.

  • Oversee in-house production for town halls, webinars, and film projects.

  • Partner with Revenue Marketing, Field Marketing, and developer teams on audience goals and follow-through; connect live, digital, and hybrid events to engagement beyond the room.

  • Define success across product understanding, adoption, community, customer relationships, brand, and business results, using feedback and AI to improve future experiences.

You might thrive in this role if you

  • 14+ years of experience in global events, experiential marketing, and large-scale production, including leadership of teams, budgets, and programs across multiple markets.

  • A track record of creating distinctive flagship experiences and building the teams and processes to deliver them consistently.

  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how to design experiences for developers, business leaders, customers, partners, and communities.

  • Experience developing leaders, setting priorities across a broad portfolio, and guiding an established team through change.

  • Experience leading complex live and recorded productions, managing agencies and significant budgets, and partnering with senior stakeholders.

  • The ability to connect event investment to meaningful outcomes while keeping the attendee experience central.

  • An entrepreneurial approach to ambiguity, curiosity about AI, and firsthand experience using it to improve your work.

jobs.title: Global Transportation Programs, Senior Manager
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Real Estate & Workplace (REW) team creates and operates the workplaces and services that help OpenAI employees do their best work. Within Workplace Experience, Transportation connects our global office network through programs designed around employee needs, local conditions, and operational excellence.

About the Role

As Global Transportation Program Sr. Manager, you will own the strategy, expansion, and day-to-day performance of OpenAI’s employee transportation programs. You will make it easier for employees to get to and between our workplaces through reliable, accessible, and cost-effective commuting options.

We’re looking for a builder who has launched and scaled employee transportation programs across countries in a fast-growing organization. You will translate our global workplace expansion plans into a transportation roadmap, establishing the systems, vendor partnerships, and operating practices needed to support new markets and growing offices. You’ll balance global consistency with local needs, creating repeatable approaches that enable local teams to deliver reliable service as the company scales.

Location and work model: San Francisco, CA based, with required travel up to 10% to our global offices. This role will be in office Monday - Wednesday, with the option to work from home Thursdays and Fridays.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a global transportation expansion roadmap aligned with office openings, headcount growth, and changing commute demand. Prioritize investments, forecast capacity and costs, and lead launches from market assessment through operational readiness and ongoing service delivery.

  • Manage the global employee transportation portfolio across shuttles, parking, micromobility, transit and commuter benefits, and EV charging. Determine the right service mix for each market based on employee needs, local infrastructure, accessibility, and cost.

  • Build a scalable operating model across regions, including repeatable launch playbooks, clear global and local ownership, vendor standards, integrated tools and reporting, and training for local teams. Adapt programs to local infrastructure, regulations, and benefit practices without rebuilding the approach for every office.

  • Manage transportation vendors from sourcing and onboarding through service reviews, renewals, corrective action, and transitions, partnering with Strategic Sourcing and Legal on commercial terms.

  • Own program budgets, forecasts, invoice review, and business cases; use utilization and cost data to recommend where to invest, optimize, or retire services.

  • Partner with Workplace Operations, Real Estate, Facilities, Corporate Security, People/Benefits, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT, and Internal Comms to clarify ownership and deliver integrated programs.

  • Work with Benefits, Payroll, and Legal to design and administer transit benefits, parking eligibility, subsidies, and reimbursement policies appropriate to each market.

  • Establish clear service levels, incident escalation, backup plans, and outage communications so employees can navigate disruptions safely and confidently.

  • Improve the end-to-end employee journey, including discovery, enrollment, booking, support, and feedback; build clear intake, tracking, and resolution processes with internal teams and vendors.

  • Measure service reliability, adoption, capacity utilization, employee satisfaction, accessibility, and cost effectiveness; turn findings into improvements and concise leadership recommendations.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have directly built and scaled employee transportation programs across multiple countries during significant organizational growth, with demonstrated results in new-market launches, service reliability, adoption, and cost management.

  • Bring hands-on experience across multiple transportation modes, including shuttles, parking, micromobility, and transit or commuter benefits, with the ability to manage an integrated portfolio.

  • Can turn ambiguous expansion needs into practical plans, budgets, operating standards, and clear decisions while staying close to daily service delivery.

  • Have managed complex vendor relationships and commercial performance, including service levels, budgets, procurement processes, and service recovery.

  • Use data to evaluate demand, service quality, utilization, and cost, and can explain tradeoffs clearly to employees, partners, and leaders.

  • Build effective partnerships across functions, regions, and external providers, and can drive decisions and accountability without relying on formal authority.

  • Apply sound judgment to safety, accessibility, local requirements, and employee data, bringing in the right specialists when needed.

  • Communicate clearly, act on feedback, and remain calm and accountable during service disruptions or changing priorities.

  • Experience with commute-management platforms, transportation demand management, sustainability measurement, or systems integrations is a plus.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

You will partner closely with Sales, GTM, product marketing, lifecycle, product, engineering, data science, finance, design, and marketing operations to connect paid campaigns to the right buying journeys.   • Develop B2B audience, offer, and messaging strategies for decision-makers, practitioners, company sizes, industries, and use cases.

  • Create strong feedback loops with Sales and Marketing Operations, using lead quality, account engagement, pipeline progression, and customer insights to improve performance.

  • Drive experimentation and incrementality measurement, translating results into scalable playbooks across markets, segments, and sales motions.

  • Build AI-enabled creative, targeting, reporting, and optimization workflows that increase iteration velocity while maintaining quality and control.

  • 8+ years of B2B growth, demand generation, or performance marketing experience, ideally in high-growth technology or subscription businesses.

  • 6+ years of deep, hands-on experience leading paid marketing across channels, including Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, and Affiliate, at both an operational and strategic level.

  • A track record of launching, scaling, and optimizing B2B paid programs at significant budget levels with clear impact on qualified demand, pipeline, or revenue.

  • Experience marketing across self-serve, product-led, and sales-assisted journeys and adapting programs for SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments.

jobs.title: Growth - Lifecycle Lead (B2B)
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering.

About the Role

We are hiring a Lifecycle Lead to build the company-wide owned-channel capability that helps teams reach businesses with relevant, timely, and trustworthy experiences. This senior, hands-on leader will set the small and medium business lifecycle strategy, partner with Engineering to build the orchestration and deployment platform, and establish the operating model that allows teams across the company to launch and improve evergreen programs safely at scale.

You will sit at the intersection of platform, product, and campaign strategy. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics on the underlying systems, and with Product Marketing Managers and other client teams to design journeys that help new, active, and returning businesses reach value and build durable habits.

This role is based in San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with B2B product to set the company-wide vision, roadmap, and operating model for lifecycle and owned-channel engagement.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics to shape the tooling and infrastructure for identity, audiences, eligibility, consent, triggers, orchestration, decisioning, frequency, experimentation, localization, quality assurance, and observability.

  • Define scalable deployment workflows—including self-service and centrally supported paths, intake, templates, approvals, governance, service levels, and incident response—so teams across the company can launch safely and efficiently.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Managers and other client teams to translate audience, product, and business goals into evergreen journey strategies across onboarding, activation, continuation, retention, resurrection, and monetization.

  • Lead the design, launch, iteration, and optimization of templates and journeys across email, push, and in-product messaging, including the deep-linked landing and post-click product experiences that complete the loop.

  • Partner with Growth DS to build a measurement system that connects reach, eligibility, delivery, engagement, landing behavior, task completion, retained activity, and incremental value through sound experiments and holdouts.

  • Optimize the small and medium business lifecycle portfolio—not just individual sends—by improving inventory, relevance, personalization, prioritization, and per-user frequency.

  • Inform our owned channel / upsell strategy–establish a high bar for deliverability, user preferences, localization, and operational quality, and trust while influencing senior stakeholders across the company.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, growth, product marketing, or marketing technology, ideally in a global B2B business serving self serve small businesses, enterprises, and developers.

  • A track record of building and scaling lifecycle tooling or platforms with Engineering for multiple teams, products, audiences, or markets.

  • Strong technical and product fluency across event and identity models, data pipelines, APIs, segmentation, triggering, decisioning, experimentation, and deployment systems; coding experience is not required.

  • Deep campaign and journey craft, with experience designing evergreen programs that move users from message to product value and durable behavior.

  • Strong experimentation and measurement judgment, including incrementality, holdouts, cohort quality, retention, and lifetime value—not just delivery or click metrics.

  • Experience creating operating models, governance, templates, and quality standards that increase organizational velocity without creating channel chaos.

  • Executive-level cross-functional influence and clear communication across Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, PMM, Creative, Legal, Privacy, and regional teams.

  • A hands-on, systems-oriented leadership style: you can set a multi-year direction, write the brief, inspect the journey, diagnose failures, and make pragmatic tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager - Web & Organic, SMB Ads
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager to build the web and organic growth engine for SMB advertisers at OpenAI. This is a zero-to-one opportunity to shape how businesses discover our advertising platform, understand its value, and become successful advertisers.

You will own the SMB Ads web strategy and experimentation roadmap, combining customer insight, analytical rigor, and product judgment to grow qualified discovery and improve conversion. Your scope spans web experiences, organic search, generative engine optimization (GEO), and the journey from first visit through signup and activation. You will work closely with Product, Design, Ads Engineering, Content, and Data Science to turn opportunities into shipped experiences, operating with the speed and ownership of a startup.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the SMB Ads web strategy and roadmap to grow qualified discovery, signup, and advertiser activation.

  • Grow organic discovery through search, content, and GEO. Test new ways to help businesses find and evaluate OpenAI’s advertising offering.

  • Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to identify conversion barriers and prioritize high-impact improvements.

  • Run experiments across landing pages, messaging, navigation, personalization, offers, and conversion flows. Use results to guide the roadmap.

  • Improve the journey from website visit to signup, onboarding, and first campaign with Product and Ads Engineering.

  • Define instrumentation, test design, attribution, and reporting with Data Science and marketing systems teams to measure incremental activation and advertiser value.

  • Launch useful web experiences with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Engineering, and specialist agencies. Evaluate capabilities such as personalization, chat, and experimentation tools.

  • Connect landing experiences to in-product, referral, and cross-sell acquisition programs. Coordinate onboarding and engagement with Lifecycle Marketing.

  • Use AI to accelerate research, prototyping, content, analysis, and experimentation. Scale successful tests and communicate results clearly.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Bring 4–7 years of experience in growth marketing, web strategy, organic acquisition, conversion optimization, or product growth, with measurable acquisition, activation, or revenue impact.

  • Apply strong analytical judgment across funnels, cohorts, customer behavior, and incremental impact to prioritize growth opportunities.

  • Demonstrate ownership of web experiences and experimentation programs that improve conversion from discovery to activation.

  • Connect SEO, content-led discovery, and GEO with customer insight, web strategy, and product judgment.

  • Translate business opportunities into clear roadmaps and launched experiences with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on growth execution. Relevant backgrounds include scaled technology businesses, startups, or consulting followed by operating experience in startup growth.

  • Evaluate and implement web capabilities with technical partners, using AI to improve execution speed and quality.

  • Understand SMB customers and bring experience in self-serve products, advertising, SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, commerce, or other high-volume digital businesses.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building web and organic growth programs for SMBs or self-serve advertising platforms.

OpenAI's Marketing team helps customers understand, adopt, and get value from OpenAI's products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understanding customer needs, market dynamics, and funnel behavior. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing Operations, Design, and Communications to create a cohesive end-to-end advertiser experience and help businesses unlock value from OpenAI's advertising platform.

About the Role

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Manager, SMB Ads to help build and execute high-velocity growth programs for small business advertisers. This person will work across acquisition, activation, lifecycle, and conversion, with an initial focus on helping advertisers move from interest and sign-up to first meaningful spend & retention over time

This is a hands-on growth role for someone who loves turning ideas into shipped experiments. You will build campaigns, lifecycle journeys, landing page tests, messaging tests, audience experiments, AI-assisted workflows, reporting improvements, and practical conversion programs. As the SMB Ads business grows, this role may continue to support acquisition and activation and expand deeper into same-store growth, lifecycle, retention, and repeat spend.

  • Execute growth experiments across acquisition, activation, lifecycle, and early retention.

  • Build email, in-product, landing page, audience, messaging, and offer tests that help SMB advertisers reach first spend and repeat value.

  • Use AI tools to prototype marketing assets, automate workflows, analyze funnel data, generate creative variations, and build internal growth systems.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing Operations to turn strategy into shipped experiments and measurable learnings.

  • Support improvements to sign-up, onboarding, campaign creation, measurement, and advertiser education.

  • Maintain experiment documentation, QA checklists, learnings, and performance readouts.

  • Translate ambiguous growth ideas into concrete tests, campaign plans, launchable assets, and clear next steps.

  • Help identify new ways to convert, activate, retain, and grow SMB advertisers.

  • Have 4-7 years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, GTM engineering, marketing operations, product growth, demand generation, or performance marketing.

  • Have shipped campaigns, experiments, automations, landing page tests, lifecycle programs, or conversion initiatives.

  • Are comfortable working across ambiguous, fast-moving growth problems with incomplete information.

  • Can interpret funnel metrics, campaign performance, experiment results, and customer behavior signals.

  • Are fluent with AI tools and use them to accelerate marketing execution, workflow automation, analysis, personalization, prototyping, or internal tooling.

  • Have strong writing and customer judgement, especially for translating product value into clear SMB-facing messaging.

  • Enjoy working across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations.

  • Have experience with SMB growth, self-serve funnels, advertiser growth, PLG SaaS, marketplaces, commerce, fintech, local services, creator tools, or other high-volume customer funnels.
