jobs.title: ITAV Deployment Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s IT organization supports the mission of deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all. Our team is committed to providing seamless technological support and solutions to ensure that all OpenAI employees are well-equipped and connected. This enables them to contribute effectively towards our AI research, corporate operations and product initiatives.

About the Role

As an ITAV Deployment Engineer at OpenAI, you will deliver the audiovisual systems for new offices, expansions, and refresh projects. You will turn approved designs into installed, configured, and tested systems, coordinate integrators and site dependencies, and carry defects through verified closeout. Your coordination begins at project inception and continues through delivery, commissioning, and acceptance by the receiving support team. You will partner with ITAV Engineering on design decisions, Network Engineering on connectivity, and Workplace and Capital Builds on site readiness and delivery timing.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver assigned AV build packages for new offices, expansions, and refreshes using approved designs, room standards, and installation requirements.

  • Coordinate the ITAV workstream for office construction projects from inception through delivery, partnering with Capital Builds, Network Security, and Workplace Design and Construction to align requirements, schedules, dependencies, and handoffs.

  • Review drawings, equipment lists, site conditions, and integrator plans; identify missing prerequisites and raise design exceptions before installation.

  • Coordinate equipment staging, installation sequencing, vendor deliverables, and site access with integrators, Workplace, Capital Builds, and ITAV program partners.

  • Configure conferencing endpoints, Q-SYS controls and audio processing, and AV-over-IP connections to match the approved design.

  • Prepare accurate device and port records and coordinate IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, and connectivity requirements with Network Engineering.

  • Commission rooms end to end, testing audio, video, control, conferencing, content sharing, monitoring, and recovery against documented acceptance criteria.

  • Diagnose installation and integration failures, maintain a prioritized punch list, and retest fixes before accepting completed work.

  • Deliver configuration backups, as-built markups, inventory, test evidence, and support instructions; train receiving technicians and secure operational handoff.

  • Identify repeatable deployment work and automate it using AI, agentic workflows, and basic scripting. Maintain reusable checks and templates, validate results, and obtain engineering review for changes to shared standards.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and commissioning enterprise conference room AV systems from technical designs.

  • Experience reading AV signal-flow drawings, equipment schedules, and installation plans, and recording accurate as-built changes.

  • Practical experience configuring conferencing hardware and platforms such as Logitech, Cisco, Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.

  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting Q-SYS audio and control systems, including signal routing and reusable configuration components.

  • Working knowledge of AV-over-IP technologies such as Q-LAN, Dante, and NDI and the ability to isolate signal, configuration, and transport faults.

  • Practical networking knowledge covering IP addressing, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and multicast, with sound judgment about when to involve Network Engineering.

  • Experience coordinating integrator work, site prerequisites, equipment readiness, defects, and commissioning milestones within an assigned project.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Workplace Design and Construction partners to deliver new office construction projects.

  • Ability to verify the complete meeting experience, document technical acceptance, and prepare usable configuration records and support handoffs.

  • Clear communication and demonstrated ability to build, test, and maintain AI and agentic workflows using scripting or configuration tools to automate repeatable deployment work.

  • Experience contributing reusable Q-SYS components or shared deployment tooling is a plus.

  • Experience delivering office AV across multiple locations or working with room scheduling and signage endpoints is a plus.

jobs.title: ITAV Event Technical Producer
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s IT organization supports the mission of deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all. Our team is committed to providing seamless technological support and solutions to ensure that all OpenAI employees are well-equipped and connected. This enables them to contribute effectively towards our AI research, corporate operations and product initiatives.

About the Role

As an ITAV Event Technical Producer at OpenAI, you will lead technical production for complex internal and external events across multiple sites, from early planning through rehearsal and live delivery. You will partner with internal stakeholders and technical teams to translate event requirements into clear production plans. You will coordinate internal and external crews, direct large, distributed shows and coordinate cross-site handoffs, and use your technical expertise to resolve production challenges and make informed tradeoffs. You will also build reusable production practices and AI workflows, improve how teams deliver events, and mentor peers and junior crew members.

This is a full-time, onsite role requiring five days per week in San Francisco. Travel to other OpenAI locations is required as needed for assigned events.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical production for complex internal, hybrid, and distributed events from early planning and scoping through rehearsal, live delivery, and debrief.

  • Align Internal Comms, Marketing, Brand Experience, and Workplace on audience goals, requirements, scope, dependencies, and decision owners. Turn ambiguous or competing needs into an agreed production plan and readiness criteria.

  • Configure and operate live audio, video switching, cameras, playback, conferencing, streaming, and recording systems for the agreed production.

  • Integrate the run of show across sites and lead multiple crews globally for all-company events. Align technical cues, rehearsals, content handoffs, schedules, and contingencies with partner teams to deliver one cohesive event.

  • Lead rehearsals and validate the complete audience experience, including remote contribution, playback, recording, and tested backup paths.

  • Independently prioritize technical production tradeoffs and lead risk reviews and incident response. Resolve ambiguity within your scope, and seek guidance for complex situations or decisions owned by event, staffing, budget, or engineering partners.

  • Build reusable production plans, show files, runbooks, and change-control practices. Coach peers and junior crew members to use them independently and verify improvements in readiness, troubleshooting, and execution.

  • Set a prioritized roadmap for production improvements using audience feedback, debriefs, and recurring failures. Lead workflow changes across teams and define permanent-system improvements with AV Engineering.

  • Identify repeatable production work and build AI and agentic workflows with partner teams. Validate results, establish operating and maintenance ownership, support adoption, and measure preparation effort or reliability improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Experience leading complex live or hybrid productions across multiple teams, from ambiguous requirements through rehearsal, delivery, and debrief.

  • Advanced expertise in multiple live-production domains, such as audio, video, conferencing, streaming, or AV-over-IP, and the ability to diagnose complex interactions across the complete signal path.

  • Experience configuring and operating professional production systems and creating reusable show files or control workflows.

  • Practical AV-over-IP and networking knowledge sufficient to troubleshoot live media, timing, and connectivity with engineering partners.

  • Experience independently resolving ambiguous production problems, setting detailed plans, and prioritizing tradeoffs while seeking guidance when complexity or decision authority requires it.

  • Demonstrated ownership of rehearsals, technical readiness, failover testing, and calm incident response for high-priority productions.

  • Ability to lead crews and influence partner teams without reporting authority, with clear boundaries for content, brand, budget, staffing, and engineering decisions.

  • Experience working with communications, marketing, brand or creative experience, Workplace, and technical partners on complex events, including sensitive planning and late changes.

  • Experience building reusable production frameworks and validated AI workflows, guiding team adoption, and mentoring peers or junior staff with measurable improvements in their capability.

  • Experience with multi-space or multi-location productions and sensitive executive events is a plus.

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Compute organization turns ambitious AI research into real-world capability by delivering the compute infrastructure behind our most advanced models. The team works across software, hardware, facilities, operations, and engineering disciplines to make enormous amounts of compute available, reliable, and efficient.

As the demand for frontier AI grows, so does the complexity of the systems required to support it. Scaling this infrastructure means solving problems that cut across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, GPU fleets, power, cooling, networking, manufacturing, supply chain, and data center delivery.

Our work is focused on expanding the compute foundation that enables OpenAI to train more capable models, including systems like GPT-5.6, and make frontier AI available to more people, products, and workflows. We’re looking for exceptional people across many disciplines to help build the next generation of AI infrastructure at a scale few organizations have attempted.

About the Role

We are hiring across a broad range of roles to help design, build, scale, and operate OpenAI’s compute infrastructure. Depending on your background, you may work on large-scale distributed systems, ML infrastructure, hardware systems, manufacturing, supply chain, data center development, or the physical engineering systems required to bring massive compute capacity online.

You’ll work with teams across research, engineering, hardware, operations, and infrastructure to solve high-impact problems at extraordinary scale. This may include improving system reliability, accelerating deployment timelines, increasing operational efficiency, designing new infrastructure, or helping bring new compute platforms and facilities from concept to production.

This is an opportunity to work on one of the most important infrastructure challenges in AI: building the compute foundation required to train and serve increasingly capable frontier models.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build, scale, and operate OpenAI’s global compute infrastructure.

  • Solve complex problems across software, hardware, manufacturing supply chain, and data center systems.

  • Improve the reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability of critical infrastructure.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to bring new compute capacity online quickly and reliably.

  • Identify bottlenecks across technical, operational, and physical systems, and develop practical solutions.

  • Build tools, processes, systems, or infrastructure that improve execution at scale.

  • Contribute to the long-term architecture and operational maturity of OpenAI’s compute footprint.

Qualifications

  • Have experience building, scaling, or operating complex technical systems.

  • Enjoy working on ambiguous, high-impact problems where the path forward is not always defined.

  • Are comfortable collaborating across disciplines, including software, hardware, operations, and physical infrastructure.

  • Have strong technical judgment and a bias toward execution.

  • Care deeply about reliability, speed, safety, and operational excellence.

  • Are excited by the challenge of building infrastructure at unprecedented scale.

  • Want your work to directly support the development and deployment of frontier AI.

Preferred Skills

  • Have experience with AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, distributed systems, GPU clusters, or cloud-scale platforms.

  • Have worked on hardware systems, manufacturing, supply chain, data center development, or large capital infrastructure projects.

  • Have domain expertise in civil, controls, mechanical, hardware, electrical, thermal, power, networking, or facilities engineering.

  • Have helped bring new technical platforms, data centers, factories, or large-scale systems from concept to production.

  • Have experience operating in fast-moving environments where technical depth and execution speed both matter.

jobs.title: Industry Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences. Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.

About the Role

As an Industry PMM, you will help define how OpenAI brings frontier AI to priority industries. This role sits at the center of OpenAI’s industry marketing motion, helping customers understand where AI can create practical value, improve workflows, and support responsible adoption.

You will shape the market narrative, build the field-facing operating system, and coordinate cross-functional execution across product launches, customer proof, partner moments, events, and account-based campaigns. You will help senior industry leaders understand how OpenAI models, products, and workflows can support meaningful work in either Life Sciences, Banking, or Healthcare.

We’re looking for a product marketer who can combine strategic narrative, technical curiosity, enterprise GTM judgment, and program leadership. The right person can turn fast-moving capability into clear positioning, credible assets, and practical field execution.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own positioning and messaging for OpenAI’s industry offering for either Life Sciences, Banking, or Healthcare.

  • Build field-ready assets for account directors, solution engineers, industry leaders, and executive audiences, including first-call decks, one-pagers, use-case libraries, customer stories, and proof-point packages

  • Translate frontier model capabilities into simple, accurate, and defensible GTM language for senior enterprise buyers and industry practitioners

  • Partner with Product, Research, Policy, Legal, Comms, Partnerships, Customer Success, and GTM to coordinate launches, claims, proof points, enablement, and customer-facing guidance

  • Develop campaigns and activation programs across launches, blogs, webinars, roundtables, executive briefings, conferences, customer proof, and account-based motions

  • Turn customer deployments, field signal, and partner feedback into approved stories, evidence, ROI narratives, and repeatable industry use cases

  • Serve as the connective tissue for the industry marketing workstream, keeping priorities, owners, launch readiness, open questions, and executive updates clear

  • Maintain a high bar for accuracy, governance, customer trust, and responsible marketing in a sensitive and fast-moving category

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in product marketing, industry marketing, vertical marketing, enterprise GTM, or adjacent B2B technology roles

  • PMM experience in either Life Sciences, Banking, Healthcare, or another regulated/high-trust vertical.

  • Have experience marketing technical enterprise products to industry, developer, IT, business, operational, or C-suite audiences

  • Can translate complex model, product, and technical concepts into clear positioning, field assets, and customer-facing narratives

  • Have strong cross-functional program leadership instincts and can drive work across Product, GTM, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, Legal, Customer Success, and Research

  • Use customer evidence, field signal, product usage, market research, and competitive context to sharpen strategy and prioritize work

  • Have experience building GTM programs, operating rhythms, or new playbooks in ambiguous, high-velocity environments

  • Bring strong writing, messaging, and editorial judgment, with a high bar for clarity, quality, accuracy, and credibility

  • Are deeply curious about AI, industry transformation, enterprise adoption, and how new capabilities become real customer value

  • Think strategically about how industry marketing drives awareness, trust, pipeline, adoption, customer proof, and long-term market leadership

  • Are highly collaborative and effective at influencing senior stakeholders, field teams, technical teams, and external partners

  • Execute quickly while maintaining a high quality bar across messaging, launch work, enablement, customer proof, and campaign execution

jobs.title: Infrastructure Communications Lead
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Our team helps OpenAI advance data center development by connecting communications, permitting and community engagement. We work across the teams building these projects to bring community expertise and clear communication to practical development needs.

About the Role

We’re looking for a versatile communications and community engagement professional who can help move data center projects forward. You’ll combine community engagement with strong communication skills and experience in permitting and public meetings. This role calls for someone who can influence across organizational boundaries, build understanding among stakeholders and step into the work where they can be most useful. This position has a strong external focus, crafting and sharing our data center narrative with a strong impact on policy-making through advocacy and press stakeholder management. This position will also have a major impact on the way OpenAI is perceived by other players in the industry and by the wider public.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with permitting and community-engagement teams to understand local concerns and support project progress.

  • Support press and storytelling around community engagement projects in our local data center communities in partnership with our Community Engagement Leads.

  • Help craft and scale our communication narrative around our operating principals as we scale our infrastructure footprint.

  • Develop clear narratives and communications that explain projects, energy needs and policy positions to relevant stakeholders.

  • Connect policy, communications and project teams so messages and actions reflect development needs.

  • Build alignment across teams, influence decisions and help resolve issues that span policy, communications and development.

  • Think creatively about communications and the channels used, working with the Public Affairs teams to deliver integrated execution of initiatives.

  • Help shape energy policy approaches that support data center development and translate policy considerations into practical recommendations.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex issues clear to different audiences.

  • Practical experience crafting a positive narrative for the data center industry, and a track record of influencing across teams and taking ownership in ambiguous situations.

  • Experience in and supporting public meetings, events, and announcements.

  • Experience managing social media messaging and campaigns in support of project initiatives

  • Media training and have experience working with senior leadership to prep for media

  • Experience in energy policy and an ability to connect policy decisions to infrastructure development.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience running a high stakes media campaign

  • Experience supporting data center development or comparable energy and infrastructure projects.

  • Experience with policy communication (on energy for example)

About OpenAI

jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations & Sustainability Lead
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Industrial Compute organization is building and operating the infrastructure required to support frontier AI at unprecedented scale. The organization works across data center development, power, design and construction, hardware, supply chain, deployment, facilities operations, and external partnerships.

As this infrastructure footprint grows, OpenAI must ensure that sustainability, operational reliability, and responsible development are incorporated into infrastructure decisions from the beginning rather than addressed as separate downstream initiatives.

About the Role

We are seeking an Infrastructure Operations & Sustainability Lead to develop and execute the sustainability strategy for OpenAI’s global infrastructure portfolio.

This role will translate environmental priorities and external commitments into practical operating requirements across site selection, data center design, construction, equipment procurement, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will build the frameworks, metrics, governance, and cross-functional programs required to improve environmental performance while preserving the speed, reliability, and scalability demanded by OpenAI’s infrastructure roadmap.

The role will partner closely with infrastructure operations, site development, engineering, construction, power, hardware, supply chain, finance, legal, public policy, government affairs, communications, and external infrastructure partners.

This is a senior leadership role requiring infrastructure fluency, sustainability expertise, executive judgment, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive sustainability strategy for OpenAI’s global compute infrastructure.

  • Translate sustainability objectives into actionable requirements for site selection, design, construction, procurement, commissioning, and operations.

  • Establish decision frameworks that balance environmental impact with infrastructure reliability, deployment speed, cost, and scalability.

  • Develop strategies addressing operational and embodied carbon, water stewardship, materials, construction impacts, waste, circularity, and equipment lifecycle management.

  • Partner with data center engineering and operations teams to identify practical improvements in infrastructure efficiency, resource use, resilience, and operational performance.

  • Incorporate sustainability considerations into self-build, colocation, cloud, and strategic infrastructure-partner decisions.

  • Establish measurable goals, operating metrics, dashboards, and governance mechanisms for infrastructure sustainability programs.

  • Improve the quality, consistency, and auditability of environmental and operational data across internal teams and external partners.

  • Work with hardware, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to develop supplier requirements and lifecycle strategies for infrastructure equipment.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, design approaches, and operating practices and determine which should move from pilot programs into scaled deployment.

  • Develop business cases that clearly communicate environmental impact, implementation requirements, cost, schedule, and operational tradeoffs.

  • Partner with Public Policy and Government Affairs on infrastructure-related sustainability positions, regulatory developments, and external engagement.

  • Represent OpenAI in conversations with infrastructure partners, industry organizations, policymakers, community stakeholders, and other external parties.

  • Provide executive leadership with clear assessments of progress, material risks, strategic choices, and recommended actions.

  • Build repeatable playbooks that allow sustainability practices to scale across sites, geographies, infrastructure partners, and technology generations.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in sustainability, infrastructure operations, environmental strategy, data center infrastructure, the built environment, or a related field.

  • Experience leading sustainability or operational-improvement programs across a large, complex, and geographically distributed organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate high-level environmental objectives into practical engineering, procurement, construction, and operational requirements.

  • Strong understanding of carbon, water, materials, waste, circularity, and lifecycle considerations within physical infrastructure.

  • Experience building metrics, governance systems, and executive reporting for complex operational programs.

  • Ability to evaluate technical, financial, environmental, regulatory, and reputational tradeoffs together.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience working with external partners, suppliers, regulators, policymakers, or industry organizations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to make complex subjects clear and decision-ready for executives.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, changing priorities, and significant external scrutiny.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with hyperscale data centers, cloud infrastructure, industrial facilities, or another power- and resource-intensive operating environment.

  • Familiarity with data center design, construction, facilities operations, hardware supply chains, and infrastructure-development lifecycles.

  • Experience with embodied-carbon reduction, sustainable construction materials, water-positive programs, equipment circularity, or infrastructure-efficiency initiatives.

  • Knowledge of greenhouse-gas accounting, environmental disclosure frameworks, lifecycle assessment, and sustainability-related data systems.

  • Experience developing external partnerships or industry initiatives that produced measurable operational outcomes.

  • Familiarity with energy procurement and utility policy sufficient to partner effectively with dedicated power and energy teams.

  • Experience building or leading multidisciplinary sustainability and infrastructure programs through periods of rapid organizational growth.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead, Brand & Policy
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We develop and execute strategies that build understanding of OpenAI, deepen engagement with our key audiences, and communicate why we build, how our technology is creating value, and how we approach its broader societal impact.

We work closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, Product, and other teams to translate complex topics into clear, relevant, and compelling stories. Our work spans national campaigns and locally tailored efforts, helping people understand both the opportunities created by AI and the important issues surrounding its development and adoption.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integrated Marketing Lead to lead policy- and reputation-focused campaigns that strengthen the OpenAI brand nationally and within local communities.

This person will spearhead integrated campaigns and corporate communications initiatives that help people understand why OpenAI builds, the impact of our technology, and how we are engaging with some of the most consequential issues surrounding AI—including infrastructure and data centers, jobs and economic opportunity, and youth safety.

The role combines national paid media with locally relevant marketing and engagement efforts. The ideal candidate understands policy, public affairs, and civic audiences while also being a sophisticated brand marketer who can make complex subjects accessible and meaningful to a broader public.

This person will bring strategic vision, sound judgment, organizational clarity, and exceptional execution to highly visible work. They will collaborate closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, and external agency partners to build trust and shape understanding of OpenAI at both the national and local levels.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead policy and brand campaign strategy: Develop integrated marketing strategies that communicate why OpenAI builds, demonstrate the real-world impact of our technology, and address important policy and societal issues.

  • Build national and local campaigns: Lead a mix of national paid-media campaigns and locally tailored efforts that reach policymakers, civic and community leaders, influential stakeholders, and the broader public.

  • Translate complex issues into compelling stories: Turn nuanced topics—including AI infrastructure, data centers, jobs, economic opportunity, and youth safety—into clear, credible, and engaging narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Own campaigns from strategy through measurement: Manage the full campaign lifecycle, including audience insights, briefs, creative development, media strategy, stakeholder alignment, execution, launch, optimization, and post-campaign analysis.

  • Connect policy expertise with brand building: Ensure policy-focused communications strengthen the broader OpenAI brand, create greater understanding of our mission, and build long-term trust.

  • Champion creative excellence: Partner with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop distinctive, culturally relevant work while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment on sensitive topics.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, Product, and other partners to align priorities, navigate complex issues, and bring campaigns to market effectively.

  • Develop audience and market insight: Build a deep understanding of policy, civic, and local audiences and use research, data, and cultural insight to determine the most effective messages, channels, and messengers.

  • Measure and improve impact: Establish clear campaign objectives and measurement plans, using results and audience feedback to continuously strengthen our strategy and execution.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Relevant experience: 12+ years of experience in integrated marketing, brand marketing, corporate reputation, public affairs, policy communications, or advertising, including significant experience leading complex, high-profile campaigns.

  • Policy audience expertise: A strong understanding of policymakers, civic leaders, advocacy organizations, community stakeholders, and other audiences that influence public understanding and policy conversations.

  • Brand-building experience: A demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical subjects into accessible stories that strengthen reputation, build trust, and connect a brand with a broad public audience.

  • National and local campaign experience: Proven success developing national campaigns as well as locally tailored marketing or public-affairs efforts informed by regional and community context.

  • Paid-media expertise: Experience leading substantial paid-media campaigns across channels such as television, digital video, social, print, audio, out-of-home, and local media.

  • Integrated campaign leadership: Proven success managing campaigns across paid, owned, earned, experiential, and community channels, with strong strategic and project-management skills.

  • Exceptional judgment: The ability to navigate sensitive, fast-moving, and highly visible issues with care, accuracy, and an understanding of reputational and policy considerations.

  • Communication and influence: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and influence decisions at the executive level.

  • Cross-functional leadership: A track record of bringing together teams with different perspectives and areas of expertise to deliver against a shared objective.

  • Agility and adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adjusting strategies in response to new developments, audience insights, and external dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing campaigns related to technology policy, corporate reputation, economic impact, infrastructure, workforce issues, online or youth safety, or other complex societal topics.

  • Experience partnering closely with public policy, government affairs, corporate communications, research, and community-engagement teams.

  • Experience managing creative and media agencies and substantial campaign budgets.

  • A passion for storytelling and for making complex ideas understandable, relevant, and human.

  • A test-and-learn mindset grounded in research, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence, emerging technology, and the evolving public conversation surrounding their impact.

Workplace & Location

  • San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

  • Optional locations: Washington DC or New York. If you're in either of these locations, you will need to travel to SF on a frequent basis.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager, AI Impact
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We help people understand what AI makes possible through the experiences of the people, communities, and customers using it.

We work closely with Social, Community, Communications, Creative, Production, and other teams to bring those experiences to life. Our work connects human stories with integrated marketing programs that build understanding and inspiration with our key audience.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to identify and curate the strongest proof points of AI’s impact—across people, communities, and society—and turn them into stories and programs that resonate.

You’ll be a builder and storyteller with the curiosity to uncover an extraordinary story and the initiative to make something of it. You’ll seek out people using AI in meaningful ways, build relationships, understand what has changed for them, and help them share their experiences in their own voices.

Working deeply with Social, Community, and Communications, you’ll shape stories together and build the programs, content, and distribution plans that help them travel. That could mean developing a recurring story series, bringing a community’s experience to a national audience, or turning a customer story into a program that invites others to participate.

You’ll combine strong editorial instincts with integrated marketing leadership, taking work from discovery and a clear brief through production, launch, and measurement. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable shaping an ambitious idea, facilitating a conversation with a story participant, and organizing the people and resources needed to bring a program to life.

In this role, you will:

  • Find the strongest proof points: Proactively discover people, communities, and customers using AI in meaningful ways. Evaluate the evidence, human significance, and audience relevance behind each opportunity.

  • Build alongside Social, Community, and Communications: Partner from the outset on story discovery, creative ideas, programming, and distribution. Align on a shared plan, clear roles, and the right moments to bring stories to audiences.

  • Turn stories into programs: Create integrated campaigns, recurring content series, community activations, and partnerships that give strong stories a life beyond a single asset or launch.

  • Connect national reach with local relevance: Adapt stories, formats, messengers, and programs to the audiences and communities they serve. Identify when a local story can resonate nationally and how a national program can become meaningful locally.

  • Lead work from idea to delivery: Own briefs, creative development, production, timelines, budgets, partner coordination, launch, and optimization across social, owned, earned, experiential, community, and relevant paid channels.

  • Champion craft and credibility: Partner with Creative, producers, and agencies to make distinctive, engaging content. Ground stories in demonstrated impact, bring technical ideas to life through human experiences, and represent participants accurately and thoughtfully.

  • Build a repeatable approach: Develop a network of internal and external partners and a practical process for sourcing, prioritizing, developing, and sharing stories. Create formats and programs that can grow while leaving room to act on unexpected opportunities.

  • Measure what resonates: Set clear goals for audience understanding, reach, engagement, sharing, and participation. Use results and feedback from audiences and participants to improve the stories, formats, and programs we build.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Relevant experience: 12+ years in integrated marketing, content or editorial strategy, customer storytelling, community marketing, or related fields, including significant experience leading complex campaigns and programs.

  • Strong story instincts: An ability to spot compelling people, experiences, and outcomes, assess what makes them credible and relevant, and shape a clear narrative for a specific audience.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: A track record of building something from zero to 100, creating momentum through ambiguity, and moving between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Integrated marketing leadership: Proven success connecting content, distribution, and audience participation across channels, with strong planning, production, budget, and project-management skills.

  • Creative and editorial judgment: Experience shaping briefs and developing work across formats such as video, social, written stories, and live experiences, with a high bar for quality and audience relevance.

  • Communication and influence: Strong writing, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear, build alignment, and influence decisions at the executive level.

  • Deep cross-functional collaboration: A track record of building programs with Social, Community, Communications, Creative, and other partners, bringing different perspectives together around a shared objective.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience telling stories about AI or emerging technology through concrete human experiences and demonstrated outcomes.

  • Experience building customer advocacy, community storytelling, or ambassador programs that surface compelling voices and encourage participation.

  • Experience with documentary, editorial, or other storytelling that involves working directly with participants, from initial interviews through production.

  • Experience developing local partnerships, events, or community programs and connecting them to broader campaigns.

  • Experience managing creative agencies, production partners, and campaign budgets, including scaling successful formats or programs.

  • Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and curiosity about how people use them to work, learn, create, and solve problems.

Workplace & Location

  • San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to help translate our products, their value propositions, and our broader brand strategy into audience-specific, globally relevant marketing programs. You’ll shape how people discover, understand, adopt, and engage with our products across markets and stages of the customer journey. You’ll connect product narratives, audience insight, cultural context, and business goals into strategies that make advanced technology feel clear, useful, and human.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for a marketer who understands how product marketing, brand strategy, audience research, and international growth work together. You’ll develop segmentation frameworks, lifecycle and go-to-market programs, regional insights, and partnership opportunities; then work across product marketing, growth, creative, partnerships, analytics, and regional teams to bring them to life. Your work will connect launches, product education, customer engagement, and ongoing storytelling into a coherent journey from awareness to advocacy.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance craft with decisiveness.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate complex product capabilities, use cases, and value propositions into clear, differentiated messaging that is relevant to distinct audiences without losing accuracy, nuance, or the product’s ambition.

  • Develop audience segmentation frameworks based on customer needs, behaviors, use cases, regions, industries, and stages of the customer journey.

  • Create audience-specific messaging and campaign strategies for groups such as creators, builders, professionals, students, consumers, and emerging-market users.

  • Lead cross-functional marketing programs end to end for defined audiences or initiatives, with minimal oversight, setting priorities across awareness, acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and advocacy.

  • Lead research efforts including customer interviews, surveys, social listening, competitive analysis, market trends, and behavioral data.

  • Turn research and performance signals into actionable audience personas, messaging frameworks, briefs, campaign recommendations, and market insights.

  • Identify cultural, regional, and language-specific opportunities across global markets, and help adapt global campaigns for local audiences while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

  • Develop go-to-market plans for new campaigns, product features, audience programs, partnerships, and market expansions.

  • Identify partnership opportunities with creators, developers, communities, platforms, industry groups, and other audience ecosystems.

  • Align partners across product marketing, growth, CRM, creative, analytics, partnerships, and regional marketing; resolve tradeoffs and shape creative direction to deliver coordinated customer journeys.

  • Measure campaign and audience performance, using data to improve messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, regional strategies, and future marketing investments.

  • Build reusable campaign processes and playbooks, and coach peers and junior teammates to improve planning, creative collaboration, and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, audience strategy, partnerships, or related fields.

  • Bring deep familiarity with AI products, foundation models, generative AI capabilities and limitations, and common user workflows; this is a critical qualification for the role.

  • Have experience translating complex technology and technical product capabilities into clear, compelling, differentiated customer value propositions.

  • Are a strategic thinker who can turn audience insight, cultural context, product strategy, and business goals into a compelling point of view and an actionable marketing system.

  • Can move fluidly between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution: building the framework, writing the brief, launching the program, and reviewing results.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with creators, developers, communities, partnerships, or other distinct customer segments.

  • Experience working across cultures, regions, or international markets.

  • Experience with experimentation, performance measurement, social listening, and translating signals into strategic recommendations.

  • Experience in consumer technology, emerging products, developer tools, enterprise products, or other fast-changing categories.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. jobs.title: Internal Communications Lead,  Enterprise & Growth
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. The Internal Communications team aims to create clarity, trust, and shared understanding that inspires our employees to do their best work. We partner across the company to craft clear, compelling narratives about what’s being built, why it matters, how it aligns to our strategy, and most importantly, how it advances our mission.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced internal communications leader to own the strategy for our Enterprise & Growth portfolio, spanning B2B, Revenue, Partnerships, Marketing, Enterprise Engineering, Ads, Commerce, and Consumer Verticals. These teams are changing how businesses operate, bringing AI into working life, and expanding access to its benefits. This work is central to our mission of ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity: helping people and businesses everywhere put AI to use in ways that improve their lives and livelihoods.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with executives to help employees understand where the business is going, why decisions are being made, and how their work ladders up. You will draw on a deep understanding of the teams you support and leverage strong relationships across the company to shape the communications approach and deliver the writing and programs that bring it to life.

A central part of this role is helping employees understand how our technology reaches people and businesses – and what we learn when they use it. You will bring user and customer experiences into companywide conversations, help employees understand the products and capabilities we’re building for businesses and the problems they solve, and help leaders communicate through rapid growth and change.

We’re looking for someone with sharp editorial instincts, boundless creative ambition, and the sound judgment to handle sensitive, confidential, and consequential work with care. You should be equally comfortable setting the communications direction, writing an executive message that addresses what’s on employees’ minds directly and transparently, and hosting a live conversation that invites candid questions and open discussion.

OpenAI is a unique and fast-moving working environment. Priorities can shift quickly, and important work often begins before every detail is settled. You will often need to get up to speed on unfamiliar topics, recommend a path with incomplete information, and adjust as decisions evolve. We’re looking for a pro who takes initiative, understands what matters to employees, and anticipates tough questions and pain points early enough to help leaders address them.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Set and deliver the communications strategy for Enterprise & Growth. Understand the portfolio’s priorities, identify where communications can make a difference, and lead programs from initial recommendation through execution and evaluation.

  • Advise senior leaders and shape their communications. Develop leadership updates, narratives, and presentations. Offer clear recommendations on framing, timing, and delivery, holding a high bar for accuracy, clarity, and transparency with employees.

  • Guide communications through complex and sensitive changes. Develop plans for leadership transitions, organizational changes, and evolving business priorities. Work with People, Legal, External Comms, and XFN partners to explain decisions, prepare leadership, and address questions employees are likely to have.

  • Lead company-wide user and customer storytelling. Build programs that show how people and organizations use our technology, how it benefits them, and what employees can learn from their experiences. Develop creative formats that bring these stories to life, encourage engagement, and spark new ideas for what we could build next.

  • Bring employee perspectives into communications decisions. Synthesize questions and feedback from Slack, leadership forums, and other channels. Help leaders understand where employees need more context, recommend responses, and assess whether communications are improving understanding, morale, and trust.

  • Keep work moving as priorities change. Move quickly, adapt as new information comes in, and keep everyone involved informed about decisions and next steps. Respond to feedback, adjust course without losing momentum, and bring a constructive, collaborative attitude to challenging moments.

  • Strengthen the broader Internal Communications function. Contribute to shared priorities, provide thoughtful ideas and feedback, and turn successful approaches into practices others can use.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in internal or executive communications, marketing communications, operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex communications programs. People Management experience (1-2 years minimum) is required.

  • Experience advising senior leaders. You have built trust through preparation, discretion, and thoughtful and strategic recommendations, and can navigate disagreement with confidence and utmost respect.

  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain business strategy and complicated decisions clearly, adapt to different leadership voices, and identify the details that make a message trustworthy and credible. You can produce strong work on a short timeline and incorporate detailed feedback without losing the purpose/“the why” of the message.

  • Curiosity about how businesses grow and how people use technology. You can connect commercial priorities, product developments, and customer experiences to our mission and the questions and themes employees care about.

We partner across the company to explain what’s being built, why it matters, and how it connects to our strategy and mission.

About the Role

We’re looking for an internal communications professional to help employees understand the work happening across OpenAI’s research and product organizations. You’ll translate technical developments, product milestones, and team priorities into clear, useful communications that connect people to the work and to one another.

Reporting to the Internal Communications lead for Research and Product, you’ll be the second member of the team dedicated to this part of OpenAI. You’ll independently own specific communications programs and projects within the broader strategy, build trusted relationships with technical teams, and identify stories and information employees need to hear. You’ll also help build practical processes that allow a small team to support a broad and fast-moving organization.

This role requires strong writing and editing skills, technical curiosity, and sound judgment. You should enjoy asking questions, making sense of complex information, and moving work forward independently, with guidance from your manager on broader strategy and sensitive issues.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own recurring communications programs that help employees understand research and product priorities, progress, and upcoming milestones.

  • Lead communications for defined projects and initiatives, developing plans, gathering input, drafting content, coordinating reviews, and managing delivery.

  • Translate complex technical and research concepts into accurate, accessible stories for employees with different levels of technical knowledge.

  • Build trusted relationships with researchers, product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to stay close to their work, identify important developments, and surface communication needs.

  • Write and edit content across internal channels, including leadership and org updates, Slack posts, FAQs, explainers, and All Hands materials.

  • Develop demos, research deep dives, and Q&A sessions that help employees hear directly from technical teams, including shaping content and preparing speakers.

  • Maintain and improve communications workflows, including editorial planning, templates, review processes, and shared resources that keep information timely and easy to find.

  • Use employee questions and feedback to improve communications, identifying gaps in understanding and recommending follow-up content or changes to format and cadence.

  • Partner with your manager on major announcements and organizational changes, owning defined workstreams and flagging sensitive issues, dependencies, and decisions that need leadership input.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in internal communications, product communications, journalism, or a related field, ideally with exposure to research or technical teams.

  • Bring strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and making information useful to the audience.

  • Have independently managed communications projects from planning through delivery, coordinating stakeholders and balancing competing deadlines.

  • Are curious about AI, research, and product development, and comfortable asking questions until you understand a topic well enough to explain it.

  • Build strong working relationships and can gather input, offer editorial guidance, and keep projects moving with busy partners.

  • Exercise sound judgment with sensitive information and ambiguity, and know when to make a decision independently or seek guidance.

jobs.title: Lab Operations Engineer, Systems Integration | Consumer Devices
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Guided by OpenAI’s mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, our team combines world-class researchers, engineers, designers, and operators who care deeply about creating useful, intuitive, and responsible technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside exceptional people on ambitious, zero-to-one challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI. This is a chance to help define an entirely new category of products—and shape how people experience AI in the future.

The Systems Integration team is critical in this mission, turning complex hardware-software development into reliable product signals. Lab Operations is the physical backbone of that work: we build and maintain the device fleets, test environments, and hardware-in-the-loop labs that let teams test repeatably, understand failures, and ship with confidence.

About the Role

As a Lab Operations Manager, Systems Integration, you will own the day-to-day operation of a large-scale consumer device test lab. This is a hands-on operations leadership role: you’ll keep device fleets, test rigs, lab infrastructure, inventory, provisioning, maintenance, and logistics running smoothly so engineers and QA technicians have reliable environments for validation and release testing.

We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, technically hands-on, comfortable with consumer electronics and lab equipment, and experienced operating complex physical test environments at scale. Because this is a new category of devices, you’ll have the opportunity to build the lab operating model early—shaping the systems, standards, and workflows that support products from prototype through launch.

In this role, you will:

  • Own device fleet and inventory: Manage configuration, deployment, tracking, lifecycle, and accurate asset records for a large fleet of consumer devices and test equipment; coordinate receiving, storage, checkout, shipping, transfers, spares, and secure disposal.

  • Operate and maintain the lab: Keep racks, benches, test rigs, cabling, power, networking, peripherals, and shared equipment reliable and organized; diagnose issues and coordinate repairs, replacements, and preventive maintenance.

  • Prepare devices for testing: Flash, provision, reset, configure, label, and assign devices to test environments.

  • Support testing and diagnostics: Partner with engineering and QA on large-scale test automation setups, failure reproduction, diagnostics collection, log capture, and environment resets.

  • Plan lab readiness and capacity: Track fleet health, rig availability, utilization, and upcoming test needs; identify constraints before they block testing.

  • Partner across teams: Work with hardware, systems, QA, reliability, IT, and infrastructure teams to keep the lab ready for development and release activities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track-record of operating or supporting a hardware, electronics, reliability, manufacturing, or QA test lab.

  • Hands-on experience managing fleets of consumer electronics, embedded devices, prototypes, or connected hardware.

  • Comfortable setting up, configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining devices, test rigs, networking, power systems, and peripherals across USB, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, power, and device connectivity.

You might thrive in this role if you:

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Within Finance, the Technical Revenue team partners with Product, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Growth, Legal, Deal Desk, GTM, Strategic Finance, Revenue Accounting, and Finance Systems to enable scalable, audit-ready monetization. We advise on commercial and contract design, establish defensible accounting positions under ASC 606, and translate those conclusions into repeatable processes, systems, controls, and reporting.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Revenue Recognition to lead revenue strategy and technical accounting for OpenAI’s strategic commercial deals.

Reporting to the Head of Technical Revenue, you will serve as the primary revenue advisor for large, bespoke, and non-standard deals outside OpenAI’s standard product and service offerings. Your portfolio may include strategic collaborations, cloud marketplaces, platform and distribution deals, licensing and revenue-share models, joint go-to-market initiatives, research collaborations, and other emerging commercial structures.

You will engage early in the deal lifecycle to help shape commercially viable, accounting-compliant, and operationally scalable outcomes. You will establish the accounting posture, identify required contract and product terms, define reporting and control requirements, and ensure that deal economics, billing flows, and revenue recognition remain aligned as the business evolves.

This role requires strong technical accounting judgment, commercial fluency, executive communication, and the ability to create clarity and ownership in areas where precedent may not yet exist.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own technical revenue accounting for strategic commercial deals, including large, bespoke, and non-standard transactions outside OpenAI’s standard product and service offerings.

  • Serve as the primary revenue advisor for strategic collaborations, cloud marketplaces, platform and distribution deals, licensing and revenue-share models, and other emerging commercial structures.

  • Partner early with Strategic Partnerships, Product, GTM, Strategic Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Tax to understand and influence deal economics, pricing, contract terms, and operational design.

  • Evaluate complex and ambiguous transactions under ASC 606, including principal-versus-agent considerations, gross-versus-net presentation, performance obligations, variable consideration, contract combinations, commitments, credits, incentives, and related-party considerations.

  • Translate technical conclusions into practical commercial guardrails and establish clear intake, escalation, and decision-making frameworks for material deals and amendments.

  • Define the data, reporting, billing, settlement, reconciliation, and control requirements needed to operationalize new commercial models and support accurate revenue recognition.

  • Draft audit-ready technical accounting memos and policies, lead discussions with external auditors, and clearly communicate conclusions and trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

  • Manage and develop team members and external resources, prioritize concurrent high-value deals, and strengthen the team’s ability to influence commercial decisions proactively.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of technical revenue accounting or related advisory experience, with deep ASC 606 expertise and experience leading complex workstreams or teams.

  • Significant experience supporting large, bespoke commercial deals, strategic collaborations, cloud marketplaces, platform distribution, licensing, revenue-share models, or other multi-party transactions.

  • A track record of influencing commercial strategy, pricing, product design, and contract terms before launch or signature.

  • Experience navigating emerging monetization models such as advertising revenue, marketplaces/commerce platforms, or other multi-sided ecosystems is a strong plus.

  • Strong command of principal-versus-agent analysis, gross-versus-net presentation, variable consideration, consideration payable to a customer, contract combinations, and complex performance-obligation assessments.

  • A track record of influencing commercial strategy, pricing, product design, and contract terms before launch or signature.

  • Experience translating evolving commercial models into scalable billing, accounting, reconciliation, reporting, systems, and control requirements.

  • Strong commercial judgment and executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting issues and practical trade-offs to senior non-accounting stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated success establishing ownership, governance, and repeatable processes in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments while developing team members and managing external resources.

  • CPA strongly preferred; a mix of Big 4 (or accounting advisory) and tech industry experience in high-growth environments is highly valued.

jobs.title: Lead Safety Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Robotics Safety Engineer to define and lead the product safety strategy for our robotics program. You will work closely with leadership, engineering, research, legal, and policy teams to ensure safety is integrated into our products from the earliest stages of development through deployment.

This role combines product safety, regulatory strategy, systems engineering, and risk management. You will help shape how we think about safety across robotic platforms, influence product architecture and development decisions, and ensure our systems are designed to meet both current and emerging regulatory expectations.

You will serve as a subject matter expert on robotics safety standards, regulatory frameworks, and safety engineering practices while helping establish the long-term safety strategy for our products and organization.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. This role will be expected to be in office 4 days per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will

  • Define and lead the product safety strategy for robotic systems across the development lifecycle.

  • Monitor and influence emerging regulatory frameworks, industry standards, and policy developments relevant to robotics and autonomous systems.

  • Partner with engineering teams to translate safety requirements into product architecture, design decisions, and engineering requirements.

  • Develop and maintain system-level hazard analyses, risk assessments, and safety cases for robotic products.

  • Establish safety requirements, verification strategies, and evidence-generation plans to support product development and future certification activities.

  • Collaborate with legal, policy, and leadership teams to assess regulatory risks and inform long-term product strategy.

  • Partner with hardware, software, controls, and research teams to identify hazards and develop mitigations throughout the development process.

  • Lead system-level hazard analyses, HARA activities, FMEAs, and other structured risk assessment processes to identify hazards, evaluate risks, and drive mitigation strategies throughout product development.

  • Represent the company in discussions with standards bodies, industry groups, regulators, and external safety experts when appropriate.

  • Help build and scale the safety engineering function as the robotics organization grows.

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Enjoy applying first-principles thinking to complex safety and risk management challenges.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity where regulations, standards, and technology are evolving simultaneously.

  • Can balance technical, regulatory, operational, and business considerations when making recommendations.

  • Enjoy working across disciplines and influencing engineering decisions without direct authority.

  • Are passionate about building products that are both innovative and demonstrably safe.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep expertise in product safety, functional safety, systems safety, robotics safety, or related disciplines.

  • Experience working with safety and regulatory frameworks such as ISO 10218, ISO 13849, IEC 61508, ISO 12100, ANSI/RIA standards, or comparable safety standards.

  • Experience developing hazard analyses, risk assessments, safety cases, or certification strategies for complex electromechanical systems.

  • Familiarity with robotics, autonomous systems, industrial equipment, consumer products, medical devices, automotive systems, aerospace systems, or other safety-critical technologies.

  • Experience working with regulators, standards organizations, certification bodies, or industry working groups.

jobs.title: Lead, Ads Prospecting & Customer Intelligence
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are hiring a Lead, Ads Prospecting & Growth Intelligence to build the intelligence and orchestration platform powering OpenAI’s ads business. This person will help us identify the right companies and people, understand why they are relevant, determine the right next action, and learn from what happens afterward.

Own the prospecting function for the ads business, serving SMB Ads while building a foundation reusable across segments. Set the vision, operating model, roadmap, platform choices, business rules, adoption, and outcomes; and partner with Ads Engineering, Data Science, and internal platform teams. Decide what to build in-house, enable through internal platforms, or deliver through selected vendors and partners.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead the function’s strategy, roadmap, operating model, and adoption. Connect platform investments to measurable advertiser and business outcomes.

  • Define a unified prospect, account, contact, and advertiser data model. Establish standards for identity, data quality, provenance, freshness, confidence, and consent.

  • Combine market, intent, behavioral, product, CRM, campaign, and customer-success signals to improve targeting and customer engagement.

  • Design enrichment and verification workflows. Evaluate in-house capabilities, platforms, vendors, APIs, AI, and human review to select effective solutions.

  • Develop scoring and next-best-action models using customer fit, intent, activity, reachability, lifecycle stage, and growth potential.

  • Connect intelligence to action across sales, marketing, product, paid media, partners, and lifecycle journeys through coordinated routing and activation.

  • Enable marketers to create audiences, configure triggered journeys, run experiments, and execute campaigns through intuitive systems with quality checks and approvals.

  • Build feedback loops that use outreach, engagement, conversion, spend, retention, churn, and customer-success outcomes to improve targeting and lifecycle decisions.

  • Measure data quality, coverage, targeting accuracy, deliverability, conversion, and incremental value. Establish permissions, suppression, auditability, and provider-performance standards.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Bring substantial experience building go-to-market systems, customer-data products, growth platforms, lifecycle infrastructure, revenue systems, or marketing technology.

  • Demonstrate ownership of platforms that connect data, decisions, and workflows to measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Apply strong product judgment to prioritize opportunities, define useful solutions, and sequence delivery.

  • Translate identity resolution, enrichment, scoring, segmentation, routing, experimentation, and feedback loops into clear system requirements.

  • Design practical solutions with marketers and sales teams, grounded in their campaign and customer workflows.

  • Explore data and test ideas with tools such as analytics platforms, SQL, APIs, automation, or AI-assisted prototyping. Production engineering experience is not required.

  • Evaluate build, buy, and integration choices across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, and campaign-execution systems.

  • Lead a small team and build alignment with senior cross-functional partners.

  • Apply sound judgment to privacy, consent, deliverability, data rights, governance, and customer trust.

  • Bring relevant experience in advertising, SMB or self-serve businesses, product-led SaaS, marketplaces, commerce, fintech, enterprise go-to-market, or other multi-segment customer journeys.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building prospecting or customer intelligence platforms for advertising, SMB, or self-serve businesses.

  • Track record combining customer and intent data to improve targeting and conversion.

  • Experience deploying enrichment, scoring, and next-best-action models across marketing and sales.

  • Experience integrating data vendors, CRM, marketing automation, and customer data platforms.

  • Hands-on experience using SQL, APIs, automation, or AI to validate growth solutions.

  • Experience building feedback loops and governance practices that improve performance, data quality, and trust.

Workplace & Location

  • San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
