jobs.title: Product Designer, Accessibility
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Design Systems team creates the foundations that help teams across OpenAI build coherent, high-quality experiences at scale.

Accessibility is fundamental to that work. We’re building the shared standards, components, tools, and practices that make inclusive experiences the default across OpenAI’s products and platforms.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll lead OpenAI’s company-wide accessibility program from within the Design Foundations team within Product Design. You’ll pair strategy and organizational influence with hands-on product design (visual and interaction design) —advocating for disabled people, removing barriers across complete customer journeys, and establishing durable ownership throughout the company.

This is an opportunity to define accessibility for a new generation of products spanning web, mobile, desktop, voice, AI, and hardware. You’ll help teams consider the many ways people perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with technology, going beyond minimum compliance to create experiences that are genuinely useful and inclusive.

Working across design, engineering, research, product, go-to-market, and legal, you’ll make accessibility an expected part of product quality—not a final review or the responsibility of a single expert.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role you will:

  • Design and ship product experiences while identifying systemic barriers across complete customer journeys.

  • Define OpenAI’s accessibility strategy, roadmap, governance, priorities, and measures of progress.

  • Build accessibility into our design system through inclusive components, tokens, interaction patterns, Figma libraries, documentation, and engineering guardrails.

  • Center disabled people through participatory research, usability studies, and assistive-technology testing rather than relying solely on assumptions, simulations, or automated tools.

  • Design for permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities, including multiple ways to perceive information, navigate interfaces, understand content, and complete important tasks.

  • Establish practical standards for screen readers, keyboard navigation, focus, reading order, contrast, typography, motion, captions, forms, errors, and multimodal interactions.

  • Lead accessibility audits, remediation priorities, launch readiness, and continuous validation across platforms.

  • Partner with go-to-market, legal, compliance, and product teams on enterprise readiness, accessibility documentation, procurement needs, and customer commitments.

  • Grow company-wide capability through training, critiques, engineering partnerships, and a network of accessibility champions.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Pair deep accessibility expertise with a very high bar for design craft: strong interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and prototyping skills

  • Have led accessibility or inclusive-design work across multiple teams, products, or platforms.

  • Understand the relationship between accessibility, usability, and inclusive design—and know when to go beyond standards to meet real human needs.

  • Have deep practical knowledge of WCAG, assistive technologies, accessible interaction design, and platform-specific standards.

  • Have embedded accessibility into design systems, reusable components, and engineering workflows.

  • Have worked directly with disabled people and translated their experiences into meaningful product and organizational decisions.

  • Can identify assumptions and exclusion within a product journey, then turn those insights into clearer and more flexible ways to interact.

  • Are equally effective setting strategy, designing detailed experiences, and collaborating with engineers through implementation.

  • Can influence across disciplines without direct authority, creating shared accountability without becoming a centralized approval gate.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Consumer Verticals team explores how ChatGPT can become meaningfully more useful in important areas of people’s lives, including health, finance, and emerging agentic experiences.

We work across research, engineering, product, design, and domain experts to turn increasingly capable models into intuitive, trustworthy consumer products. Our work combines the reach of ChatGPT with the depth required to serve distinct user needs responsibly.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll lead the end-to-end design of new consumer experiences across emerging verticals. You’ll explore how ChatGPT should adapt to different contexts, translate complex model capabilities into clear product interactions, and establish patterns that can scale across multiple domains.

This is a highly generative, zero-to-one role. You’ll move between broad product vision and detailed interaction design, creating prototypes that help teams learn quickly and polished experiences that are ready to ship. You’ll also navigate domains where trust, accuracy, safety, and user agency are essential.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Shape the product and design direction for purpose-built consumer experiences across areas such as health, finance, and general consumer agents.

  • Design and ship high-quality products from early concepts and prototypes through detailed interaction design and final visual execution.

  • Define how ChatGPT should behave in different domains while preserving a coherent, distinctly OpenAI experience.

  • Explore new interaction models for AI systems that can understand context, support complex decisions, and take action on a user’s behalf.

  • Partner closely with research, engineering, product management, safety, and domain experts to turn technical capabilities into useful and responsible products.

  • Conduct and apply user research to understand the distinct needs, expectations, and risks within each vertical.

  • Balance specialized domain requirements with reusable patterns that can strengthen ChatGPT and accelerate future product development.

  • Contribute to OpenAI’s broader design culture and raise the bar for consumer product craft.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have substantial experience designing and shipping high-quality consumer software at scale.

  • Bring exceptional UX, UI, and interaction design skills, with a high bar for craft in every stage of the work.

  • Are a highly generative product thinker who can explore broadly, develop a strong point of view, and turn ambiguity into clear product direction.

  • Have led zero-to-one initiatives or introduced new product categories, behaviors, or interaction models.

  • Can simplify complex systems without hiding the details users need to make informed decisions.

  • Have strong instincts for trust, safety, transparency, and user control—particularly in consequential or sensitive experiences.

  • Can move fluently between domain-specific problems and broader systems or platform thinking.

  • Communicate through compelling narratives and prototypes that build alignment across design, research, product, and engineering.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Engineering Acceleration
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Engineering Acceleration team builds products that multiply the effectiveness of OpenAI’s technical teams, helping engineers, researchers, and product teams understand complex systems, learn from what they ship, and operate reliably at scale.

As AI changes how software is built, we have an opportunity to rethink engineering workflows from first principles. We’re creating tools and shared systems that turn complex data, experimentation, and technical workflows into clear decisions and useful action.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll lead design across two connected product areas: a real-time data exploration and observability experience for investigating large-scale system and product behavior, and an experimentation platform for safely launching changes, measuring their impact, and deciding whether to ramp, iterate, or roll back.

This is more than a dashboard-design role. You’ll define the interaction models that take someone from a vague question or unexpected signal to a trustworthy answer and clear next step. You’ll work closely with engineers, researchers, data scientists, and product teams to understand the mechanics of their work and make dense technical systems coherent without flattening the details that matter.

You’ll also help establish greater consistency across OpenAI’s enterprise and internal tools, developing durable patterns that support AI-native workflows and enable other designers to build more effectively.

This role is based in our Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA offices. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end design for data-intensive products used by engineers, researchers, and product teams.

  • Shape the complete learning loop: instrument, launch, observe, investigate, evaluate, decide, and iterate.

  • Create clear, high-craft workflows for querying, filtering, comparison, drill-down, visualization, alerting, and sharing.

  • Make complex concepts—including data freshness, coverage, reliability, uncertainty, experiment assignment, metric validity, rollout state, and regressions—understandable and actionable.

  • Partner closely with engineering, data science, research, and product management to translate deeply technical infrastructure into elegant, coherent product experiences.

  • Use prototyping, research, and rigorous design exploration to establish interaction patterns for emerging technical and AI-native workflows.

  • Define shared systems and patterns that create consistency across OpenAI’s enterprise and internal tools.

  • Establish a high bar for information architecture, visual hierarchy, interaction quality, and craft across complex, multi-surface products.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have substantial experience owning data products, observability platforms, experimentation systems, analytics products, developer tools, AI/ML tooling, or similarly technical workflows.

  • Are a strong product and systems thinker who can set direction in an ambiguous space and make durable interaction and platform decisions.

  • Can make dense information feel calm, legible, and useful without oversimplifying important complexity.

  • Are technically fluent, enjoy learning how underlying systems work, and can build credibility with engineers and other highly technical users.

  • Have strong instincts for trust and understand how provenance, reliability, uncertainty, permissions, and edge cases affect whether people act on a system’s output.

  • Have redesigned workflows spanning multiple tools, products, or surfaces and can create coherence across a broader ecosystem.

  • Have strong UX/UI and interaction design skills, with a high bar for contemporary visual craft and information design.

  • Can demonstrate how your work changed product decisions, accelerated learning, or improved the velocity of the teams you supported.

  • Enjoy staying close to detailed workflows and hands-on design while helping shape a broader product vision.

  • Are excited to define how engineers and AI agents will build, evaluate, and improve software together.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Higher Education
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Education team is focused on making AI safe, useful, and empowering for students, faculty, and institutions.

Our work spans core learning experiences, course-based tools, and campus-wide product solutions. We’re also exploring how OpenAI’s technology can support colleges and universities, educators, teaching and research, and collaborative learning.

About the Role

We’re looking for a staff-level product designer to shape how students and educators engage with AI and help define OpenAI’s emerging higher education experiences. You’ll work across immediate product needs and ambitious zero-to-one opportunities, from core learning and course experiences to campus-wide tools for teaching, research, and collaboration.

A high craft bar is imperative. You’ll be expected to pair exceptional interaction and visual design with deep product thinking—turning complex questions around safety, learning, and institutional needs into experiences that feel clear, trustworthy, and engaging.

This is a highly generative role for someone who can move from early exploration to concrete, high-fidelity product direction. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, research, safety, policy, and design to establish durable patterns for a space that is still being defined.

In this role, you will:

  • Establish an exceptionally high standard for craft across OpenAI’s higher education experiences.

  • Lead end-to-end design for products that help students, faculty, and campus staff use AI safely, confidently, and productively.

  • Design clear, trustworthy experiences for learning, course participation, and campus-wide use, including sensitive or high-trust interactions.

  • Shape zero-to-one higher education experiences spanning colleges and universities, educators, courses, collaborative work, and builder-style workflows.

  • Turn emerging ideas into compelling concepts, prototypes, and high-fidelity product experiences that teams can evaluate and build.

  • Partner with research, engineering, product, safety, policy, and design to balance user needs, technical capabilities, and responsible deployment.

  • Conduct and apply research with relevant users and partners to understand the needs of students, faculty, campus staff, and institutions.

  • Develop reusable patterns and principles that create coherence across core learning, course, and campus-wide products as the area grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft and are motivated to raise the quality of design across OpenAI.

  • Are a highly generative designer who explores broadly, iterates deeply, and turns ideas into concrete, polished product direction.

  • Pair strong craft with deep product and systems thinking.

  • Have led substantial, ambiguous, or zero-to-one product areas and can help shape both vision and execution.

  • Can design thoughtful experiences for sensitive, high-trust, or safety-critical contexts.

  • Understand how to create products that are engaging and intuitive without compromising safety or clarity.

  • Can navigate the needs of multiple audiences, including students, faculty, campus staff, administrators, and institutional partners.

  • Communicate clearly, build alignment across disciplines, and remain hands-on throughout the product-development process.

  • Are energized by the opportunity to define how AI can support learning while serving higher education communities responsibly.

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Payments team works across product, engineering, design, and finance to build the financial infrastructure that makes OpenAI’s products accessible to consumers and enterprises around the world. As AI introduces new ways for people and organizations to work, the team is defining how to support and monetize emerging forms of product usage, from usage-based pricing to agentic work. We’re building the foundational systems that help OpenAI products deliver clear, reliable, and scalable payment experiences while ensuring that this powerful technology is deployed responsibly.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll lead design for one of OpenAI’s most foundational product areas: the payments and monetization infrastructure that supports our consumer and enterprise products. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams to shape how customers understand, manage, and pay for entirely new kinds of AI usage. Your work will extend beyond traditional checkout and billing. You’ll help define the systems, frameworks, and experiences behind durable pay-as-you-go models, Codex usage, and agentic workflows, translating complex business and technical requirements into intuitive experiences. As a product designer in a highly ambiguous and rapidly evolving space, you’ll influence both product strategy and the underlying infrastructure that OpenAI products depend on.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design direction for foundational payments, billing, and monetization experiences across OpenAI’s consumer and enterprise products.

  • Design and ship high-quality, end-to-end product experiences, from early systems and interaction concepts to high-fidelity prototypes and production-ready designs.

  • Shape the infrastructure and product frameworks that support emerging AI usage models, including pay-as-you-go, Codex usage, and agentic work.

  • Partner closely with engineering, product management, finance, and design peers to define long-term platform strategy, influence the roadmap, and prioritize near-term execution.

  • Translate complex platform dependencies, financial logic, and technical constraints into clear, trustworthy, and scalable user experiences.

  • Engage in user research to understand how individuals and organizations evaluate pricing, track usage, manage billing, and make purchasing decisions.

  • Contribute to and evolve the design systems, patterns, and principles that bring consistency to payments and monetization across OpenAI products.

  • Help establish the design culture for a growing, foundational product area.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a strong systems thinker who can connect user experiences to the underlying platform, business logic, and technical architecture.

  • Have experience designing complex, infrastructure-adjacent, platform, or enterprise product experiences.

  • Have strong UX/UI and interaction design skills, with a high bar for quality, clarity, and craft.

  • Are comfortable leading an ambiguous product area, developing a clear vision, and shaping a roadmap alongside product and engineering partners.

  • Can explain complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to technical, business, and design stakeholders.

  • Enjoy solving problems where scalability, reliability, and long-term product coherence matter as much as the immediate user experience.

  • Are excited by defining how customers understand and pay for emerging AI products and behaviors.

  • Have experience with payments, billing, pricing, monetization, or usage-based products, or are eager to apply strong platform-design experience to those challenges.

  • Can work within, improve, and contribute to a shared design system.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Youth
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Youth team is focused on making AI safe, useful, and empowering for young people.

Our work spans foundational protections—including age assurance and always-on safety—as well as new learning and education experiences. We’re also exploring how OpenAI’s technology can support K–12 schools, educators, classrooms, and collaborative learning.

About the Role

We’re looking for a staff-level product designer to shape how young people safely engage with AI and help define OpenAI’s emerging education experiences. You’ll work across immediate product needs and ambitious zero-to-one opportunities, from age-appropriate safety systems to tools for learning and group work.

A high craft bar is imperative. You’ll be expected to pair exceptional interaction and visual design with deep product thinking—turning complex questions around safety, learning, and institutional needs into experiences that feel clear, trustworthy, and engaging.

This is a highly generative role for someone who can move from early exploration to concrete, high-fidelity product direction. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, research, safety, policy, and design to establish durable patterns for a space that is still being defined.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role you will:

  • Establish an exceptionally high standard for craft across OpenAI’s youth and education experiences.

  • Lead end-to-end design for products that help young people use AI safely, confidently, and productively.

  • Design clear, age-appropriate experiences for safety, age assurance, and other sensitive or high-trust interactions.

  • Shape zero-to-one K–12 experiences spanning school districts, educators, classrooms, collaborative work, and builder-style workflows.

  • Turn emerging ideas into compelling concepts, prototypes, and high-fidelity product experiences that teams can evaluate and build.

  • Partner with research, engineering, product, safety, policy, and design to balance user needs, technical capabilities, and responsible deployment.

  • Conduct and apply research with relevant users and partners to understand the needs of young people, educators, and institutions.

  • Develop reusable patterns and principles that create coherence across youth and education products as the area grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft and are motivated to raise the quality of design across OpenAI.

  • Are a highly generative designer who explores broadly, iterates deeply, and turns ideas into concrete, polished product direction.

  • Pair strong craft with deep product and systems thinking.

  • Have led substantial, ambiguous, or zero-to-one product areas and can help shape both vision and execution.

  • Can design thoughtful experiences for sensitive, high-trust, or safety-critical contexts.

  • Understand how to create products that are engaging and intuitive without compromising safety or clarity.

  • Can navigate the needs of multiple audiences, including young people, educators, administrators, and institutional partners.

  • Communicate clearly, build alignment across disciplines, and remain hands-on throughout the product-development process.

  • Are energized by the opportunity to define how AI can support learning while serving young people responsibly.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Product Engineer, Cyber
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

We are building the Defense Factory to help enterprises find and fix security vulnerabilities with AI. We build infrastructure that enables AI agents to work in secure, customer-controlled cloud environments, with the context, tools, and controls they need to investigate security findings, carry out approved actions, and verify results.

Our focus is turning AI capabilities into reliable security outcomes, starting with finding and fixing vulnerabilities and expanding into investigation, detection, and response. That means solving challenging problems in cloud environments, orchestration, security, and collaboration, while making the experience straightforward for the people directing and reviewing the work.

We’re a team that values initiative, close relationships with customers, and exceptional engineering craft. We take ownership, learn quickly, and communicate directly and kindly.

About the Role

We’re hiring backend-focused Product Engineers across our platform and security product teams. You’ll build infrastructure and customer-facing workflows that let developers and AI agents work reliably in parallel.

You’ll work primarily in Go on APIs, complex networking, development environments, and orchestration for long-running tasks. You’ll own outcomes from understanding a user’s problem and choosing an approach through shipping, operating, and improving the solution, working closely with frontend, infrastructure, and security engineers.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with customers to build developer and security workflows, from getting a project running to investigating findings, reviewing agent-generated changes, and verifying fixes.

  • Build Go services and APIs for provisioning cloud environments, running agents in customer infrastructure, and integrating with source control, CI, and other developer tools.

  • Design reliable orchestration for long-running, parallel work, including durable state, retries, cancellation, and recovery.

  • Build security into execution workflows through clear permissions, credential handling, isolation, and auditability.

  • Own production quality: testing, safe rollouts, observability, performance, and operational reliability.

  • Partner with frontend and design colleagues to make complex backend capabilities straightforward to use.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have strong Go skills and experience building and operating production backend systems.

  • Understand distributed systems, concurrency, and state, and can reason about failures and recovery.

  • Have practical experience with Linux, containers, cloud infrastructure, and networking, including routing, DNS, and secure connectivity.

  • Can design clear APIs and data models that simplify complex workflows.

  • Are product-minded and want to stay close to customers, understand their needs, and own solutions from problem discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly and work effectively across disciplines and locations.

Experience building on AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus. Depth in one or more of developer platforms, workflow engines, Kubernetes, networking, sandboxing, identity systems, security products, or AI-agent workflows would be useful; we don’t expect expertise across all of them. Frontend experience is welcome but not required.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Full Stack - Agents
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

We're building the foundation for a new kind of AI coworker: persistent agents that have their own environments, can meet people wherever they work, and continue making progress for as long as a task requires. Our goal is to help individuals, teams, and organizations delegate meaningful work to AI—not just ask questions or complete a single turn.

Our work brings together product, agent, and infrastructure capabilities across OpenAI. Together, we are creating always-on virtual coworkers that can carry context across tasks, operate through the right tools and channels, and deliver reliable results in real workplace environments.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full stack product engineer to shape how people discover, direct, and collaborate with AI coworkers. You’ll own product experiences end to end, spending roughly equal time building intuitive frontend surfaces and the backend systems that make agentic workflows persistent, reliable, and useful.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, design, agent capabilities, and enterprise readiness—turning rapidly evolving model and platform capabilities into experiences customers can understand, trust, and use every day.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and ship full stack product experiences that help people and teams delegate meaningful work to persistent AI coworkers.

  • Create intuitive frontend interfaces for directing agents, reviewing their progress, understanding their actions, and collaborating on the work they produce.

  • Build backend APIs, services, and data models that support persistent agent state, asynchronous execution, orchestration, and progress reporting.

  • Develop workflows that help agents access relevant context, use tools, and collaborate with people across workplace surfaces and channels.

  • Partner with product, design, research, and engineering teams to turn shared capabilities into cohesive products.

  • Build trust into the product through clear user controls, understandable agent behavior, safe execution, and reliable operational foundations.

  • Use customer feedback, product insight, and rapid iteration to identify high-value workflows and improve how AI coworkers deliver useful results.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years of professional full-stack or product engineering experience, ideally building user-facing products in product-driven or enterprise environments.

  • A track record of shipping polished user-facing products and production backend systems with meaningful ownership across the full stack.

  • Strong frontend skills with TypeScript, React, and modern web application development, including a thoughtful approach to interaction design and usability.

  • Experience building backend services, APIs, data models, and production systems in Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, or similar languages.

  • Strong product judgment and comfort taking ambiguous customer problems from concept through implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Experience designing software for complex workflows, collaboration, enterprise users, developer tools, or other trust-sensitive product environments.

  • Ability to reason about asynchronous work, stateful systems, reliability, performance, security, and the tradeoffs required to deliver a great user experience.

  • Proven ability to work closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and engineers across multiple teams.

  • High agency, strong execution, and enthusiasm for building new products in a fast-moving environment.

  • Interest in AI agents and the future of work; experience with agentic systems, enterprise software, or early-stage products is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: Product Manager, API Agents
jobs.description_html:
About the Team:

The OpenAI API team builds the foundation that enables every developer to harness OpenAI’s models safely, reliably, and at scale. Our mission is to make it effortless for any developer to build transformative products with OpenAI’s models. We’re responsible for the infrastructure and product layers that allow millions of developers to integrate our models, fine-tune behavior, manage data, and deliver experiences to their users. We collaborate deeply across product, research, and engineering teams to drive innovation at the model layer and then directly translate that into value for customers.

About the Role:

As the Agents Product Manager for the API team, you'll be at the forefront of defining and guiding the future of how developers build agentic applications on top of our AI models. You’ll set clear priorities and drive impactful improvements to model capabilities, balancing user needs, safety considerations, and technical innovation. This role is perfect for a proactive, technically adept PM who thrives on solving challenging, ambiguous problems through structured product thinking and close collaboration with customers, engineers, and researchers.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

About the Team:

The OpenAI API team builds the foundation that enables every developer to harness OpenAI’s models safely, reliably, and at scale. We design and operate the systems that power model serving, API access, billing, developer tooling, and enterprise integrations—forming the connective tissue between OpenAI’s research breakthroughs and real-world products.

Our mission is to make it effortless for anyone to build with OpenAI technology. We’re responsible for the infrastructure and product layers that allow millions of developers to integrate GPT models, fine-tune behavior, manage data, and deliver transformative experiences to their users. We collaborate across product, research, and engineering teams to ensure that innovation in model capabilities translates directly into value for customers.

The API team spans multiple disciplines, including product management, infrastructure engineering, developer experience, and data systems. We care deeply about reliability, scalability, and simplicity—creating tools that let developers focus on their ideas while we handle the complexity of running world-class AI systems.

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and scale the construction of our data processing, data privacy, billing, and access controls products. You will set strategy and execute on projects like expanding our regional data processing footprint, enabling new inference caching controls in the API or building APIs that make it easier for organizations to manage their spend limits. You will also define the strategy and ship foundational capabilities that ensure customers use OpenAI products securely, privately, and with enterprise-grade controls. This role partners deeply with engineering, security, legal, compliance, finance and leadership to deliver high-trust, enterprise-grade systems.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Develop an enterprise data control plane to securely access and manage enterprise data for LLM use

  • Drive product strategy for safety controls, privacy features, access management, and API usage/cost visibility.

  • Build and improve data governance capabilities: retention, encryption, audit logs, permissions, and lifecycle management.

  • Lead development of access control models, identity flows (SSO/SAML, SCIM), and admin tooling.

  • Oversee usage metering, cost dashboards, alerts, budgeting tools, and predictable API cost experiences.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience in security, privacy, data infrastructure, or usage-based platform products.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, access controls, and enterprise identity.

  • Experience with usage metering, cost-management tooling, or billing-adjacent systems.

  • Ability to work across security, legal, engineering, compliance, and finance domains.

  • Strong systems thinking, analytical skills, and comfort operating in high-risk, high-trust areas.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Models
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Core Models team helps shape how OpenAI’s frontier models are built, measured, and launched. We work across Research, Engineering, Model Design, Data Science, and Product to turn advances in model capabilities into reliable, useful experiences for people. Our scope includes model planning and launches as well as building data flywheels, evaluations and measurement systems to ensure our models have strong capabilities and behavior.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for the Core Models team, you'll be at the forefront of defining and guiding the future of how our AI models work in real-world applications. You will connect user needs to model and systems decisions: how prompts are understood; how information is aggregated and made useful for training and evaluation data; and how capabilities move from research prototypes into the mainline model and launch stack. You will operate comfortably across research, infrastructure, and consumer product surfaces, creating clarity where ownership and technical boundaries are still emerging.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate user and product goals into clear model requirements, system architecture choices, and research priorities across query understanding, indexing, retrieval, ranking, tool boundaries, data, training, inference, and evaluation.

  • Build closed learning loops that turn product usage, explicit feedback, and other user signals into datasets, evaluations, experiments, training priorities, and launch decisions.

  • Define success across offline evaluations and online product metrics, balancing model quality, usefulness, latency, safety, reliability, and cost.

  • Partner closely with post-training research, applied product engineering, Model Design, and Data Science to integrate capabilities into the mainline model stack.

  • Create reusable platforms and operating systems for evaluation, experimentation, and signal collection so that new capabilities improve faster over time.

  • Use concrete product failures and emerging user needs to identify gaps, form hypotheses, and shape the next wave of research and product investment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have deep expertise in product management or closely related experience, including ownership of technically complex products or platforms.

  • Bring deep fluency in one or more relevant domains: search and information retrieval, recommendation or personalization systems, ML platforms, large-scale data systems, model evaluation, or AI product infrastructure.

  • Know how to pair offline evaluation with online experimentation and user signals, and can distinguish a useful metric from a convenient one.

  • Earn the trust of researchers and engineers through technical depth, crisp judgment, and a willingness to engage directly with the details.

  • Combine consumer product taste with systems rigor, and care about both the quality people feel and the infrastructure that makes it repeatable.

  • Move quickly in ambiguous environments, communicate directly, and help teams make sound decisions without waiting for perfect information.

  • Care deeply about how increasingly capable models affect people, and bring humility, judgment, and a strong sense of responsibility to the work.

About the Team:

About the Team: Our team brings OpenAI’s most capable technology to the world through our products. We've released ChatGPT, GPT6-Astra, and Codex. We empower consumers and developers alike to use and access our state-of-the-art AI models, allowing them to do things that they’ve never been able to before.

Across OpenAI’s enterprise product suite, it is critical to offer organizations the technology to securely establish, connect, and manage people and non-human identities across OpenAI products. The Enterprise Identity team builds shared identity foundations and enterprise controls for authentication and federation, provisioning and lifecycle, secure access, session management and revocation, administration, auditability, and access visibility so identity and access can be governed consistently across products. We build the foundational systems that enable organizations to adopt OpenAI products with confidence.. Our work underpins enterprise security, IT integration, and the safe deployment of AI at scale, making sure the right people have the right access at the right time.

We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager for OpenAI’s Enterprise Identity product efforts. You will lead efforts to deliver critical capabilities such as SSO, SCIM, and identity federation across all OpenAI products, enabling enterprises to securely manage users, data, and access in complex organizational environments.

This role requires close collaboration with engineering, security, GTM, and customer-facing teams to ensure our identity systems meet the needs of organizations ranging from high-growth startups to the world’s largest enterprises. Your work will directly enable safe, large-scale enterprise adoption of frontier AI.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Financial Services
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI is building AI products for serious professional work. We’re going deep on finance with a committed team focused on unlocking the potential of AI in this vertical: working closely with industry experts and users to build bespoke solutions that help finance professionals do real work.

OpenAI’s Financial Services team works closely with customers to understand where AI can improve the economics and quality of financial work: faster diligence, broader research coverage, sharper client materials, more accurate models, and better investment analysis. Our work spans workflows across investment banking, equity research, private equity, asset management, wealth management, insurance, and other parts of finance. We bring together OpenAI’s models, financial data, and enterprise knowledge to build products that fit how financial professionals work.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build OpenAI’s financial services products. Reporting to the GM of Financial Services, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key experiences, taking them from customer discovery and early prototypes through launch, adoption, and iteration. This is a hands-on role. You will spend time with bankers, investors, analysts, and other finance professionals; build and test early product experiences; and work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and customer-facing teams to ship. You should have strong judgment about both the product experience and the work it produces. You will also form a vision for how AI can change the financial services space and can translate that into product execution.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product strategy and priorities. Work with the GM to identify the most valuable customer problems and translate them into a clear roadmap. Make decisions about what to build, what to defer, and where partners or shared OpenAI capabilities can best meet the need.

  • Go deep on financial workflows. Sit with customers, observe how they work, and understand the documents they create, data they trust, tools they use, and standards they apply. Use those insights to design experiences that customers return to in their daily work.

  • Build and ship. Create working prototypes, demos, example outputs, and product requirements using Codex and other OpenAI tools. Partner with Engineering and Design to turn early concepts into reliable products, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery through launch and iteration.

  • Raise the bar for quality and trust. Work with Research and Engineering to turn real finance tasks and product failures into evaluations, datasets, and model feedback. Define what good looks like across accuracy, source traceability, completeness, and ease of review, while making practical tradeoffs across quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

  • Make products work inside financial institutions. Translate integration, data-access, privacy, security, and review requirements into product decisions. Work across Legal, Security, Partnerships, and core product teams to address deployment barriers and determine which needs require finance-specific solutions.

  • Measure results and drive adoption. Define success through task completion, output acceptance, repeat usage, time saved, and business impact. Combine product data, evaluations, and customer feedback to guide investment. Partner with GTM and customer-facing teams on pilots, onboarding, and launches, then use what you learn to improve the product.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a track record of taking complex products from discovery through launch and sustained adoption, as a product manager, founder, or builder with substantial product ownership.

  • Understand financial work well enough to earn credibility with demanding practitioners. You may have built products for financial institutions or worked directly in investment banking, investing, equity research, corporate development, or related fields.

  • Combine strong product taste with attention to detail. You care about making complex workflows feel simple and can judge both the experience and the quality of its outputs.

  • Work comfortably with engineers and researchers on model behavior, data quality, integrations, and evaluations. You can distinguish a model limitation from a data, workflow, or product-design problem.

  • Use AI deeply in your own work and build prototypes to test ideas. You are willing to teach, onboard, debug, and inspect outputs alongside customers.

  • Know how to choose useful goals and metrics, test assumptions, and change priorities when the evidence changes.

  • Bring sound judgment about privacy, trust, and accuracy in consequential professional work.

  • Take ownership in ambiguous situations, drive decisions across teams you do not manage, and communicate clearly. You can set direction and stay close to the details required to ship.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The Integrity team builds the systems OpenAI uses to understand, prevent, and respond to misuse across our products. We partner with Product, Policy, Safety Systems, User Operations, Security, Legal, Privacy, OpenAI for Government, and research teams to turn policy and threat models into product controls, review workflows, measurement systems, and enforcement paths.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Integrity's product strategy for sensitive deployments: contexts where model capability, customer or deployment setting, privacy constraints, and misuse potential make the operating bar unusually high. This includes government and other high stakes deployments, regulated or high-trust enterprise contexts, zero data retention and privacy-constrained environments, and agentic workflows where harm can unfold across many steps rather than a single prompt.

The Integrity PM will focus on high-consequence use cases relevant to government deployments and broader deployment-readiness questions for high-risk domains (e.g., healthcare), while building reusable Integrity capabilities for agentic detection and enforcements in these environments.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the roadmap for sensitive deployment Integrity controls and readiness criteria.

  • Define how we measure residual risk, decision quality, review quality, and mitigation effectiveness.

  • Build agentic investigation and context-assembly workflows for complex, multi-step misuse patterns.

  • Partner with Policy, Legal, Privacy, Safety Systems, User Ops, Government, and product teams to build shared capabilities.

  • Create launch and deployment playbooks for sensitive customer, capability, and product contexts.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have shipped complex product systems in AI, integrity, trust and safety, security, privacy, risk, government, regulated enterprise, or AI safety.

  • Can turn ambiguous policy and threat-model questions into product requirements, metrics, operational workflows, and tradeoff frameworks.

  • Are energized by agentic AI products and want to build the platform layer that makes them safer to deploy.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Learning
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The ChatGPT product team is a rapidly evolving, high-impact group within OpenAI that builds intuitive, safe, and useful AI-powered experiences for millions of people worldwide. Our team brings together engineering, design, research, and product to explore how conversational AI can help people learn, create, and solve problems.

AI has the potential to transform how millions of people learn, teach, and achieve their goals. Learning is one of the top use cases on ChatGPT— not only for students, but also for adults building new skills in a rapidly changing world. The Education team is focused on advancing how humans learn with AI and working to make high-quality learning accessible. We aim to deliver measurable gains in cognition and achievement, partnering closely with students, educators, and country leaders to ensure new tools are safe, effective, and trusted.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Education & Learning, you will shape the strategy and build products to advance learning experiences in ChatGPT— defining a category that could reshape classrooms, careers, and lifelong learning. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners—from AI research to design to go-to-market—to build ChatGPT into a true learning agent and ensure those products you build meet the needs of stakeholders throughout the ecosystem. You will also partner closely with product teams across growth, youth well-being, and enterprise to ensure alignment and maximize impact.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and drive the product vision for education and learning in ChatGPT.

  • Partner with research teams to explore how AI can better advance learning outcomes

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, product, and go-to-market—to bring education features to life.

  • Partner with xfn growth, GTM, and marketing teams to bring the tools to students, adult learners, and educators.

  • Work with external partners in academia, education, and workforce development to track outcomes & ensure products are safe, effective, and aligned with real-world needs.

  • Use both data and user feedback to validate impact and guide product direction.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of product management experience with strong leadership, xfn collaboration, and communication skills.

  • Bring experience in education, EdTech, or learning research, or are eager to dive into complex, research-driven problem spaces.

  • Have built and scaled impactful consumer products.

  • Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and excited to build products that help people learn.

jobs.title: Product Manufacturing & Quality Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a product manufacturing & quality engineer, who will be responsible for driving technical initiatives related to the manufacturing, quality and reliability of our AI supercomputer hardware systems to ensure product success from concept to launch and through mass production. You’ll have the opportunity to coordinate with functional SMEs and work with a wide range of stakeholders, from design engineering and operations teams, TPMs, external industry vendors and partners to ensure that all products are developed and delivered on time and to the highest quality standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Own the integrated manufacturing and quality readiness for a product across L6, L10, and L11, with clear gates, milestones, deliverables, owners, and closure criteria.

  • Lead readiness of process flows, tooling, fixtures, assembly operations, test interfaces, and production controls. Review and contribute to work instructions.

  • Translate product requirements into qualification plans, process controls, test requirements and acceptance criteria with design engineering and Area SMEs

  • Coordinate and drive execution of product and process qualification, reliability testing, and validation with the relevant SMEs. Maintain traceable evidence that assigned products and processes meet agreed performance, reliability, and compliance requirements.

  • Own the supplier and line scorecard. Using yield, defect tracking, process capability, and reliability data to assess process health, identify trends and escapes, prioritize improvements, and verify their effectiveness.

  • Lead containment, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and corrective actions for issues affecting the program during development, production, and deployment. Drive actions to closure with evidence that fixes are effective and sustained.

  • Work on-site with Area SMEs at supplier and sub-supplier locations to assess line readiness and process execution, troubleshoot issues, and verify that agreed controls and corrective actions are implemented.

  • Lead JDM/CM manufacturing and quality audits and performance reviews for the program, and drive readiness, process, and control gaps to closure.

  • Assess the manufacturing and quality impact of design, process, source, and site changes. Coordinate validation and control updates with the responsible engineering and sourcing owners.

  • Provide evidence-based release recommendations using readiness gate status, qualification and control evidence, containment status, and remaining risks and actions. Make any unmet criteria clear to the responsible approval owners.

  • Manage multiple projects, track progress against milestones, communicate priorities and risks across functions, and coordinate risk mitigation to meet schedules and quality standards.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a track record of owning both manufacturing and quality outcomes for complex hardware from new product introduction through production ramp and sustaining operations.

  • Are hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking deep ownership of an assigned product, source, or site while coordinating specialists across disciplines.

  • Understand high-performance computing hardware and the manufacturing and quality risks that carry across component, system, and rack integration, including L6, L10, and L11.

  • Partner closely with design engineering and subject matter experts to assess changes, define validation needs, and integrate technical decisions while respecting design and commercial ownership.

  • Have experience building integrated readiness plans, managing qualification gates and dependencies, and using technical evidence to make clear release recommendations.

  • Have significant experience working with multinational JDM/CM partners on manufacturing readiness, process controls, yield improvement, quality, reliability, and issue closure.

  • Are familiar with mechanical and electrical Design for Quality (DFQ), Excellence (DFX), Manufacturability (DFM), Assembly (DFA), Test (DFT), and Reliability (DFR), and can apply them with the relevant specialists.

  • Have experience leading structured problem solving and root cause analysis using methods such as 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis, including validation of corrective-action effectiveness.

  • Use statistical methods and manufacturing and quality data to understand yield, defects, process capability, and reliability, and communicate findings through clear supplier and line scorecards.

  • Have experience qualifying processes or sources, evaluating technical equivalency, and managing risks across suppliers, sites, and product or process interfaces.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and changing conditions, and can make clear decisions, document risks, and escalate issues while maintaining ownership through closure.

jobs.title: Product Manufacturing Engineer - PCBA
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manufacturing Engineer to drive manufacturing strategy and execution for next-generation AI hardware within the Silicon & Systems team, with a particular focus on PCBA manufacturing, assembly, process development, and production readiness.

You will work closely with design engineering, systems engineering, operations, TPMs, contract manufacturers, suppliers, and other external partners to ensure new hardware products successfully transition from concept and prototype builds through NPI and high-volume production. You’ll own critical manufacturing initiatives, identify and resolve production risks, and help establish the processes and controls required to deliver complex hardware at scale.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive manufacturing and quality initiatives to ensure product success from concept and early development through NPI, production launch, and scale.

  • Lead manufacturing process development for next-generation AI hardware systems, partnering closely with design engineering, systems engineering, operations, TPMs, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

  • Own PCBA manufacturing development and production readiness, including assembly processes, process validation, manufacturing test, rework, yield improvement, and successful transition into volume production.

  • Establish NPI manufacturing processes, systems, quality controls, milestones, and deliverables across internal teams and external manufacturing partners.

  • Provide hands-on manufacturing engineering support during design, development, prototype, validation, and production phases.

  • Partner with engineering teams to assess manufacturability, identify production risks, and incorporate manufacturing requirements early in the product development lifecycle.

  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for manufacturing, assembly, test, yield, and quality issues.

  • Research and develop manufacturing automation, test methodologies, tooling, and processes that improve quality, throughput, and efficiency.

  • Develop and manage manufacturing requirements, schedules, readiness criteria, and deliverables across engineering teams, TPMs, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other key stakeholders.

  • Drive manufacturing readiness reviews and ensure products meet quality, reliability, yield, and production requirements before ramp.

  • Communicate effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure successful execution of complex hardware programs.

  • Perform risk assessment, mitigation, and change management throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Manage multiple hardware programs and manufacturing workstreams simultaneously while ensuring critical milestones and standards are met.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong track record of taking complex hardware products from concept and prototype through NPI, production launch, and high-volume manufacturing.

  • Have deep experience with PCBA manufacturing, assembly processes, manufacturing test, process development, yield, and quality.

  • Are familiar with PCBA assembly and rework processes, component-level manufacturing considerations, and the equipment and processes required to manufacture complex, high-performance hardware.

  • Have significant experience working with multinational JDMs, CMs, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to drive quality, schedule, and production readiness.

  • Understand the manufacturing challenges associated with complex, high-density, high-power, and high-speed compute systems.

  • Are comfortable partnering closely with electrical, mechanical, systems, test, reliability, operations, and supply chain teams throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Have experience driving development timelines for new platform introductions and managing manufacturing readiness and internal review processes.

  • Are skilled at analyzing manufacturing and test data to identify issues, improve yield, and drive corrective actions.

  • Enjoy solving difficult manufacturing problems and are comfortable getting hands-on during prototype builds, failure analysis, and production ramps.

  • Are creative, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable operating in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.

About the Team

The Product Marketing team shapes how OpenAI brings its research, models, and products to market. We work across Research, Product, Engineering, Sales, Communications, and Marketing to translate technical advances into clear customer value, compelling market narratives, and go-to-market strategies that drive meaningful adoption.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior product marketing leader to shape how OpenAI’s models and research are understood and adopted around the world. You’ll work directly with frontier research teams to understand emerging capabilities and translate them into compelling product strategies, market narratives, and customer experiences.

Your scope will span frontier models, specialized models for cybersecurity and life sciences, multimodal capabilities, and the API portfolio that makes these systems accessible to developers and businesses. You’ll build and lead the team responsible for helping customers understand what our models can do, how they’re evolving, and how to deploy them responsibly.

In this role, you will:

  • Define the product marketing strategy for OpenAI’s models, research advances, and API portfolio.

  • Embed with Research, Product, and Engineering to understand model capabilities, evaluations, limitations, and technical tradeoffs.

  • Shape how OpenAI explains advances in AI to developers, business leaders, and the broader market.

  • Lead positioning, launches, demonstrations, and adoption strategies across frontier, specialized, and multimodal models.

  • Help customers navigate model selection, API access, privacy, security, and responsible deployment.

  • Bring customer and market insights into research and product decisions.

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, and regional teams to develop customer narratives, use cases, and enablement.

  • Work with Communications, Safety, Policy, and Legal to ensure technical claims are accurate and grounded.

  • Build and lead a high-performing product marketing team and define success across understanding, adoption, and API usage.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in product marketing across AI, developer platforms, enterprise technology, cloud, or other complex technical products.

  • You love the craft of product marketing and storytelling, and bring the curiosity, conviction, and passion to thrive in a deeply immersive role.

  • Have built and led product marketing teams or functions.

  • Can understand sophisticated technical systems and explain them clearly without losing nuance.

  • Have worked closely with research, engineering, or advanced product development teams.

  • Have led major launches and sustained adoption strategies across a product portfolio.

  • Bring strong judgment in positioning, technical storytelling, and executive communication.

  • Understand how developers and enterprises evaluate APIs, model capabilities, security, and privacy.

  • Can operate effectively across senior stakeholders and move between strategic leadership and hands-on execution.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead, ChatGPT Work
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

The B2B Marketing team contributes to OpenAI's broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. We are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI's products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Sales, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.

About the Role

We're looking for a senior product marketing leader to own the strategy, narrative, and go-to-market direction for ChatGPT Work. This role will help define how professionals, teams, and organizations put AI to work on meaningful tasks, move from questions to completed work, and adopt new ways of working across their business.

You will serve as the senior product marketing owner for ChatGPT Work, shaping the category, setting portfolio priorities, and connecting product innovation to customer understanding, adoption, and growth. Your scope will span the Work experience across surfaces, connected tools, and AI-powered workflows, with a clear focus on the needs of professional users, Business customers, and Enterprise organizations.

This is a leadership role for someone who can set strategy, make difficult tradeoffs, and stay close enough to the work to shape the messaging, product decisions, launches, and programs that determine whether customers adopt. You will partner with Product, Growth, Sales, Research, Comms, Creative, and adjacent product marketing teams to build a coherent experience from first discovery through sustained team usage.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the ChatGPT Work product marketing strategy: Define the audience, market opportunity, positioning, competitive strategy, and go-to-market priorities across professional users, teams, and enterprise customers.

  • Build a clear and differentiated product narrative: Explain what ChatGPT Work enables, when to use it, how it differs from a traditional chat experience, and how it complements Codex and other OpenAI products.

  • Lead the portfolio across launches and sustained adoption: Set priorities for major product moments while ensuring that customer education, activation, recurring usage, and ongoing demand do not disappear between launches.

  • Translate product capabilities into useful customer workflows: Turn advances across web, desktop, mobile, connected tools, and AI-assisted work into concrete examples, demos, stories, and programs that show how people complete real work.

  • Drive adoption from first useful task to team-wide usage: Partner with Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Customer Education, and Sales to improve discovery, activation, repeat workflows, team adoption, and expansion.

  • Shape the product through customer and market insight: Bring customer research, usage data, field feedback, competitive intelligence, and observed workflow barriers into product, packaging, and go-to-market decisions.

  • Build enterprise confidence and field readiness: Work with the administrator and governance PMM, buyer-focused marketers, and customer-facing teams to connect user value with deployment requirements, customer proof, executive buy-in, and a credible enterprise story.

  • Lead cross-functional decisions and raise the quality bar: Align Product, Engineering, Growth, Creative, Comms, Sales, and Marketing around shared priorities; coach product marketers; and make clear choices about what matters most.

  • Measure whether the work is changing customer behavior: Define success using meaningful indicators such as qualified adoption, activation, repeat usage, retention, team penetration, customer preference, and business impact.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 12+ years of experience in product marketing, product strategy, or closely related go-to-market leadership roles, including ownership of a complex software, platform, or AI product.

  • A strong track record of defining product and category strategy, not just executing launches or producing marketing assets.

  • Experience bringing products to market across both self-serve and enterprise motions, with an understanding of how individual usage grows into team adoption and organizational standardization.

  • Exceptional positioning, writing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to make sophisticated technology concrete and relevant to professional users and executive buyers.

  • Demonstrated success working closely with Product and Engineering to shape priorities, clarify tradeoffs, and turn customer insight into better product and go-to-market decisions.

  • Experience leading through influence, developing other product marketers, and earning trust with senior cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience connecting product marketing programs to adoption, retention, expansion, or other meaningful business outcomes.

  • A practical understanding of how knowledge workers use AI across functions such as operations, finance, marketing, sales, legal, or strategy.

  • High standards for craft, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and clear communication in environments where products and market conditions change quickly.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and hands-on experience using modern AI products to improve how work gets done.

Workplace & Location

OpenAI’s B2B Marketing team helps businesses understand, adopt, and get value from our products. We work closely with Product, Research, Sales, and Communications to connect advances in AI to the problems organizations are trying to solve.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Messaging Lead to shape how businesses understand OpenAI and the value of our portfolio. You’ll develop a clear enterprise narrative, connect individual product stories to it, and help explain how AI is changing the way people and organizations work.

You’ll work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to make difficult positioning decisions and turn them into work that customers, executives, and the field can use. You’ll be a hands-on writer and editor as well as a strategic partner, responsible for the quality and coherence of our most important business stories.

This is a senior individual contributor role, with the potential to build and lead a team as the function grows.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and evolve the enterprise narrative and the messages that connect our products to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Partner with product and industry marketers to make the portfolio clear and differentiated while preserving the depth each audience needs.

  • Translate complex capabilities into precise, compelling stories with Product and Research.

  • Personally develop core enterprise pitches, executive narratives, major launch messages, and other high-priority materials.

  • Bring customer insight, competitive context, and credible proof into the story with GTM and Customer Marketing.

  • Help Marketing, Communications, and Enablement apply the narrative, and improve it through customer feedback and testing.

  • Coach partners on messaging and writing, and help define how the function should grow.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • A track record of leading messaging, positioning, or product marketing for complex technology portfolios serving business customers.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with examples of work you personally created and an ability to explain the decisions behind it.

  • Strong product and technical judgment, including the ability to distinguish a supported claim from an appealing assertion.

jobs.title: Product Reliability Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops silicon and system-level solutions designed for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is responsible for building the next generation of AI-native silicon while working closely with software and research partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. In addition to delivering production-grade silicon for OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure, the team also creates custom design tools and methodologies that accelerate innovation and enable hardware optimized specifically for AI.

The Compute team works on the design of our AI supercomputers, doing everything from workload modeling to influencing accelerator design. We’re leaning into our partnerships to make system and data center co-design an integral part of this process, and are looking for engineers to design AI supercomputers solutions for data center applications

This team is responsible for working with partners to optimize their hardware for our workloads, identifying promising new deep learning accelerators, and bringing those hardware platforms to production.

If you’re excited to work at the intersection of cutting edge deep learning, hardware system, and data center design this role is for you!

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Reliability Engineer to own reliability engineering for advanced IT hardware, from printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) through compute and networking trays, systems, and fully integrated racks. You’ll translate operating conditions and service-life goals into reliability requirements, design and execute qualification tests, and drive failure analysis and corrective-action verification from development through production and field deployment. Working with electrical, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, quality, and data center teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners, you’ll use test and field evidence to improve hardware durability, serviceability, and availability.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Define reliability requirements and targets for PCBAs, trays, systems, and racks using mission profiles, expected service life, operating environments, duty cycles, and availability goals.

  • Drive design-for-reliability reviews with electrical, mechanical, and thermal engineers. Use failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA or FMEA) and physics of failure to prioritize risks and recommend design improvements. Own component de-rating guidelines and guidance.

  • Own reliability qualification plans from new product introduction through production, defining test coverage, representative configurations, sample sizes, stress conditions, duration, pass/fail criteria, and exit evidence at each assembly level.

  • Develop and execute accelerated life and environmental tests, including temperature cycling, humidity exposure, power cycling, shock, vibration, and transport testing. Exercise hardware under representative workloads and monitor function and degradation during stress.

  • Analyze life-test and field data using Weibull and other reliability models, acceleration models, and confidence intervals. State assumptions, exposure, and uncertainty when estimating failure rates, useful life, or reliability against targets.

  • Lead failure investigations from symptom reproduction through physical root cause. Maintain failure reporting, analysis, and corrective-action records, and verify fixes through targeted testing and recurrence monitoring.

  • Review supplier reliability plans and evidence for PCBs, PCBa components/assemblies, cables, connectors, and cooling components. Identify gaps between component qualification and the stresses encountered in the integrated system or rack.
