About the role

We're looking for an API engineer to join our core API team and help scale Runway's platform serving millions of users and handling thousands of requests per second. You'll work on the critical infrastructure that powers both our public API (used by external developers) and internal tools, managing user data, task orchestration, billing, permissions, and asset management.

This is a high-impact role on a mature, production system. You'll build enterprise features, optimize database performance, design async workflows, and ensure reliability at scale. If you're passionate about API development, love TypeScript, and want to own systems end-to-end, this is the role for you.

A peek at our technical stack

Our API endpoints for real-time collaboration and media asset management is written in TypeScript, and runs in ECS containers on AWS Fargate. We leverage multiple AWS-native components, such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Kinesis, and SQS, as building blocks of our infrastructure.

Our inference backend is written in Python (PyTorch, TorchScript), and is deployed across multiple clusters / cloud providers. We use Kubernetes for container orchestration, and k8s-native components such as Flyte, Kueue, and Kyverno efficient job orchestration. We invest in prometheus and grafana for monitoring, and Terraform to manage our infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full API lifecycle from design and implementation to monitoring, optimization, and documentation for both public and internal APIs

  • Design and implement async workflows for task orchestration, content moderation, prompt enhancement, and post-processing pipelines

  • Optimize database queries and improve performance for a high-traffic Postgres database

  • Build rate limiting, fraud detection, and credit management systems

  • Implement comprehensive API security, rate limiting, authentication, and monitoring systems to ensure reliability at scale

  • Improve the public API developer experience with better documentation, SDKs, and tooling

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and code quality of our codebases

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years of industry experience building production APIs

  • Strong TypeScript experience, so you can jump in and be productive immediately

  • Experience owning systems end-to-end: infrastructure, monitoring, logging, metrics, incident response

  • Understanding of API design patterns, REST principles, and async workflows

  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres preferred) and query optimization

  • Experience architecting production-ready systems at scale using cloud primitives from AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and iterate on them with tight product deadlines

  • Humility and open mindedness; at Runway we love to learn from one another

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, ML Platform
jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

We're looking for an ML infrastructure engineer to own model evaluation at Runway, end to end. Every decision we make about a model – which checkpoint to keep training, what to ship to millions of users, which datamix and architecture shows the most promise – rests on evals. Today that work is spread across the organization. You'll turn it into one platform.

Your job will be to design and build the systems that generate samples at scale, score them with automated metrics and human annotations, track results across checkpoints and releases, and put the answers in front of researchers in minutes rather than days. You'll define what "better" means operationally – how we measure it, how confident we are, and how a result becomes a ship/no-ship decision.

You'll be embedded within research teams as a member of ML Platform, and you'll set the technical direction for evals across the company. This is an extremely high-leverage role: the quality of our models is bounded by how well we can measure them.

A peek at our technical stack

Our inference and training code is written in Python (PyTorch) and is cloud-native. We leverage multiple clouds and use a combination of Kubernetes native and home-grown tooling for efficient job orchestration.

We’re big users of agentic development and operations. We have a robust internal platform and provide broad access to the latest models and harnesses.

You’ll have access to best-in-class models, agents, GPUs, storage and cloud services you need to drive a world class evaluation pipeline that helps us deliver frontier models.

What you'll do

  • Own the evaluation platform end to end: the tooling and systems required to generate, annotate, review and adapt at frontier scale

  • Define the CLIs, APIs, GUIs and storage layers required to make this process seamless, fast, sophisticated and collaborative

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to candidates based near our NYC office or those willing to relocate.

Building general world models — systems that understand and simulate reality across tasks, modalities, and domains — requires closing the loop between learned representations and real-world action. We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to bring our video-native foundation models onto real hardware: deploying world-model-based policies on real robots and making them work in the real world.

You will work across the full stack of robot learning — from data collection and task design, to policy deployment, to physical evaluation. This is a hands-on, execution-oriented role at the intersection of foundation models, learned robot policies, and hardware. You'll bring deep robotics domain expertise and help us ship world-model-based robot policies end-to-end, with applications ranging from manipulation to mobile robotics.

What you’ll do

  • Own the deployment loop for learned policies (VLAs, diffusion policies, World Action Models) on real robot arms: inference serving, action decoding, controller integration, latency budgets, and safety limits

  • Diagnose real-world policy failures — determining whether the problem is data coverage, camera/proprioception mismatch, or execution — and partner with the research team to fix it at the right layer

  • Design demonstration data collection protocols (task setup, camera placement, teleop conventions) that produce data our world models can actually learn from — working with our existing teleop and lab infrastructure

  • Partner with research to run controlled experiments connecting world model representations, data composition, and fine-tuning recipes to physical success rates

  • Define and run physical evaluation protocols so results are trustworthy and comparable across policy iterations

  • Adapt our policy recipe to partner hardware and new embodiments

What you’ll need

  • You have personally deployed software on real robot hardware and iterated to make it work — whether learned policies, motion planning, classical control, or perception-driven manipulation. You can walk through a specific system you shipped, what broke on the physical robot that didn't break in sim or testing, and how you fixed it.

  • Fluency in the software-to-robot interface: action/command spaces, control frequencies, observation pipelines, calibration, and how each affects real-world behavior

  • Comfort working at the intersection of software and physical systems: you can reconfigure a robot workspace and trace a policy failure in the same afternoon

  • Bonus: direct experience deploying learned policies (VLAs, diffusion policies) on real hardware; experience with video/multimodal generative models or world models

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring around the world for the right candidate.

Runway Creative is an all-in-one platform giving creators and businesses endless ways to generate and edit video, images, and audio. Our customers range from individual creators on self-serve plans to studios and enterprise marketing teams, and they generate with both Runway's own models and leading third-party models, all on one platform.

We're hiring a Pricing & Packaging Lead to own how Runway creates and captures value across all of it. You'll partner closely with our Self-Serve Product Lead to evolve our plans and credits, build the path from self-serve to enterprise, and set the pricing for every model we launch and every third-party model we serve. You'll build the pricing framework the rest of the company uses, and you'll be accountable for revenue growth, gross margin, and customer trust in equal measure.

What you’ll do

  • Own self-serve pricing & packaging: partner with the Self-Serve Product Lead on our plan ladder and credit design, including allowances, rollover, top-ups, annual vs. monthly, and regional pricing. Run a continuous program of pricing and packaging experiments with Growth and Data.

  • Build the path to enterprise: design the triggers, team and workspace constructs, seat and credit-pool models, and commit and consumption contracts that move customers from self-serve to enterprise. Equip Sales with pricing playbooks, discount bands, and deal guardrails.

  • Create a company-wide pricing framework: publish Runway's pricing principles, value metrics, and decision process so any product team can price new features and products with confidence. Run a regular pricing council with Product, Finance, Research, and GTM.

  • Price our models: set launch pricing for every Runway model release, working with Research and Infrastructure on cost-to-serve. Define how model pricing evolves from launch through deprecation as inference costs change.

  • Own third-party model economics: set credit pricing and target margins for the partner models we serve, monitor competitive pricing, and work with Partnerships on vendor terms. Make per-model margin visible to the whole company.

  • Keep pricing changes trustworthy: own how we communicate every pricing change, from advance notice and in-product usage visibility to spend controls and customer FAQs. Changes should land as clearly as they were designed.

  • Build the team: hire and lead a small pricing team over time, and partner closely with billing engineering to turn decisions into systems.

What you’ll need

  • 10+ years across pricing, monetization, strategy, or strategic finance, with 5+ years directly owning pricing and packaging decisions. A track record of moving revenue, conversion, and margin, not just producing recommendations.

  • Deep experience with usage, credit, or consumption-based pricing. You can build a cost-to-serve and margin model from compute and inference inputs, and you understand how hybrid seat + usage models behave in the wild.

  • Experience across self-serve and sales-led motions. You've shipped pricing changes for PLG subscription products and designed the contracts and guardrails that support enterprise expansion.

  • Rigorous and experimental. You're fluent in pricing experiments, willingness-to-pay research, and cohort analysis, and comfortable in SQL and financial models.

  • You thrive in an environment with rapid pace and a high accountability culture. You make decisions with incomplete information and know when a pricing call needs more data and when it needs to ship.

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, and Seattle.

We are looking for a Prototype Researcher to join Runway Labs — our research and exploration team pushing the frontier of AI video and General World Models. You’ll imagine, design, and build experimental experiences that make emerging AI capabilities tangible and communicate a compelling vision for where the technology is heading.

This role combines creative thinking, hands-on prototyping, and storytelling. You should be able to develop an original idea, build a working prototype, and shape it into a clear, memorable demonstration. Your work will help people understand new AI systems through experiences they can see, use, and engage with.

Working closely with researchers, engineers, and designers, you’ll explore new interfaces and interaction paradigms for AI-generated video, world models, and agentic systems. The focus is on research explorations that express our vision, reveal new possibilities, and strengthen Runway’s position as a full-stack research organization.

We’re looking for a motivated self-starter with strong creative judgment, technical fluency, and a portfolio that shows both what you can build and how well you can communicate an idea.

What you’ll do

  • Develop original concepts that explore the possibilities of emerging AI systems, from interactive video and world models to agentic experiences.

  • Design and build working prototypes that turn research capabilities into engaging, understandable experiences.

  • Shape each project’s story: what it explores, why it matters, and what it suggests about the future.

  • Package explorations into polished demos, films, and interactive experiences that communicate our research and vision.

  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers to understand new capabilities and identify compelling ways to demonstrate them.

  • Move quickly through experimentation, using prototypes to test ideas and refine both the experience and its narrative.

What you’ll need

  • A portfolio of original projects that demonstrates creative thinking, design craft, technical execution, and strong storytelling.

  • The ability to take an idea from an early concept to a working prototype and a compelling presentation.

  • Hands-on experience building interactive experiences with code, with the judgment to choose the right tools for each experiment.

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills, with an eye for detail and an instinct for making complex ideas accessible.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI video, world models, agentic systems, and emerging generative media.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous research environments, defining your own direction, and learning new tools as the work evolves.

  • The ability to explain the purpose and potential of your work clearly, through writing, visuals, demos, or film.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Data Foundations
jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

Building general world models — systems that understand and simulate reality across tasks, modalities, and domains — demands training data that is as rich and varied as the real world itself. We’re looking for Research Engineers to own the data behind our models: what they learn from, how well they learn it, and what new capabilities that unlocks. You will design datasets, run modeling experiments, and build the infrastructure to generate and curate data at scale — directly shaping what our models can do, with applications ranging from creative tools to robotics.

What you'll do

  • Design multimodal, multitask datasets that teach world models new capabilities — deciding what data to collect, generate, or curate and measuring its effect on model behavior

  • Run controlled training experiments to understand how data composition drives model performance across tasks and domains

  • Build and operate large-scale pipelines for synthetic data generation, filtering, and quality control

  • Define evaluations and benchmarks that measure whether our models are actually improving at the things that matter

  • Partner with product and creative teams to translate target behaviors and capabilities into concrete data strategies

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience in machine learning, bonus points for data-centric approaches

  • Experience with large multimodal datasets and generative models (video, image, or multimodal)

  • Deep intuition for how data composition and quality translate to model capabilities

  • Comfort working across the full research stack: data analysis, dataset creation, model training, evaluation, and back again

  • Proficiency with at least one ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and distributed compute tools (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes)

  • Excitement about building AI that simulates the world

jobs.title: SEO / AEO Manager
jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for someone to own Runway's SEO and AEO strategy, end to end. You’ll build out our library of SEO content at scale, run experiments to sharpen what's working, own technical SEO health and report on what’s working to drive organic growth.

This is a hybrid strategy-and-execution role. You won't just hand off a keyword list and wait. You'll be optimizing a piece of content one day and making a technical case to our development team the next.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own Runway's SEO and AEO strategy: Keyword cluster architecture (pillar-and-spoke), competitive SERP and content-gap analysis, understanding what stage of the buying journey a searcher is in so content matches what they actually need, as well as champion Runway's presence in AI-generated answers.

  • Build out Runway's library of SEO content: Briefs, landing pages, articles and more, identifying and scoping high-opportunity content, without sacrificing quality or brand voice

  • Design and run experiments on content formats, internal linking and page structure and use the results to sharpen the strategy

  • Own technical SEO health: Indexing, sitemaps, structured data and schema markup, ongoing site monitoring and recommend site structure and information architecture changes (page templates, internal linking, URL structure) that improve crawlability and rankings

  • Own measurement and reporting for organic growth: Track keyword rankings, organic traffic and AI citation trends against clear targets, and go beyond traffic volume to measure whether that traffic actually converts into product signups

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 4+ years in SEO, with experience contributing to overall strategy

  • Experience building or scaling an SEO function from a small base, moving fluidly between strategic and hands-on work

  • Experience collaborating across teams, including managing freelancers and partnering with product, marketing and design teams

  • Proficiency with GA4 and Google Search Console, plus keyword/competitive research tools like SEMrush or Ahrefs

  • Experience in AEO / AI-search visibility, with the ability to bake it into a broader SEO strategy

  • Experience using Profound, AirOps, or similar AEO tool is a plus

  • Experience at an AI, product-led or consumer-facing tech company is a plus, where SEO has to coexist with a fast-moving roadmap

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle

We’re looking for a Senior HR Generalist to own the day-to-day of Runway’s HR function and shape how it scales. You’ll run core programs end to end, advise managers and employees on sensitive situations, unblock teams so they can move faster and build the processes that keep a fast-growing team compliant and well supported. You’ll work directly with the HR Manager as a strategic partner, and you’ll have the autonomy to make decisions, set priorities and fix what’s broken without waiting to be asked.

What you’ll do

  • Own the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding for full-time employees and contractors, and keep improving the process as the team grows

  • Own HRIS administration and data integrity in Rippling, including reporting, audits and workflow automation

  • Manage employee visa and immigration processes in partnership with outside counsel

  • Oversee leave administration and accommodations across jurisdictions, and keep policies and practices compliant with current employment law

  • Run key programs end to end with the HR Manager, including performance reviews, open enrollment, engagement surveys and compensation cycles

  • Act as the go-to resource for employees and managers on benefits, policies and HR processes

  • Identify gaps in HR operations and ship fixes: updated policies, clearer documentation and more efficient tooling

  • Pitch in wherever the team needs; no task is too small if it moves things forward

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of experience in an HR Generalist or people operations role at a high-growth company

  • Deep working knowledge of benefits, leave administration, immigration basics and employment law across multiple states

  • Experience running company-wide programs such as performance cycles, open enrollment and engagement surveys

  • Strong HRIS skills, with Rippling experience a strong plus

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the credibility to advise managers and senior leaders

  • Comfort operating independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail

  • A high ownership mindset and a team-first attitude

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote on the West Coast— preferable to have someone near our office in SF or Seattle.

We're looking for someone to join our IT team and take ownership of day-to-day technical support for a globally distributed company. You'd report to the Head of IT/Security and be the first point of contact for employees with requests, device issues, and account problems.

You'll own the fundamentals from day one: handling tickets, provisioning laptops, running on-boarding, and keeping our SaaS stack in order. But this is a small team at a fast-growing AI company, so the scope grows quickly. You'll get pulled into real projects sooner than you'd expect, across security, infrastructure, and automation. How far you take it depends on what you're good at and what interests you.

What you'll do

  • Handle help-desk tickets: Triage and resolve employee requests — password resets, access provisioning, Slack/Google Workspace/Zoom troubleshooting, and general "my thing is broken" support

  • Manage the device lifecycle: Procure, provision, configure, and ship laptops for new hires. Handle off-boarding wipes and returns. Keep the asset inventory accurate.

  • Run on-boarding and off-boarding: Create accounts, apply security profiles, draft welcome communications, and make sure new employees have everything before day one

  • Administer Google Workspace: Manage users, groups, aliases, and license assignments. You'll use both the admin console and CLI tools regularly.

  • Support endpoint compliance: Work with our device trust tooling to keep employee machines meeting security policies, and follow up when they don't

  • Deploy and enforce security policies: Help roll out and maintain endpoint security configurations, access controls, and compliance requirements across the fleet

  • Manage corporate software: Handle seat assignments, renewals, license optimization, and access reviews across our SaaS stack

  • Support office networking and AV: Help maintain networking equipment, conference room setups, and office technology across our physical locations as needed

  • Train and enable employees: Deliver lightweight technical guidance and training on IT systems, both for new hires and for ongoing support (written guides, short walkthroughs, the occasional screen share)

  • Write things down: Maintain run-books, knowledge base articles, and process docs. If you fix something, document how.

Where this role can grow

We don't expect you to stay in a pure helpdesk lane. Our SOC2 program has ongoing evidence collection and device trust work to pick up, and there's security policy work that needs someone to own the rollout and enforcement side.

On the infrastructure side, we manage cloud resources through infrastructure-as-code, and there's room to contribute once you're comfortable. We also automate a lot (scripting, CI/CD pipelines) and there's no shortage of manual process waiting to be turned into a workflow.

Over time, you'd lead IT projects around endpoint management, security improvements, and internal tooling rather than just executing on them.

What you'll need

  • Some form of IT support experience. A help-desk role, an internal support function, or just being the person everyone came to when something broke. The title matters less than the reps.

  • Comfort with macOS. Our user endpoint fleet is mostly Mac. You should be able to troubleshoot system issues, manage profiles, and work in the terminal without hand-holding.

  • Familiarity with Google Workspace administration, or the confidence to pick it up fast. CLI admin tooling experience is a plus.

  • A working understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN basics, and how traffic moves. You don't need to be a network engineer, but you shouldn't be lost when a connectivity issue comes in.

  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles. You should know what endpoint security, encryption, and access controls are, and why they matter, even if you haven't built policies from scratch.

  • Strong written communication. This is a remote role and coordination happens in Slack and Notion. If you can't write clearly, the timezone gap makes everything harder.

  • Self-direction. There's separation between you and the rest of the IT team for part of the day. You need to be someone who sees what needs doing and does it.

  • Curiosity about how systems work. Maybe you've run a homelab, automated something tedious with a script, or set up a Pi. We care more about the impulse than the resume line.

Nice to have

  • Experience with MDM platforms (any of the major ones)

  • Any exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, etc) and infrastructure-as-code concepts

  • Scripting in Python, Bash, or JavaScript

  • Familiarity with zero-trust networking concepts and tools

  • Background in compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001)

  • Exposure to international IT regulations or data privacy requirements (GDPR, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Manager/Director, Product - Developer Platform
jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring anywhere in the US.

Runway's Developer Platform (RunwayDev) is the best place for developers to build with AI media models, with customers ranging from the world’s software companies, to enterprises and agencies, to vibe-coders. RunwayDev provides a single gateway to integrate with the best image, video, audio, and real-time models. Our vision is to be the developer platform behind all creative work: one place to call the best model for any creative task, with the best quality output.

RunwayDev serves not only Runway’s first-party frontier models (Gen-4.5, Aleph, Act-Two), but also provides day-zero access to a curated set of best-in-class third-party models, and intelligent routing that no aggregator can match.

We're hiring a Product Leader to own the Developer Platform business end-to-end. You'll own the API revenue number, create the platform strategy, prioritize the portfolio of bets, and serve as the single front door for this business across the company. You'll start deeply hands-on as the primary PM, and grow a strong team as the business scales.

What you’ll do

  • Own the developer platform business. Drive the revenue goals for the developer platform (API ARR), along with the full funnel of developer signups, activation (first task), weekly active developer accounts, and developer NPS.

  • Create and drive the strategy. Articulate and drive the portfolio of bets that make Runway the platform of choice for developers integrating media models. Co-develop strategy with leadership and partners, then make clear, ambitious calls on where to invest and what to cut.

  • Win professional developers. Land and grow agencies, software tools, and platform partners. Partner with our internal deployment teams to ensure developers are successful with the platform.

  • Ship, hands-on. Talk to developers every week, ship your own PRs and reference integrations, and partner tightly with engineering, design, DevRel, PMM, and partnerships. You'll be in the details daily and shipping regularly.

  • Build the team. Start as the primary IC DRI and hire PMs underneath you as the business grows, raising the bar on outcome orientation as you scale.

What you’ll need

  • 7+ years in product management, preferably leading a developer-facing or platform/API product at meaningful scale. A track record of moving revenue and adoption metrics, not just shipping features.

  • You thrive in an environment with rapid pace and a high accountability culture. You move very fast, make decisions with incomplete information, and instinctively gravitate towards shipping today, not writing docs for tomorrow.

  • A GM mindset. You think in terms of the business, not just the roadmap. You're fluent in the economics of a usage-based / consumption API business, comfortable owning a P&L-style number, and you instinctively tie every bet to a hypothesis about how it moves the business.

  • Deep developer-product craft. Hands-on experience with API and SDK design, developer onboarding and activation, docs and DevRel, and usage-based pricing and packaging. You know what a great developer experience feels like and you've personally driven the loop.

  • Strong technical fluency and customer obsession. You can earn the trust of a discerning developer audience — talk credibly about latency, cost, reliability, and integration ergonomics. Experience with inference platforms, infrastructure, or AI media products is a plus.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can make a sharp, written argument and tell a compelling launch story. You confidently assess the state of the business, call out challenges and articulate your plans to solve them

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

  • GWM-1

  • Gen-4.5

  • General World Models

  • Robotics SDK

  • Conversational Real-time Agents

  • Runway Studios

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US & Canada - we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle

We're seeking a detail-oriented Senior Revenue Accountant to help build and scale Runway's revenue accounting function. You'll cover all of revenue recognition (B2B and B2C), invoicing, collections, accounts receivable and deferred revenue. This is a high-impact role on a small, collaborative team, with significant room to grow.

What you’ll do

  • Support the revenue close by preparing journal entries, accounts receivable and deferred revenue reconciliations, AR aging, and flux analyses for all revenue-related accounts

  • Prepare technical accounting analyses, including contract review checklists, identifying performance obligations, establishing standalone selling price, calculating the impact of contract modifications, and applying revenue recognition to various products

  • Manage the full-cycle Order-to-Cash process , including invoicing, cash application, aging and collections , and resolve overdue accounts and billing disputes on time

  • Identify and implement process improvements across revenue workflows, using AI to modernize how we do accounting

  • Build revenue recognition workbooks for new products and pricing models as they launch

  • Partner with Sales, Post-Sales, FP&A and Legal as a trusted revenue resource, answering billing questions and reviewing ordere forms against revenue treatment

  • Implement controls over our revenue process and serve as a key point of contact for external audit requests

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA a plus.

  • 4+ years of progressive revenue accounting experience, including ASC 606 experience in a SaaS or technology environment

  • Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, or comparable ERP/CRM systems; advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

  • Experience with Usage Based revenue recognition preferred

  • Big 4 or public accounting experience preferred

  • Solid knowledge of internal controls and audit coordination

  • Detail-oriented and proactive, comfortable in ambiguity, and is always looking to improve the process

  • Partner with leaders on org design, headcount planning, team structure and leveling

  • Coach managers and executives on performance, feedback, career development and difficult conversations

  • Work with Compensation and Talent Acquisition on offers, promotions and market adjustments

  • Use headcount, attrition, engagement and performance data to spot risks early and recommend action

  • Design and roll out programs that fit how Runway’s teams work, from manager training to engagement initiatives

  • Step in wherever the team needs it

  • 7+ years of experience in HR, including at least four as an HR Business Partner supporting fast growing teams

  • Experience at a high-growth company, ideally through periods of rapid headcount growth

  • A record of advising senior leaders and earning their trust

  • Strong employee relations experience, with sound judgment and discretion

  • Working knowledge of employment law, compensation practices and performance management frameworks

  • Clear written and verbal communication

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to join our team and help us build cutting-edge, AI-powered video creation and collaboration tools. Rather than specialists, we’re seeking curiosity-driven engineers who are thoughtful problem solvers and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. Our engineering team is highly collaborative and works on a wide variety of exciting challenges, including developing new interfaces for AI content creation, building LLM-powered features and conversational experiences, and deploying cutting-edge computer vision and generative models to production.

A peek at our technical stack

The rich UI of our generative AI tools is powered by TypeScript and React with MediaBunny driving in-browser media and React Flow powering our node-based creative workflows. Our API endpoints for user and media management are written in TypeScript and Node.js and deployed as containerized services on AWS ECS Fargate. We leverage AI APIs to power advanced generative capabilities.

What you’ll do

  • Create rich multimedia interfaces using the cutting-edge of the latest AI video generation models Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2.0

  • Build end-to-end full-stack AI-powered product features — designing and developing both frontend experiences and backend systems, including authoring server-side processes and APIs that power our generative AI tools

  • Design and implement LLM-powered features and conversational interfaces

  • Partner with a world-class engineering team pushing the boundaries of creativity and content creation on the browser

  • Take on new challenges across the Frontend stack to implement product features for Runway’s machine learning-based generative AI tools

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and code quality of our codebases

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of industry experience in a software engineering role, ideally full-stack focused

  • Demonstrated fluency in one or more programming languages, including but not limited to JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience building with third-party AI APIs (e.g., chatbots, LLM integrations)

  • Experience in architecting production-ready systems and familiarity with debugging and profiling tools

  • Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and iterate on them with tight product deadlines

  • Humility and open-mindedness; at Runway, we love to learn from one another

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

We're looking for a Product Designer to own the experience developers have building on Runway's API: the docs, the console, and the moment someone goes from reading a reference page to a working integration. You'll partner with platform engineering and product to turn a fast-moving API surface into something developers can actually pick up and use.

What you’ll do

  • Design the developer console and API docs experience, from account setup and API keys to usage, billing, and rate limits

  • Prototype and ship playground tools, quickstarts, and code samples that let developers test endpoints and outputs before writing integration code

  • Turn new models and endpoints into clear, well-documented interfaces as the platform ships, keeping pace with a fast-moving API surface

  • Collaborate closely with platform engineering to design authentication, webhooks, and other technical flows in terms developers actually understand

  • Contribute to visual and interaction consistency between the developer platform and the rest of Runway's product

  • Set the design direction for the developer platform as a whole and mentor other designers working on it

What you’ll need

  • Experience designing developer-facing products with a platform or tool you've shipped to point to

  • Comfort translating technical concepts into interfaces a developer can use without reading a manual first

  • Experience designing flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI's for web products, with strong visual design skills

  • Experience delivering and iterating fast in close collaboration with engineering teams

  • Ability and flexibility to iterate fast and often

  • Passion for working with small teams, establishing a design culture, and creating a design-centric process within the company

  • Knowledge of the creative tool space and genuine interest in how developers build with generative AI

  • Experience in creating functional prototypes using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco.

This is a rare PM role with true vertical ownership across the full product lifecycle; from early-stage research and pre-training through to post-training and UX buildout through to GTM strategy and pricing - giving the right person a GM-like mandate to drive product decisions end-to-end in a way that's unique for a company of our scale.

We’re looking for a passionate Product Manager to help us develop cutting-edge AI tools. This role is for someone who has a combination of strong technical or ML background and experience in product management. You have the ability to take the state-of-the-art AI systems our research team builds and turn them into impactful tools for our customers.

You’ll deeply understand what users want, what’s possible to build, and what’s strategic for our business. You’ll be a bridge between our users and our internal teams so we ship products that have the most value for Runway’s creators.

This role is a fundamental and critical part of the team for a market-defining company in its early stages.

What you’ll do

  • Work alongside our research team to define new AI applications that solve customer needs and drive business value

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design to productize research and continuously improve existing tools

  • Define and analyze metrics, talk with users weekly, and conduct A/B tests to discover use cases, validate pain points, and prioritize features

What you’ll need

  • 1+ years of direct experience with SQL, python, code generation tools, and version control best practices

  • 4+ years of product management experience

  • Familiarity with the current state-of-the-art ML capabilities and ML products

  • Experience working with fast-moving teams and building products from scratch

  • Passion for seeing research through from initial conception to ultimate application

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. About the Role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle
Strategic Finance is a high-visibility, high-impact role embedded in the decision-making core of the company. You will serve as a crucial partner to our executive, R&D, and GTM teams, owning the financial modeling and analysis that drives our core product and research strategy, optimizes our GTM engine, and informs critical operational decisions.

This is a role for someone who has done this inside a fast-growing company before. You bring that operating judgment alongside analytical rigor, strong communication, and the curiosity to thrive at the frontier of generative AI. You’ll work closely with our CFO and Head of Strategic Finance, and partner directly with the executive team and cross-functional leads.

What you’ll do

  • Partner deeply with Product, Research, and Engineering leadership to evaluate the financial ROI and viability of new product lines, features, and R&D investments.

  • Drive pricing and packaging strategies that maximize market penetration and revenue expansion.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing leaders to analyze and optimize unit economics (LTV/CAC, payback periods), sales efficiency, pipeline health, and customer retention.

  • Act as the analytical engine for the executive team by leading cross-functional initiatives to improve operational efficiency, optimize resource allocation, and scale business processes.

  • Translate operational plans into financial models, identify risks and opportunities, and hold teams accountable to KPIs.

  • Own the KPI infrastructure that connects product and revenue metrics to financial outcomes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and a consistent narrative across all reporting.

What you’ll need

  • 7+ years of experience, including foundational analyst experience in investment banking or financial services, and high-impact operating experience in Strategic Finance, BizOps, or Corporate Finance at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience building and leveraging AI tools for yourself and for cross-functional use.

  • A track record of operating through rapid scale: building and evolving financial models, planning processes, and reporting as a company’s complexity grows.

  • Strong fundamentals in financial modeling with a rigorous and quantitative approach to measuring operational success.

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex financial concepts into simple, digestible narratives for non-financial stakeholders.

  • You have a high bar for operational excellence and a keen sense of how to translate complex, ambiguous business questions to a clear plan of action.

  • A genuine interest in AI and its implications for industry and society

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring in London and APAC.

We're building a creative platform used by artists, filmmakers, and teams at some of the world's most recognized brands. Our support org handles everything from a five-minute billing question to a technical escalation, and we're building out a dedicated tier for the first kind so our more experienced specialists can focus on the second.

We're looking for a Support Representative who's accurate, fast, and comfortable following a process closely under volume. No creative or AI background required. We'll train you on the product.

What you’ll do

  • Resolve high-volume, tickets across account access, billing, and plan questions for Free, Standard, and Pro and Max users

  • Use existing macros, playbooks, and AI support layer suggestions to close tickets accurately and quickly

  • Recognize when a ticket needs product judgment or creative-tool troubleshooting, and route it to Tier 2 Support or Enterprise

  • Flag recurring questions that don't have a macro yet

What you’ll need

  • Clear, accurate written communication, especially on process-driven, checklist-style work

  • Comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work without losing accuracy

  • Prior experience with tools like Zendesk, Notion, or Slack is a plus, not a requirement

  • 0-2 years in any customer-facing or process-driven role (preferably in SaaS, but not required)

  • Enough curiosity to spend a little time in the product or help docs before talking to us. No creative background needed, just evidence you looked

What sets great candidates apart

The best people in this role follow the playbook precisely and know exactly when a ticket doesn't fit it. They don't force a wrong answer to hit volume, and they don't escalate everything out of caution either. They've put in enough time with Runway to have a real sense of what it does and who uses it, so a ticket that's slightly off-script doesn't stump them, even without a creative background. When they see the same question surface three times, they ask whether it should become a macro instead of just answering it a third time.

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the west coast — we also have offices in San Francisco and Seattle

We're building a tool that makes content creation accessible for everyone, from individual creators to Fortune 500 enterprises. We're looking for people who are deeply versed in the Runway product and can take a strategic and creative view to Enterprise Support. If that's you, read on!

What you’ll do

  • Manage customer inquiries across email, chat, Slack, focusing on complex cases requiring human judgment

  • Provide technical and creative support to enterprise customers via written communication and calls

  • Investigate technical issues and create detailed bug reports that save engineering time

  • QA test AI support automation for quality and accuracy

  • Partner with Customer Success on enterprise implementation and adoption, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams

  • Stay current on product updates by actively using Runway

  • Contribute to knowledge base, documentation, and process improvements

  • Identify systemic issues from ticket patterns and calls, and proactively suggest improvements and operate autonomously - you know when to escalate vs. own a problem through resolution

What you’ll need

  • Experience with a mix of video editing, content creation, creative workflows, or generative AI tools

  • 3-5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, solutions engineering, CSM, technical account management)

  • Proven track record handling enterprise customers and complex escalations

  • History of working autonomously with minimal supervision

  • Examples of process improvements or systems you've built

For your application:

During our interview process, you'll have several chances to get acquainted with the Runway product and use all the features our team has built - and that starts now! As part of your application, instead of a cover letter, we ask that you try out the Runway product, specifically build a custom workflow.

Build a Custom Runway Workflow:

  1. Sign up for a free Runway account (no payment required)

  2. Review these resources:

    1. Tutorial

    2. Guide

  3. Build a workflow based on your own creative idea or theme.

    1. Your workflow should include at least 3 steps

    2. Think about a real creative problem someone might solve with Runway

  4. Submit in the application:

    1. Screenshot of your completed workflow

    2. Brief description (3-4 sentences): What's your creative concept? What does your workflow accomplish? Who would use this?

Note: Free accounts can build workflows but can't run them - that's fine! We want to see your ability to learn the product and think creatively about how customers might use it.

In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring in London and APAC.

We're building a creative platform used by artists, filmmakers, and teams at some of the world's most recognized brands. Our support org handles everything from a five-minute billing question to a technical escalation, and we're building out a dedicated tier for the first kind so our more experienced specialists can focus on the second.

We're looking for a Support Representative who's accurate, fast, and comfortable following a process closely under volume. No creative or AI background required. We'll train you on the product.

What you’ll do

  • Resolve high-volume, tickets across account access, billing, and plan questions for Free, Standard, and Pro and Max users

  • Use existing macros, playbooks, and AI support layer suggestions to close tickets accurately and quickly

  • Recognize when a ticket needs product judgment or creative-tool troubleshooting, and route it to Tier 2 Support or Enterprise

  • Flag recurring questions that don't have a macro yet

What you’ll need

  • Clear, accurate written communication, especially on process-driven, checklist-style work

  • Comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work without losing accuracy

  • Prior experience with tools like Zendesk, Notion, or Slack is a plus, not a requirement

  • 0-2 years in any customer-facing or process-driven role (preferably in SaaS, but not required)

  • Enough curiosity to spend a little time in the product or help docs before talking to us. No creative background needed, just evidence you looked

What sets great candidates apart

The best people in this role follow the playbook precisely and know exactly when a ticket doesn't fit it. They don't force a wrong answer to hit volume, and they don't escalate everything out of caution either. They've put in enough time with Runway to have a real sense of what it does and who uses it, so a ticket that's slightly off-script doesn't stump them, even without a creative background. When they see the same question surface three times, they ask whether it should become a macro instead of just answering it a third time.

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across North America and London — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

We’re building a tool that makes content creation easy and accessible for all types of creatives. Our users love it. Runway has an actively engaged and growing community of passionate artists and creators worldwide. And we’re growing our support team to ensure we can continue to provide delightful experiences for our users every day.

We're looking for creatives at heart that can pick up new tools fast, hold up under high ticket volume without losing quality and identify solutions vs. just clearing the queue. If that's you, read on!

What you’ll do

  • Work through a high volume of inbound support tickets across Free, Standard, Pro and Unlimited plans with speed and accuracy

  • Handle escalations from our AI support layer with sharp judgement on what needs a human and what doesn't

  • Identify patterns across tickets and proactively surface them to the product team- not just reporting, but also offering thoughtful recommendations based on what you're seeing

  • Help identify opportunities to maintain or build self-service content: help docs, short-form videos, FAQs, etc.

  • Engage with the Runway community on Discord and other forums

  • Contribute directly to process improvements and automation, including building things yourself when the opportunity is there

  • Triage complex technical issues for escalation to Enterprise support

  • Live troubleshoot within the Runway platform as needed

What you’ll need

  • You're already comfortable in tools like Notion, Slack, Zendesk (or similar), Google Workspace and AI platforms

  • Strong written communication: clear, direct, and thoughtful at volume

  • A learn-by-failing mentality, when you hit something unfamiliar, you have an experimental mindset

  • Natural curiosity about how products work, why users get confused, and what could be done better

  • Comfort managing your own work in a fast-moving environment- high ownership and high autonomy

  • Data driven mindset: you notice patterns and know how to communicate them

  • 1-3 years in customer support, operations, or technical role

  • Expertise and/or interest in the creative space, AI or both

  • Genuine interest in AI, creative tools or both

What sets you apart

The most successful people in this role don't just keep up- they set the pace. They move through 60, 80, even 100+ tickets in a day without letting quality slip. They're reading the queue, not just clearing it. They notice what keeps surfacing and do something about it, a message to product, a doc, sometimes something they built themselves. They show up with ideas no one asked for yet.

jobs.description_html:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

Open to hiring remote across North America and London — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

We're building a tool that makes content creation easy and accessible for all types of creatives. Our users love it. Runway has an actively engaged and growing community of passionate artists and creators worldwide. And we're scaling the systems behind our support team so we can keep delivering delightful experiences as that community grows.

We're looking for a Support Systems Engineer who ships production code, not tickets and specs: someone who takes a fix from proposal to merged PR themselves. This role reports directly to the Head of Customer Experience.

What you’ll do

  • Own the AI support agent, our ticketing system and other Support tools end to end: authentication (JWT), response logic, routing, escalation paths and tone, tested in staging before it sees live traffic

  • Ship daily product changes that remove ticket volume. Recent example: extending automatic refund eligibility to one-click credit purchases, accidental upgrades and month-based proration on annual terms

  • Build and maintain internal CX tooling as real software, not one-offs: scripts, jobs, dashboards, admin surfaces

  • Run QA and evals with real test suites and pass/fail rubrics, plus monitoring and alerts for outages, bugs and volume spikes

  • Own releases: staged rollouts, a regression suite before every ship, clear rollback criteria, a writeup when something reaches production

  • Build the CX reporting the org runs on: volume, deflection, CSAT, reply and resolution time, escalation accuracy, agent spend. You own the correctness and availability of the queries.

  • Build and stage the guardrails on refunds, account changes and anything touching money or PII, including the audit trail

  • Keep the knowledge base accurate and structured for the agent to parse, and manage the handoff into the ticketing system

  • Keep the CX roadmap and the coverage model current, sequenced against priorities set by the Head of CX, so gaps show up before they bite

  • Run the day-to-day with our AI platform vendor: weekly working session, joint roadmap, issues filed with reproductions

  • Carry signal across teams: Product and Engineering on bugs and rollouts, Customer Education on self-serve, community on Discord and the forums, GTM and Analytics on routing and reporting

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Engineering or Support Operations, with real time spent writing code

  • You ship production code in codebases you didn't write: read TypeScript, trace logic through someone else's service, put up a PR that survives review. Our stack is TypeScript and Node.js on AWS

  • Hands-on experience building and tuning AI or LLM-powered support workflows: prompt and context engineering, routing, escalation design, evals

  • SQL experience. You own the reporting, so you shouldn't be waiting on Analytics for it

  • Code-level experience with a billing or payments API: invoices, prorations, refunds. A large share of consumer tickets live here

  • Git, PR review, CI, staging and feature flags as your default way of working

  • Real QA and eval experience: you can define rubrics, build test suites and calibrate against what good looks like

  • Judgment about where a fix belongs, in code, in the agent or in the knowledge base

  • A track record carrying signal between support, product and other functions and turning it into action

  • Comfort managing your own work in a fast-moving environment, high ownership and high autonomy

  • Genuine interest in AI, creative tools or both

What sets you apart

The most successful person in this role treats the agent and the systems around it like a product they own. They watch where it fails, ship the fix and check whether it worked. They build reporting people actually use. And they show up with improvements no one asked for yet.

For your application

During our interview process, you'll have several chances to get acquainted with the Runway product and use all the features our team has built, and that starts now. As part of your application, instead of a cover letter, we ask that you try out the Runway product, specifically build a custom workflow.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

Runway is scaling its Enterprise revenue organization with leaders who know how to build and scale high-performance teams. And, who can operate a revenue machine while keeping customer value in mind - leading our industry-based revenue pods responsible for both net-new ACV, NRR, and Renewal.

This role is designed for the leader who wants to accelerate their CRO career trajectory. Someone who knows how to build and scale teams and leadership excellence from $100M to $500M+ organizations, operate in AI-native fluid environments, and have experience selling-to, expanding, and renewing with client operators from across a variety of ICPs (From operators in Marketing, HR, Operations, and Finance, to technologists in AI, IT Infrastructure, and Security).

Runway is searching for leaders who enjoy the build - hiring top-performing AEs and frontline leaders to grow your teams for scale. You’re a leader-of-leaders who lead hybrid revenue pods of AEs + Engagement managers. We expect you to think like a CRO - every pod is effectively a P&L, expansion is as much your number as new logos, and any customer who signs needs to see value through consumption of the Runway platform.

If you have only ever inherited a running enterprise org, this is not the right fit. If you have built one, we'd like to talk.
