jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage.

This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them.

If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

What You’ll Do

  • Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok.

  • Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion.

  • Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage.

  • Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing.

  • Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed.

  • Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board.

  • Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance.

  • Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working.

What You’ll Need

  • A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work.

  • Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts.

  • A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks.

  • Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality.

  • A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

  • Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

  • Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly.

  • Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets.

  • Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster.

  • A love of music and an eye for culture.

Compensation

This is a contract role paying $70 to $90 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Office Coordinator, LA (contract)
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're seeking a detail-oriented Office Coordinator to support our Workplace team and be the heartbeat of our LA office operations. As the first face visitors see and the go-to person for our team's daily needs, you'll create an environment where creativity and productivity thrive. This role combines the precision of facilities management with the warmth of hospitality.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same, bringing both meticulous organizational skills and a natural talent for making people feel welcome. From managing confidential documents to coordinating team experiences, your attention to detail and proactive approach will ensure our workplace supports our team's best work.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/2II3nDj637yNpta9

What You’ll Do

Administrative Management:

  • Process and maintain NDAs, waivers, and contracts

  • Serve as onsite coordinator for guests and candidates

  • Handle incoming/outgoing package shipments

  • Scan and distribute incoming mail to appropriate teams

  • Manage digital and physical filing systems

  • Serve as primary point of contact for vendors and service providers

  • Establish and negotiate partnerships with local hotels and vendors

  • Support visiting executives and special projects

Office Operations & Facilities:

  • Oversee office maintenance and promptly address facility issues

  • Maintain daily office cleanliness and organization

  • Manage security system including badges and camera monitoring

  • Manage onsite music studio, support partnerships team in hosting artists

  • Provide plant care and maintenance throughout the office

  • Monitor and stock food/beverage supplies

  • Coordinate daily lunch program including setup, service, and cleanup

  • Maintain office supply inventory

  • Process incoming and outgoing mail/packages

  • Manage guest and visitor access, including registration with building security

  • Oversee AV systems setup and troubleshooting

  • Coordinate device procurement and inventory

Team Experience:

  • Plan and execute team events and activities

  • Create a welcoming environment for employees and visitors

  • Support office culture initiatives

  • Support the talent acquisition team through onsite coordination

  • Support new hire onboarding

What You’ll Need

  • 1-2 years of experience in office management or facilities coordination

  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Experience managing vendor relationships

  • Proficiency with office management software and digital tools

  • Problem-solving mindset with ability to work independently

  • Detail-oriented approach with a proactive attitude

  • Comfort with dynamic environments and changing priorities

  • A love of music is a huge plus

Compensation:

This is an hourly position with a rate of $40-$45 an hour.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in person role working at our LA office

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Paid Social Creative Strategist (Contract)
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

  • Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

  • Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

  • Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

  • Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

  • Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

  • Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

  • Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

  • A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

  • A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

  • Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

  • The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

  • A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

  • Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

  • Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

  • Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

  • A love of music and an eye for culture.

Compensation

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Payroll Manager
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is scaling fast, and payroll is becoming mission-critical as our headcount grows. As our first internal Payroll Manager, you'll own payroll processing and compliance end to end for a rapidly growing Series D company — bringing the function in-house, building the processes and controls it needs, and running it cleanly every cycle. Reporting to the Director of Accounting and partnering closely with the People team and our third-party payroll providers, you'll make sure every employee is paid accurately and on time while keeping us compliant across a growing footprint. You'll also bring a measured, meaningful approach to AI and automation to make payroll faster and more accurate. This is a hands-on, build-and-operate role for someone who wants to stand up the payroll function the right way and grow with it.

Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/NHzt3T6j1cg7P3NT

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing across all pay cycles, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Manage compliance across federal, state, and local requirements — tax withholding and filings, wage-and-hour rules, garnishments, and year-end (W-2) processing.

  • Partner closely with the People team on onboarding, compensation changes, benefits and equity-related payroll, and off-boarding.

  • Manage third-party payroll providers and reconcile payroll to the general ledger, resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Build the policies, controls, and documentation that make payroll scalable, audit-ready, and self-service as the team grows.

  • Bring AI and automation to payroll with the right guardrails — making it faster and more accurate so the people building the world's first Creative Entertainment platform are always paid right and on time.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 5-7 years of payroll experience, including hands-on ownership of end-to-end payroll processing at a high-growth company and a passion for payroll.

  • An extremely high level of discretion and ownership, capable of handling highly confidential and time sensitive matters.

  • Deep knowledge of multi-state payroll compliance — tax withholding and filings, wage-and-hour rules, garnishments, and year-end reporting.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll systems and third-party providers (e.g., Rippling, Gusto, ADP, Workday, or similar), including implementations or transitions.

  • Strong payroll accounting skills — reconciling payroll to the GL and partnering on the monthly close.

  • A demonstrated, measured use of AI and automation to make payroll faster and more accurate.

  • A builder's mindset and aptitude for building — you'll set up, document, operate, and then automate, often with little existing infrastructure.

Nice-to-Haves

  • CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or FPC certification.

  • International payroll compliance experience, ideally managed through a 3rd party EOR.

  • Experience bringing payroll in-house or standing up a payroll function from scratch.

  • Equity / stock-based compensation payroll (RSUs, options, ESPP) and global / multi-entity payroll exposure.

  • Consumer tech or other high-growth environment experience.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Willingness to travel (up to 10%) to collaborate with team members across Suno office locations.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategy Lead, Paid Media
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno is changing who gets to make music, and this role helps bring that to millions of new people. As Creative Strategy Lead, you'll own the creative strategy behind our performance marketing: which audiences we reach, what resonates with each, and how every ad makes us smarter. You'll lead a team of creative specialists, work hand-in-hand with paid media, data science, and production, and build the playbook for how we grow, with full autonomy to shape it.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/wSfvXxWs5tF0RkeL

What You’ll Do

  • Own creative strategy for performance marketing across paid social and beyond, from persona strategy to the creative roadmap and the testing plan behind it

  • Build a persona playbook that spells out what to say, show, and test for each audience, and keep it current as results come in

  • Run the loop from creative analysis to insight to strategy, partnering with paid media and data science on tagging, testing, and reading what drove performance

  • Drive audience research, customer conversations, and competitive intel to deepen our understanding of who we bring in, scale what works, and find new audiences worth reaching

  • Lead and develop a team of creative specialists across UGC, AI, and brand creative, and manage our UGC agency partner

  • Feed what you learn about our users back into product and go-to-market, and help bring millions of new people into creative entertainment

What You’ll Need

  • 8+ years in creative strategy, with deep roots in performance marketing

  • A track record of paid social creative strategy that drove subscriptions and conversions (not brand or awareness campaigns), with results you can speak to

  • Experience at large, complex consumer companies with a wide range of audiences, selling everything from low-price subscriptions to higher-ticket plans

  • Experience leading creative strategists and creatives while acting as the bridge between creative and paid media teams

  • A sharp, clear communicator who can explain exactly how a strategy is built and why

  • Relentlessly proactive: you go looking for the audience insight nobody handed you, and you care deeply about the people you're advertising to

  • Bonus: YouTube or Google display creative, ASO, or lifecycle marketing experience

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

 

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

$150,000–$200,000 base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior / Staff Application Security Engineer to own the security of how our product is built. You’ll be the person who makes sure our code, APIs, and services are secure by design — threat-modeling the product, hardening the application layer, and building the AppSec practice from the ground up.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/Eh3xgvx2oFpT0QPq

What You’ll Do

  • Execute application security end to end: threat-model features and services, and drive remediation of the most significant risks.

  • Secure the application layer against the vulnerabilities that matter most — injection, broken authentication and authorization, and insecure APIs.

  • Build and run a secure SDLC: code-review guardrails, SAST/DAST, dependency and supply-chain security, secrets management, and pre-production testing.

  • Harden authentication, authorization, and session/identity handling across the product.

  • Secure the AI-specific application surface — model and inference endpoints, prompt and input handling, and the new classes of vulnerability that come with shipping generative features.

  • Partner with product and platform engineering to design security in early and raise the security bar across the codebase.

  • Set the standard for how engineering reasons about and ships secure code.

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years in security engineering with deep, hands-on application-security expertise.

  • Strong command of the vulnerability classes that cause incidents and how to eliminate them at the source — code, API, and authz design.

  • A builder who has stood up AppSec practices and secure-SDLC tooling, not only operated established ones.

  • Fluent in modern application stacks and comfortable in AWS.

  • Able to work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and raise the bar without becoming a blocker.

  • Able to write and ship production-quality code, not only review it.

  • Curiosity about emerging AI/LLM threat classes and how to defend against them as the product evolves.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, secure-by-design work on generative-AI or ML product surfaces, and/or early security-hire experience.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our three offices.

Compensation:

  • $230,000 to 330,000

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. About the Role

Trust should be the foundation of every relationship Suno has — with our users, our artists, our rightsholders, and the broader music community. We're looking for our first dedicated data scientist on the Trust & Safety team to help make that real by building the metrics and analysis that let us measure how we're doing, and collaborating to define and execute on an impactful roadmap. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and legal to bring a rigorous, quantitative lens to problems like copyright detection, content filtering, and bot detection. You and cross-functional stakeholders will work together to create a seamless creative environment for our users that is built on security and trust.

Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/ip8Q3TIlQxuaTyOt

What You'll Do

  • Define and evaluate metrics for the health of our trust and safety ecosystem

  • Analyze and build models, algorithms, and methodologies for maintaining a safe platform, like bot detection, content filtering, copyright detection, etc.

  • Design and run experiments that measure the real impact of changes to Trust & Safety practices, and turn results into clear recommendations

  • Partner with product and engineering to size opportunities and shape the Trust & Safety roadmap

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 6–8 years of experience in data science or a closely related analytical field, with several years in trust & safety or closely adjacent problems (e.g., spam/fraud, integrity, policy-adjacent ML)

  • Strong hands-on SQL and Python

  • Experience running online experiments end-to-end, from ideation and metrics selection through analysis and informing the final decision

  • Experience building metrics or evaluation frameworks from scratch, without established precedent to lean on

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience training and building predictive ML models, offline and real-time.

  • Musician or creative hobbyist

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/375QSVXzMkUOAvwN

About the Role

AI is changing how software gets built and how companies run and we intend to be at the front of it. We're hiring a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to build the systems that let every team at Suno move fast and scale with our rapid growth. This is greenfield work with real ownership, and you'll help shape how Suno adopts AI. We're hiring for our AI Leverage team, which empowers engineers and other teams across Suno to move faster at scale with agentic tools.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build AI-powered internal systems that let everyone at Suno, from engineers to recruiters, do more with AI

  • Own the underlying infrastructure that keeps our AI tooling running in production: reliable, observable, cost-effective, and flexible

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their workflows, surface the right problems to solve, and prioritize what gets built next

  • Champion best practices for agentic coding and operations, and help teams adopt them across the company

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • You bring 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience

  • You’ve designed, built, and shipped AI-based tools that go well beyond using a coding assistant, and you’re fluent in concepts like MCP, gateways, and evaluations

  • You’re eager to learn and share agentic coding best practices and tools

  • You have a track record of shipping tooling or systems that support engineering or internal teams

  • You thrive in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where the problem space is still being defined

Nice-to-Haves

  • You’ve worked with agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) and eval or observability tooling (e.g. LangSmith, Braintrust)

  • You’ve stood up operational practices for internal systems from scratch

Not sure you meet every point above? Please apply anyway. If you're excited about this work and think you could make an impact here, we'd love to hear from you. The best candidates rarely check every box.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for early members of our Android team at the Senior and Staff levels. These aren’t maintenance roles — you’ll help define the architecture and experience of a product that’s genuinely changing how the world makes music.

You’ll work directly alongside the founding team, shaping technical and product decisions from the ground up. The Suno Android app is far more than a music player: it’s a real-time AI creation studio, a social platform for sharing and discovering original music, and a showcase for some of the most advanced generative audio technology ever shipped to consumers at scale.

At the Senior level, you’ll own major features end-to-end, drive engineering quality, and contribute to architectural decisions. At the Staff level, you’ll set the technical direction for the Android platform, mentor the team, and define the foundations that scale us to 10x our current user base and beyond.

Our Android app has earned over 1.6 million reviews and a 4.8 rating on Google Play, with 10M+ downloads — a generative audio workstation in every user’s pocket, used by creators worldwide. The Android team is central to how people experience Suno: music creation, discovery, playback, social features, and real-time AI inference all live on this platform. If you care about building something that feels native, responsive, and genuinely delightful on Android, and you want to do it in one of the most exciting problem spaces in tech, this is the role.

Check out the Suno song we made about this role: https://suno.com/s/oEdmOtkZDLHCopSG

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build Suno’s Android app across creation, discovery, playback, and social experiences

  • Create foundational abstractions and libraries for performant, highly interactive media experiences

  • Own feature development from zero to one and beyond — scoping, shipping, and iterating post-launch

  • Collaborate closely with product and design to shape the feel, flow, and direction of the app

  • Optimize for performance, responsiveness, and delight — from render times to audio latency to micro-interactions

  • Instrument and monitor the app’s health, and iterate rapidly based on real user data

  • Set the technical direction for the Android platform and define architectural patterns the team builds on

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, abstractions, and engineering culture

What You’ll Need

Required

  • 5+ years shipping production Android apps

  • Advanced expertise in Kotlin and modern Android development frameworks and best practices

  • Experience building fluid, polished animations and translating design prototypes into robust, production-grade code

  • A keen understanding of what’s distinct about Android — and how to leverage that in a media-rich application

  • Strong sense for performance: you profile, benchmark, and fix across UI rendering, memory, and network efficiency

  • An obsession with great user experience — you care about the details that most engineers skip

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can scope work, make tradeoffs, and ship without a fully-defined spec

  • A collaborative spirit and strong communication — you work fluidly with designers, PMs, and backend teams

Strong Plusses

  • Prior experience with ExoPlayer and Media3 for audio/video playback

  • Experience working with audio streaming pipelines or real-time audio on Android

  • Experience with social product features: feeds, follow graphs, notifications, publishing flows

  • Background designing or consuming mobile-first APIs in close collaboration with backend engineers

  • Track record building 0→1 consumer products at a fast-moving startup

  • Technical leadership or mentorship experience (especially important for Staff candidates)

  • A genuine love of music — listening, creating, or performing

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $200K – $300K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO with HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes

  • This role is a 5 day a week in-office role in our LA, Venice Beach office

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Life at Suno: https://suno.com/about

Series D Announcement: https://suno.com/blog/series-d-announcement

jobs.title: Senior Manager, IT Operations
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Lead the team that keeps Suno Corporate IT Systems running. As Manager, IT Operations, you'll lead our IT Engineers and build our IT Service Desk. Your team owns IT operations across our four US offices — Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles — including identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration software, office A/V, office networking, and Tailscale.

Your success will be measured through the impact of your team. You'll establish clear ownership over operational areas, ensure top-notch service that your colleagues trust, and your team will leverage AI and Automation to scale efficiently. You'll partner closely with Operations, People, Finance, Security, and Engineering, and you'll be the senior IT presence on the West Coast.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/0fzLoGLLVcxm3uBA

What Your Team Owns

  • Identity and access management — Okta, SSO and SCIM coverage, joiner / mover / leaver automation via our IGA platform, access reviews, and ad hoc access requests.

  • Endpoint management — the Mac fleet in MDM, zero-touch enrollment, OS and patch compliance, device trust, and endpoint security in partnership with our EDR/MDR providers.

  • Collaboration software — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the broader SaaS portfolio: configuration, hardening, licensing, and lifecycle.

  • Office A/V — conference rooms, videoconferencing, and event spaces.

  • Corporate Networking — wired, wireless, and WAN across four sites, including design for buildouts and expansions with outside experts where it makes sense.

  • Tailscale — our zero-trust network layer: ACL policy, device posture, access to internal tools and infrastructure, and the day-to-day administration in collaboration with Engineering

  • IT service delivery — the service desk, AI IT Service Management platform, SLAs, escalation paths, knowledge base, and the Tier 0 partnership with office managers.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the IT Engineers — set expectations against our role standards, give direct feedback, run 1:1s and performance conversations, and grow people on the IC track. Manage against outcomes and impact, not tenure and activities.

  • Build the IT Help Desk — define the service model (what the desk handles, what escalates to engineering, what office managers cover at Tier 0), write the job profiles, our our service desk team.

  • Run change well — size changes by scope, impact, and reversibility; make sure the team communicates before changes land and can roll them back after; bring in the right partners early and avoid surprises.

Must-Haves

jobs.title: Senior UX Researcher, Qualitative
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About The Role

For most people, making music has always felt out of reach. Suno is changing that, and mobile is where that change will happen for the majority of people.

We are looking for a Senior Qualitative UX Researcher to own the deepest questions about the people we haven't reached yet. Not the users who already know what a stem is, but the ones who open the app with no idea what's possible and no vocabulary for what they want. Understanding how creative confidence gets built, across a very wide range of ages and levels of experience, is one of the highest-leverage research problems at the company right now.

You'll be the research partner to the PM and designer leading mobile create and working alongside them to address shared product questions. You’ll also collaborate with the researcher focused on rapid mobile evaluation, ensuring that usability insights and foundational research inform one another.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership. You’ll develop and advocate for the research roadmap, adapt it as priorities evolve, and confidently revise your perspective when new evidence emerges.


Listen to the song we made about this role! https://suno.com/s/Asd2doVRgxJzjenY

What You'll Do

Own the foundational research agenda for mobile create - Define and run the generative studies that shape where the product goes: ethnography, diary and longitudinal studies, in-context observation, concept work. Decide what's worth studying, and say no to what won't change a decision.

Go where the creating happens - Lead in-person and in-field research, including in-home sessions and sessions with more than one participant at once, such as household and family settings. Some of the most important behavior here will never show up in a remote unmoderated test.

Be a true partner, not a service desk - Sit with the mobile create PM, designer, and engineers as decisions are being made. Bring user signal early enough to change the shape of the work, not late enough to only validate it.

Turn findings into things the org keeps using - Segmentations, journey and jobs-to-be-done frameworks, opportunity maps, design principles that outlive any single launch and get cited in rooms you're not in.

Connect qual to the numbers - Pair depth with survey and behavioral data. Work with data science as a peer to size what you find, and with growth partners to translate insight into acquisition, onboarding, and retention bets.

Raise the craft bar - Mentor, review study designs, and unblock other researchers. This is an IC role with real influence, not a management track.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of industry UX research experience, with deep specialization in qualitative methods and consumer mobile products

  • A track record of research that shifted strategy, not just UI. You can name the roadmap decisions, product bets, or reversals your work drove

  • Experience running in-person research with groups, including in-home and in-context sessions, sessions with more than one participant at a time, and the consent and assent workflows that come with them

  • Rigorous methodological judgment and the range to match method to question rather than reaching for the same study every time

  • Sound instincts about ethics and participant comfort with people who are not professional research subjects

  • Fluency with quantitative data. You can read an experiment readout, design a survey that holds up, and hold your own with a data scientist

  • Genuinely self-directed. You find the important question before anyone assigns it, and you have a high tolerance for ambiguity, shifting priorities, and moving faster than feels comfortable

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority, and to hold a position when the room disagrees

  • Excited by consumer products, creativity, music, and AI, and by the idea that the interaction patterns for this category don't exist yet

What You'll Need

  • Startup experience, especially as the first or only researcher, or as a founder (even with a research team around you, this role runs on ownership rather than process)

  • Experience in sensitive product areas such as safety, trust, or wellbeing

  • Background in consumer mobile in audio, music, or social

  • Experience researching AI and generative products, where user mental models are still forming

Nice to Haves

  • PhD in HCI, Human-Centered Computing, Psychology, Learning Sciences, or a related field, combined with real industry experience.

  • You know of a good UX research lab or in-person session space in LA that we could use, and bonus points if you've worked out of it

  • Bonus points if you've used Suno to make music

Additional Notes

  • You must be authorized to work in the United States

  • You must be willing to work 5 days per week at our Venice Beach office

  • Some travel for team meetings and field research

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is: $176K-$220K (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

We’re looking for early members of our machine learning recommendations team. You’ll work closely with the founding team and have ownership of a wide variety of technical decisions on how we build and deploy our state of the art recommendation models.

Check out the Suno version of the job here! https://suno.com/s/ujpqmS3Rf9Qg911A

What You’ll Do

  • Formulate and develop mathematical models of user preference, similarity, and engagement for music discovery

  • Design learning systems that infer user taste from sparse, noisy, and evolving interaction data

  • Build and deploy scalable recommendation and ranking models that operate under real-time latency and throughput constraints

  • Translate abstract objectives (relevance, novelty, diversity, long-term satisfaction) into measurable metrics and optimized systems

  • Run large-scale experiments and causal analyses to evaluate model behavior and product impact

  • Work closely with product and research leadership to define the technical direction of Suno’s personalization systems

What You’ll Need

  • Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) with the ability to implement and iterate on research ideas

  • Solid knowledge and understanding of data pipelines and cloud technologies, e.g., Spark, AWS, etc.

  • Proven track record of building, deploying, and maintaining 0->1 production Machine Learning or Data Science solutions

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills working with cross-functional teams such as Product, Data, Infra, etc.

  • A love of music (listening, exploring, or making) is a strong plus

    Preferred Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of industrial experience in Recommendation, Search, Ads, Optimization, Reinforcement Learning, or related disciplines

    • Publications at top Machine Learning, Data Mining, Information Retrieval, Natural Language Processing conferences such as KDD, ICML, NeurIPS, RecSys, ACL, etc.

Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Artists & Creators
jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is standing up an Artists & Creators pod, and our first major focus is Songkick.com — our newly acquired live music and ticketing product. We're hiring an early team to take technical ownership of Songkick within Suno across the stack: the backend, the website, the mobile app, the data pipelines, and the notification systems that power it. You'll report to the Songkick Engineering Manager and work closely with the Songkick General Manager, our Product Manager, and our Music teams to help define how this team tracks success and grows. Early on, the work is hands-on and diverse — understanding the existing system deeply, stabilizing it, and finding the integration points that make Songkick and Suno stronger together. Over time, this role has real influence over the roadmap, engineering best practices, and leaving a handprint on Suno's Artists & Creators engineering team.

Check out the Suno version of the role here! https://suno.com/s/emzEA5oPeNN6dxK2

What You'll Do

  • Own part of the Songkick product end-to-end, wherever you’re strongest — from backend, mobile app (React Native, iOS + Android), data pipelines, and notifications

  • Lead the technical integration of Songkick into Suno, partnering with the Songkick Engineering Manager, Product Manager, incoming General Manager, and our existing engineering team to identify what to build next

  • Architect and maintain data aggregation systems that ingest, normalize, and score touring and event data from dozens of sources into a single canonical record

  • Assess a large, established codebase and make clear-eyed calls about what to preserve, modernize, or retire

  • Design APIs consumed by mobile clients, working directly with the teams building on top of them

  • Extend Suno's mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality into how fans discover and experience live music

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 5–10 years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated hunger to stay close to the code and the end user

  • An ownership mentality — you enjoy taking a large, ambiguous product space and running with it end-to-end

  • Startup experience shipping quickly in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

  • Strong API design skills, having worked closely with iOS/Android or other mobile teams

  • A flexible set of communication styles — you reduce entropy rather than create it, pride yourself on your ability to write, as well as facilitate live discussions with stakeholders ranging in level of technical expertise

  • Experience working with modern agentic coding workflows, including E2E testing harnesses, reusable skills, and defining clear success criteria

  • Enthusiasm for rapid learning, regardless of whether technology and tools are brand new or legacy

  • A preference for deeply collaborative environments

Experience with a few of the following:

  • Experience building systems that ingest data from 20+ sources, normalize it, score or weight it by source reliability, apply survivorship rules, and store a canonical record

  • Strong SQL and NoSQL experience

  • Strong data modeling and system architecture skills at scale

  • Tuning Web, Android, and/or iOS performance metrics with a healthy fear of red numbers

  • Building out a design system to accelerate development whilst keeping a consistent feel

  • Experience retrofitting design systems

Nice-to-Haves

  • Hands-on experience with React Native and/or Ruby on Rails

  • Experience building or maintaining email or push notification systems

This Role is a Match for Candidates Who:

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments — you don't need everything mapped out to move forward

  • Bring low ego and high versatility, equally at ease debugging a small fix or driving a major project

  • Get energy from rapid prototyping and iteration — you'd rather ship something rough and refine it than wait for perfect

  • Have a genuine passion for music and live events, and want that passion reflected in your work

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in-person role working at our Cambridge, NYC, LA offices.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

 

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $ $228K-$363K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is hiring a Software Engineer, Trust and Safety, to safeguard the platform millions of creators call home. You'll be the line of defense between our community and the abuse, fraud, and harmful content that threatens it — building the systems that keep Suno a place people can trust with their creativity.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/ettTEOOCwNM5xT5T

What You'll Do

  • Build systems, data pipelines to observe, measure, detect, and enforce against Trust and Safety violations (legal compliance, content safety, fraud, bot, abuse, impersonation, etc.)

  • Build tools and dashboards for operations and investigations

  • Investigate data to identify new attack patterns and improve existing solutions

  • Work closely with engineering, product, data science, operations and legal teams

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years of experience in Trust and Safety (ex: anti-abuse, bot, content safety, fraud)

  • 5+ years of experience with backend development: Python

  • 5+ years of experience with data handling: SQL, Snowflake, Dagster, Airflow, etc.

  • Experience with building tools, dashboards, statistical analysis, and anomaly detection

  • Experience with real-time systems and event-driven architectures

Nice to Have

  • ML experience (model development and deployment)

  • Experience of behavioral analytics and user journey analysis

  • Experience of A/B testing and experimentation

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. We support H-1B transfers.

jobs.description_html:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno’s platform teams build the foundation upon which everything else is built, from our products at scale to our internal processes. We’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to work on one of the teams that powers the entire company: Infrastructure, Platform, and Leverage These teams work on a range of complex challenges, from the lowest layers of compute, to the platforms that 70+ engineers build on daily, to the AI-native tools and workflows that catalyze how everyone at Suno works, to the core creation surface where millions of people make music.

During the interview process we’ll work with you to find the team that’s the best mutual fit based on your background, technical strengths, and what gets you excited. What all of these teams share: they’re building foundational systems at scale, they own their work end-to-end, and their output directly determines how fast and how well Suno can build and ship products. They solve hard problems with autonomy and a bias toward engineering excellence.

Check out the Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/3NcdjuEOnlHGMoBt

What You’ll Do

On one of Suno’s platform teams, you’ll work on a subset of the complex challenges outlined below:

  • Build the platforms that 70+ engineers depend on to ship product quickly and safely — APIs, authentication, deployment tooling, backend-driven configuration, and similar

  • Manage migrations that help teams transition off legacy systems seamlessly and without risk

  • Collaborate with engineering teams across the company to understand their needs and build the right abstractions

  • Build shared infrastructure, agentic tooling, and workflows that enable AI-native development across the company

  • Define best practices, frameworks, and evaluation systems for how Suno uses tooling in daily work

  • Partner closely with engineering and non-engineering teams to understand their needs and build the right solutions

  • Architect and build services to handle write-heavy consumer traffic and data

  • Design systems that are performant, secure, scalable, and easy to observe

  • Build and operate distributed databases, caching layers, and storage systems at consumer scale

  • Scale Kubernetes infrastructure and control planes to support rapid product and ML growth

  • Design inference infrastructure that keeps AI workloads fast, reliable, and cost-efficient

  • Build the foundational infrastructure for next-generation song creation: a multi-modal music agent, a create platform that powers multiple song creation products, and a realtime API enabling live generation and radio experiences

  • Operate with ambiguity — scope what matters, move fast, and drive projects forward independently as the space evolves

  • Own systems end-to-end — from design through deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence

  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability

What You’ll Need

To succeed on one of Suno’s platform teams, your experience and skill set might resemble a cross section of the following:

  • 5–7+ years of infrastructure, backend, or systems engineering experience

  • Experience building and operating systems at significant scale in production

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud services (AWS/GCP), and modern infrastructure patterns

  • Expertise in infrastructure and platform security best practices

  • Ability to reason through hard scaling, reliability, and performance problems with clear technical judgment

  • Technical leadership or management experience

  • Experience building internal systems 0→1 — auth, notifications, CDN, or similar

  • Experience with websockets, streaming traffic patterns, and audio/video delivery

  • Familiarity with backend API design patterns at scale to serve internal backend, web and mobile clients alike

  • Experience on a platform or developer experience team where your primary customers were other engineers

  • Ability to manage system migrations with multiple dependent engineering teams

  • A working knowledge of security best practices in building and scaling infrastructure

  • Hands-on familiarity with the current landscape of AI for software engineering including, but not limited to: models, agents, coding assistants, and agentic workflows

  • Experience building or operating agent orchestration, tool calling, or streaming LLM generation systems

  • Experience building a streaming or realtime protocol in production — streaming generation, chat/turn-based UI, or live progress feeds

  • Shipped APIs consumed by iOS and Android clients in production; mobile-friendly API design is second nature

  • Observability is part of how you ship — you instrument before launch, not after

  • Mentorship experience — you’ve actively developed junior or mid-level engineers, not just worked alongside them

  • Strong product instincts — you synthesize user needs and build the right abstraction

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces

  • High ownership — you drive projects end-to-end without waiting for direction

  • Strong product instincts — you synthesize user needs and build the right abstraction

  • Strong communication skills — you keep stakeholders informed and reduce ambiguity for the teams you serve

  • Strong written communication — patient and educator-minded when rolling out tools that change how people work

  • Strong oncall instincts — triage, debug, and resolve incidents across a distributed stack

  • A love of music, whether you’re an avid listener or musician yourself

Additional Notes

  • This role is based in Cambridge, MA (Boston).

  • This role is expected to work from the Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno’s company policy.

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Establish the metrics and frameworks the team uses to define and measure success

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

  • 6–8+ years of experience in data science in consumer tech and mobile apps

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and statistical modeling

  • Experience running experiments end-to-end, from design through analysis to shipping decision

  • A user-centric, product-first mindset

  • Excellent communication and collaboration

  • A self-starter mentality with the ability to thrive in ambiguity, eagerness to wear multiple hats, and passion for continuous learning

  • Proficiency with and excitement about using and building AI tools

Nice-to-Haves

  • Musician or creative hobbyist — genuine empathy for the people using the product

  • Experience partnering with early-stage or 0-to-1 product teams

  • Familiarity with mobile-specific analytics and attribution tooling

Suno is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to help us scale our technical programs and launches - coordinating across engineering, product, and other functions to land some of our largest initiatives. As a Staff TPM, you’ll have the ability to create and drive programs, and partner with us to figure out where we should be investing that we aren’t today. What You'll Do

  • Lead cross-functional programs end to end — things like model launches, multi-team engineering efforts, and engineering initiatives — from scoping, through rollout, and tracking

  • Coach and grow the team's TPM, building the mentorship and structure that hasn't existed here before

  • Help shape what "TPM" means at Suno — the working model, the organizing principles, and where the function needs to grow

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership so cross-functional continues to move fast and collaboration is easy, contributing directly to team velocity

  • Help turn Suno's mission — making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — into shipped, coordinated reality across teams

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 8–10 years in program or technical program management

  • Demonstrated adaptability — you find the right approach for the environment you're in rather than importing what worked somewhere else

  • A clear, articulable framework for how you evaluate and measure whether a program is actually succeeding

  • Enough technical/coding fluency to get hands-on and understand the work that needs to be done, not just coordinate around it

Nice-to-Haves

  • Track record of building a program from zero in genuine ambiguity and landing it

  • Experience coaching or mentoring other program managers

  • Background at a consumer tech company, a high-scale tech company, or a hypergrowth scale-up

About the role

You will own the operating floor of Trust & Safety at Suno: review queues, vendor capacity, quality programs, SLAs, and escalation workflows. Our enforcement system blends automated decisioning with human judgment, and your job is to make the human side of that system fast, accurate, and worth every dollar it costs. You will report to our Trust & Safety lead and work closely with Product, Eng, Legal, Comms, and the broader Operations team.

Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/bWZ30M98bvirsCPq

What you'll do

  • Run day-to-day enforcement operations: queue health, latency, SLA attainment and escalation handling across all content categories.

  • Own vendor and BPO performance: capacity forecasting, quality enforcement, contract performance and site management.

  • Build and run the training, QA, and calibration program that keeps decision quality measurable and improving.

  • Manage capacity planning against rapid volume growth, including the tradeoffs between headcount, vendor spend, and automation.

  • Define tooling requirements for reviewer workflows and partner with Engineering to ship them.

  • Support reviewer wellness and resilience programs for the teams doing the hardest work on the platform.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or CX operations, including 2+ years directly managing reviewers or vendor teams.

  • Ownership of operational metrics you can speak to concretely: SLA attainment, queue latency, QA scores, cost per decision, reviewer utilization.

  • Hands-on vendor or BPO management with real performance accountability, not just relationship handling.

  • Experience building or running a QA and calibration program with measurable decision-quality outcomes.

Nice to have

  • Operating experience alongside ML-assisted enforcement: queue routing on model scores, human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Reviewer wellness and resilience program exposure.

  • UGC or generative AI platform background.
